# UI/UX audit — details (generated from the 2026-10 audit run)

Machine-assisted audit: 6 researchers, 8 audit dimensions, solutions per dimension, two independent skeptic passes (findings refutation, solution feasibility/ethics). Evidence references screenshots and measurements that lived in a scratch directory; code references are file:line at commit fb32d77. Verdicts: findings `confirmed` / `partly`; solutions `keep` / `modify` / `drop`. A `modify` verdict means the **revised proposal** below replaces the original.

## First run, home page, navigation

The home screen has one strong primary action (a big orange "Начать" or "Продолжить" button inside a "Today's lesson" card), the first task is a gentle one with a "Прочитать" audio button, and the language switch is always visible. What hurts the 6-8 year old first-timer is the first launch and the screen's length. The welcome dialog is a wall of text. Its only CTA ("Поехали") is below the first screen and is disabled with no explanation. The home page then adds a sixth heading-level block of reading between the child and the content. Phone header navigation is icon-only with 34 px tall targets. Home is about 9 viewports (7594 px) and shows all 21 days, plus a habits card that repeats the same week list. For an older child (Dilnoza) the chess entry and the day plan are far down the page, and progress is shown as many small, low-contrast tiles. The math / chess / my tasks / parents split is not explained anywhere in the child's own words. Priorities: shorten and stage the welcome, make the CTA reachable, label the header on phone, put one "next step" at the very top, and collapse everything below it.

**Keep (strengths):**

- One unmistakable primary action on the home hero: a big orange 'Начать ▶' / 'Продолжить ▶' button (HomeDashboard.tsx:85-89, rich-phone-home-t1.jpg), with the day title and a visible 'сегодня' badge on the matching day card (HomeDashboard.tsx:296). Keep this pattern.
- The live name greeting 'Привет, Азиз! 👋' while typing (ChildNameField.tsx:156-159, fresh-bottom-noage.png) is warm and gives instant feedback; the hero then greets the child by name (HomeDashboard.tsx:59-61).
- Language switch is available in the welcome dialog (HomeDashboard.tsx:350-365) and in the header on every page as a compact RU/UZ toggle (LangSwitch.tsx); it applies immediately and the Uzbek home (richuz-phone-home-t1.jpg) is complete and natural.
- The welcome dialog has a voice button and age buttons that are exactly 44 px (measured: 44x44), and the age choice shows an immediate explanation of the profile (HomeDashboard.tsx:440-444). Age is a tap, not a typed field.
- The returning-user path is good: the hero turns into 'Продолжим' (HomeDashboard.tsx:69-72), the next incomplete day is computed automatically (HomeDashboard.tsx:36), and the daily quest items are tappable links that take the child straight to the activity (TodayCard.tsx:80-94).
- Soft gamification is calm: 'Один пропуск в неделю прощается' (TodayCard.tsx:118-124), a week goal of 5 of 7 days, no loss wording. Day cards combine emoji per task type with a progress bar, which a non-reader can scan (rich-phone-home-t4.jpg).
- ChessHomeCard is a strong card: a row of six piece icons, current rank, a progress bar 'N из 43' and a full-width yellow CTA with min-h-14 (ChessHomeCard.tsx:281).
- Nothing overflows horizontally and no interactive element lacks an accessible name on the home page (audit-metrics 'phone /': hOverflow false, noName 0).

### Findings

#### ONB-1 · major · confirmed — Welcome dialog is a text wall; the only CTA is below the fold and disabled without a reason

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** The first thing a 7-year-old sees is ~584 characters: a 3-line heading, a grey intro, three 2-line rules, a voice button, then name, then age, then the button. All on one scrolling sheet. On a Pixel 7 (839 px viewport) the dialog is 1066 px tall, the name field starts at y=680 and the 'Поехали!' button at y=970, so neither the age choice nor the start button is visible on the first screen. The button is disabled (faded purple) until both name and age are set, and nothing says what is missing (no aria-disabled, no helper text). Escape does not close it (and there is no skip). When the on-screen keyboard opens for the name, the viewport shrinks further and the age row and button are pushed several scrolls away.
- **Evidence:** HomeDashboard.tsx:339-450 (Welcome): heading + paragraph + 3 rules + ListenButton + name + age + CTA in one scroll; Playwright on Pixel 7: dlgScrollH 1066 vs vh 839; btnTop 970; btnDisabled true; ariaDisabled null; fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg / t2.jpg; fresh-bottom-noage.png (faded 'Поехали!' with nothing explaining why); HomeDashboard.tsx:446 Button disabled={!ready}
- **Principle:** Progressive disclosure and one-thing-at-a-time for emergent readers; Fitts/visibility of the primary action; never disable a primary button without saying why (Nielsen: visibility of system status, error prevention). Cognitive load for ages 6-8: ~3 items per screen.
- **Impact:** Aziz either gives up, asks a parent, or taps randomly; the very first minute of the product is the highest-drop-off moment and currently needs an adult.
- **Skeptic:** Reproduced on Pixel 7 with an empty profile. Viewport is 839 px and the dialog scrolls to 1066 px. The name input starts at y=680. The age buttons sit at y=906 (44 px tall, which is fine). The 'Поехали!' button is at y=970, below the fold. The button is disabled (opacity 0.45) with aria-disabled null and no title. Escape leaves the dialog open (count stays 1). Focus stays on BODY with no autofocus. With the viewport cut to 420 px to simulate the keyboard, the button top is at 637, so it is off screen. Small slip: the text is about 554 characters, not 584. Everything else matches.

#### ONB-2 · minor · partly — The welcome splits the three rules of the lab into text, but never says what the app is (math AND chess) and never starts with a win

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** The dialog spends its space on three behavioural rules ('Не торопись', 'Открой подсказку', 'Объясни почему'); they are valuable, but they are abstract instructions before any experience. The word 'шахматы' appears nowhere in the welcome, and the hero heading below says 'Математика — это место...' only. A child who came for chess (the second pillar) lands in a math-only hero, and a child who is told rules does not yet know the product. A better order is: 1 choice (language), 1 tiny profile (name, age), then a 30-second first task with the rules revealed in context (hint button appears -> 'hints come one by one').
- **Evidence:** HomeDashboard.tsx:367-400 (rules text) and :63-65 (math-only h1); fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg; fresh-desk-home.jpg (same content on desktop, longer than a 800 px viewport)
- **Principle:** Just-in-time teaching over upfront instruction (Duolingo, Khan Academy Kids both put a first activity before sign-up questions); 'show, don't tell' for pre-readers.
- **Impact:** Time to first success is longer than necessary; the owner's pedagogy rules are delivered where children do not read.
- **Skeptic:** The facts hold: the welcome text has no mention of chess, and the hero h1 says only 'Математика — это место...' (HomeDashboard.tsx about line 63). The recommendation (put a first task before the rules, show the rules in context) is a design opinion with no measured evidence of drop-off. The three rules do match the owner's stated principles. The rules text is already covered by ONB-1, so the extra impact is small.

#### ONB-3 · major · confirmed — Phone header navigation is icon-only, with small targets, and the chess entry is a grey glyph

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** Below the sm breakpoint the labels 'Шахматы', 'Мои задачи', 'Родителям' are hidden (hidden sm:inline), leaving only ♞ ✍️ 🔒. They are 36x34, 42x34 and 42x34 CSS px (below 44), spaced by gap-1 (4 px); RU/UZ buttons are 33x32. The ♞ is a monochrome text glyph that renders dark grey and small next to colourful emoji, so the child's second main section looks like the least important icon. aria-label/title exist but are invisible on touch. '✍️' and '🔒' do not communicate 'my own tasks' or 'for parents' to a 7-year-old; the padlock is also the only 'don't touch' symbol and may scare or tempt.
- **Evidence:** SiteHeader.tsx:12-24 ('hidden sm:inline' label, px-2.5 py-2), :42-46; Playwright header measurements: Шахматы 36x34, Мои задачи 42x34, Родителям 42x34, RU/UZ 33x32; rich-phone-home-t1.jpg (header: grey ♞, ✍️, 🔒 floating with no text); audit-metrics 'phone /': small44 10, tiny32 1
- **Principle:** Navigation needs recognition over recall; touch targets >= 44-48 px for children (children's motor precision is lower; WCAG 2.5.5, Apple HIG). Icon-only nav is unreliable without text, especially for a bilingual audience.
- **Impact:** Aziz cannot find chess outside the home card; parents hunt for the parent area; mis-taps on the 4 px gaps next to the language switch are likely.
- **Skeptic:** Measured on Pixel 7 at /: Шахматы 36x34, Мои задачи 42x34, Родителям 42x34, RU 33x32, UZ 33x32. The nav gap is 4 px (left 190+36 -> next 230). SiteHeader.tsx:23 has 'hidden sm:inline' on the label, so on phone only the ♞ ✍️ 🔒 glyphs show. In rich-phone-home-t1.jpg the ♞ is a small grey text glyph next to colour emoji. aria-label and title exist but are not visible on touch. audit-metrics 'phone /' lists the same three links in small44 (small44 = 10, tiny32 = 1). The claim that the padlock may scare or tempt a child is opinion, but it is plausible (see missed issue on PIN).

#### ONB-4 · minor · partly — Home is ~9 screens long: all 21 days are expanded, and the same week list is shown twice

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA, PARENT
- **Problem:** Phone home is 7594 px (9.1 viewports): hero 1 screen, habits card ~1.9, today card ~1.5, chess ~1, then 3 weeks x 7 full-size day cards (each ~680 px with title, 8 mini-emoji and a progress bar) and 4 stat tiles. The 7 habits per week are also a second visualisation of the same 21 days (habit = day), and the current-week list shows long dashed items that are not tappable. The child has no 'map'; they have a very long list. Weeks 2 and 3 are shown in full although they are 'впереди' and not yet relevant; the Aziz-sized attention span (about 10 minutes) cannot handle that scroll.
- **Evidence:** audit-metrics 'phone /': docH 7594, ratio 9.1, interactive 38; HomeDashboard.tsx:121-178 (habits card), :185-271 (all weeks rendered), :273-287 (stats); rich-phone-home-t2.jpg (habit list), rich-phone-home-t4/t5/t8.jpg (day cards); Playwright: chess h2 top at 1947 px, 'Задание дня' at 1391 px
- **Principle:** Hick's law and focus: show the current step and a compact map, not the whole curriculum; progressive disclosure; 'a path, not a list' (Duolingo path, Khan Academy Kids).
- **Impact:** Important things (quest, chess) are 1.5-2.3 screens down; the page feels like a document, not a game; it is also costly on 4G with a mid-range Android phone.
- **Skeptic:** The page length is real: docH 7594 and ratio 9.1. All three weeks are fully rendered (week h2s at y=2195, 3801 and 5407), and chess h2 is at 1947. But the per-block figures are inflated. The habits card runs from y=708 to 1391, about 683 px (0.8 viewport), not 1.9. The Today card runs 1391 to 1947, about 556 px (0.66), not 1.5. The chess card runs 1947 to 2195, about 250 px (0.3), not 1. A day card is about 190-200 CSS px (rich-phone-home-t4.jpg shows about 505 px in the 2.63x image), not 680. A whole week takes about 1600 px. The conclusion 'long list, no map, weeks 2 and 3 expanded' stands, but it is a long scroll rather than a blocker. The primary CTA is at y=479, above the fold.

#### ONB-5 · minor · partly — Above the fold there is a heading to read, not a thing to do; the daily quest and chess sit far below the main CTA

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** The hero spends ~600 px of the first 839 px on the 4-line h1 'Математика — это место, где происходят интересные вещи' (a slogan) before the lesson card. The orange button appears at y~1250/2.6 = 480 CSS px, with 'Распечатать' (a parent action) as a same-size neighbour that wraps below it on phone. The 'Задание дня', which is the strongest return trigger, and the chess card are different 'next actions' competing with the hero: a child who has finished the lesson sees three 'what's next' blocks (hero, daily quest, chess) and no single answer. When the child finishes Day N, 'next' is simply Day N+1 of math; chess is never offered as the next step, though the quest asks for 'шахматное упражнение'.
- **Evidence:** HomeDashboard.tsx:63-65 (h1 text-3xl), :84-98 (CTA + print button); rich-phone-home-t1.jpg, kid7-phone-home-t1.jpg; TodayCard.tsx:41-45 asks to do a chess exercise but links go to a different place from the hero; audit-metrics 'phone /': aboveFoldInteractive 9
- **Principle:** One primary action per screen (Fogg: motivation + ability + prompt); the 'next best step' pattern of Khan Academy Kids / Duolingo; secondary actions must look secondary.
- **Impact:** Return visit has no single obvious 'what do I do now' for children who finished the day; the daily quest is not wired to the hero CTA.
- **Skeptic:** The h1 is 4 lines but only 150 CSS px tall (bottom at y=291), not about 600 px. The orange 'Начать' CTA is at y=479 with height 56, inside the first 839 px, so the hero does show a thing to do above the fold. Confirmed: 'Распечатать' is a same-size secondary button that wraps under the CTA at 412 px (rich1.png). Not confirmed: that the quest is not wired. The quest rows in TodayCard.tsx are Links to g.href, so each row goes straight to its target, including the chess exercise. The finding's TodayCard.tsx:41-45 is inaccurate (the file is in src/components/progress/). Whether the child sees 'three what's next blocks' is a design opinion.

#### ONB-6 · minor · partly — Section structure (math / chess / my tasks / parents) is not explained and the home is math-first while chess is half the product

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA, PARENT
- **Problem:** The site brand tagline 'математика · логика · шахматы' appears only on desktop (hidden sm:block). On phone the child sees 'Davlatjon' and three icons. The IA is: Home (math-first), Chess (/chess), 'Мои задачи' (/my-problems), 'Родителям' (/parent). 'Мои задачи' is ambiguous: it sounds like 'my assignments / homework' (what I must do) but is actually where the child invents their own problems; the quest also uses 'task' for different things. Chess has no icon in the hero and appears only as a card below. Awards, history and review pages are reached only from inside chess. There is no persistent 'home' / 'chess' tab-like structure on mobile.
- **Evidence:** SiteHeader.tsx:37-39 (tagline hidden on phone), :43-45 labels; HomeDashboard.tsx:181-183 (TodayCard, ChessHomeCard order), :63-65 (math-only heading); rich-phone-home-t1.jpg (no label visible for sections); richuz-phone-home-t1.jpg (Uzbek 'Masalalarim' also hidden)
- **Principle:** Clear information architecture and labelling (recognition over recall; Nielsen 'match between system and real world'); equal visual weight for equal importance; for a two-pillar product use a two-tab or 'world' switcher.
- **Impact:** Children and parents do not form a mental model of the product ('where do I go for chess?', 'where are my medals?'); 'Мои задачи' is easy to misread as an obligation.
- **Skeptic:** Confirmed in code and screenshots: the tagline is hidden on phone (SiteHeader.tsx:37 'hidden sm:block') and the nav labels are hidden (line 23). The home is math-first (h1, then the habits card). Not demonstrated: that 'Мои задачи' is misread as an obligation, or that awards, history and review are reachable only from chess (not checked in full). The label ambiguity is a subjective claim, and most of this overlaps ONB-3, ONB-5 and ONB-7.

#### ONB-7 · minor · partly — Chess is the lowest-priority card on home: a long scroll away, and a child who never scrolls never meets it

- **Who:** DILNOZA, AZIZ
- **Problem:** ChessHomeCard is a polished card but it comes after the hero, the habits card and the Today card, at ~1950 px on phone (2.3 viewports). It uses the 'Шахматная школа' name and says 'Твоё звание — «Пешка». Следующий уровень: «Конь»' for a user who solved 7 of 43 exercises; for a first-time user the card says 'Шесть званий: от Пешки до Короля.' which is a sentence a 7-year-old cannot parse. The card's own CTA is good, but nothing on top links to it except the 34 px grey knight.
- **Evidence:** ChessHomeCard.tsx:262-271 text; :279-284 CTA; rich-phone-home-t3.jpg (card appears after quest and level bar); Playwright: chess h2 at 1947 px
- **Principle:** Equal discoverability of the two main modes; visual hierarchy by value to the child (competitive older kids come for chess).
- **Impact:** Dilnoza's strongest motivator (rank, crowns, robot) is hidden; chess-first families get the impression that the app is only math.
- **Skeptic:** The position is confirmed: chess h2 'Шахматная школа' at y=1947, about 2.3 viewports down on phone, and the header ♞ is small and grey. The 'Шесть званий: от Пешки до Короля.' text really is the first-time branch (ChessHomeCard.tsx:48). But this largely duplicates ONB-4 and ONB-6. I could not verify '7 of 43 exercises'. The sentence-complexity claim is opinion.

#### ONB-8 · minor · confirmed — Reading load and tiny text on home: 63 text nodes under 14 px, long sentences with word-play

- **Who:** AZIZ
- **Problem:** The home has 63 visible text nodes at 12 px (phone) and 403 text nodes in total. Things at 12 px: 'Режим занятий: 6-8 лет · изменить', 'N из 8 задач', 'Звёзд дня: 0', the 'X / 150 XP' counter, the week 'впереди' badges, 'Каждый пройденный день добавляет новую привычку', stats. Habit names are 'Я перебираю по порядку', 'Я думаю шагами': abstract first-person strings that only mean something after a few days. The Aziz persona cannot decode '25 минут · привычка «Я замечаю»'. The lesson card meta line is 14 px and low contrast (white/80 on violet).
- **Evidence:** audit-metrics 'phone /': textUnder14 63, minFs {12: 63}; HomeDashboard.tsx:78-82, :112-117, :245-247; rich-phone-home-t1.jpg (meta line); rich-phone-home-t2.jpg (habit names)
- **Principle:** Reading level for 6-8 year-olds: short phrases, iconography first, minimum 16 px body (WCAG 1.4.4 and children's reading research); keep decorative or parent-facing info out of the child's primary view.
- **Impact:** Aziz skips these lines; parents receive the information only if they squint.
- **Skeptic:** audit-metrics 'phone /' reports textUnder14 = 63, minFs {12: 63} and textNodes 403. Seen in the screenshots: 12 px 'Режим занятий: 6–8 лет · изменить', the 'N из 8 задач' captions, and the habit names ('Я перебираю по порядку', 'Я думаю шагами') in fresh-phone-home-t2.jpg. The hero meta line is text-sm (14 px) in white/80 on violet. I did not measure its contrast ratio, but it looks acceptable in the screenshot. Impact on Aziz is plausible but unmeasured.

#### ONB-9 · minor · confirmed — 'около 25 минут' and 8-9 tasks per day vs. Aziz's ~10 minute attention; no short path through the day

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** The hero says '8 задач · около 25 минут' for every age profile, including the 6-8 profile (kid7-phone-home-t1.jpg shows the same text). The day then offers a full 8-9 task sequence with no 'short version' or chosen checkpoint. For the 7-year-old with hintPause on, the page should say 'начнём с 3 задач' (a 5-10 minute visit) and for parents it is a more honest session length. The quest asks for 3 different things in 3 different areas (puzzles, math task, chess exercise), which may exceed a short session as well.
- **Evidence:** HomeDashboard.tsx:78-82 (hard-coded 25 minutes); kid7-phone-home-t1.jpg vs rich-phone-home-t1.jpg (identical text; only 'Режим занятий' changes from 9-10 to 6-8); TodayCard.tsx:61-98 quest
- **Principle:** Session-length fit and 'chunking' by developmental stage (about 2-3 minutes per year of age in attention span heuristics); honest expectations build parent trust.
- **Impact:** Parents see an unrealistic expectation; Aziz meets the day as a long list instead of a small win.
- **Skeptic:** HomeDashboard.tsx has the hard-coded 'около 25 минут' / 'taxminan 25 daqiqa' in the hero meta line. kid7-phone-home-t1.jpg (age 7, 'Режим занятий: 6–8 лет') shows the same '8 задач · около 25 минут' text as the age 9 profile. The 25-minute figure is not age-adapted. The 10-minute attention span is a persona assumption, not a measurement.

#### ONB-10 · minor · confirmed — Returning/empty states: stats and quest read as '0' rows; habits card shows 21 greyed items before any win

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** On a fresh profile the home shows four stat tiles with zeros (HomeDashboard.tsx:273-287), a quest with three '⬜ 0/n' rows, 'Звёзд дня: 0.', a level bar and the habit card with 21 faded greyscale icons (the second and third weeks are visible as tiny dashed boxes). Zeros and empty slots are discouraging for a first-time child; they put the feeling of 'not yet' ahead of 'first step'. The quest copy does not say 'Первая звезда уже ждёт'. The 'Мои достижения' tiles say '0 решений объяснено', '0 других способов' which the child has not yet been told about.
- **Evidence:** HomeDashboard.tsx:121-178, :273-287; TodayCard.tsx:99-103 ('Звёзд дня: 0'); after-start-vp.png; fresh-phone-home-t2.jpg (habit grid and quest at 0/3)
- **Principle:** Positive empty states: show the first reward instead of zeros (Zeigarnik / endowed progress effect: start the bar at 1 step), avoid showing what is missing before something is achieved.
- **Impact:** Aziz's first home view is a screen of unfilled boxes; the endowed-progress opportunity is wasted.
- **Skeptic:** fresh-phone-home-t2.jpg shows 21 greyed habit icons (week 2 and week 3 rows are faded icons), and the quest rows at '0/3', '0/1'. The stat tiles use `hydrated ? stats.x : 0` (HomeDashboard.tsx about lines 273-287) and TodayCard prints 'Звёзд дня: 0.' This is a design observation, not a bug. The 'endowed progress' benefit is theoretical.

#### ONB-11 · minor · partly — Print, 'изменить' and week-print links sit in the child's path

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** Parent-oriented controls are placed at the same visual level as the child's CTA: 'Распечатать' as a secondary button of the same size beside 'Начать' (HomeDashboard.tsx:90-97), 'Режим занятий: ... изменить' link under the hero (:111-118) which opens parent settings (/parent/settings) behind a PIN, and a '🖨 Распечатать всю неделю' link at every week heading (:196-201). A 7-year-old taps the nearest big thing; 'Распечатать' wraps under the CTA on 412 px.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-home-t1.jpg: two stacked buttons of similar weight; HomeDashboard.tsx:84-98, :111-118, :196-201
- **Principle:** Separate audiences: keep adult functions out of the child's primary flow (children's product design principles; also helps COPPA-style expectations of a 'parent gate').
- **Impact:** Mis-taps, a PIN dialog or a print screen for a child who just wanted to start; the visual noise lowers the CTA's prominence.
- **Skeptic:** Confirmed: 'Распечатать' is a same-size secondary button under the CTA (rich1.png), the week-print link is in each week header (HomeDashboard.tsx about lines 196-201), and 'изменить' links to /parent/settings. Tested: on a device with no PIN yet, tapping 'изменить' or the 🔒 icon opens a 'create PIN' form (settings.png), not an existing PIN prompt, so the 'PIN dialog' claim is inaccurate for first-time users. The COPPA comment is rhetorical. The real risk is covered in the missed item below.

#### ONB-12 · polish · partly — Language switch is tiny, and the welcome switch does not carry the choice into the voice/heading flow clearly

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** RU/UZ in the header is 33x32 px with 12 px text (text-xs), two labels of 2 letters. In the welcome dialog the buttons are larger (Русский / Oʻzbekcha) which is good, but the header version (used on every later page) is the only way back. The parent who set Russian for the child by mistake has a tiny target. Uzbek mode needs a hidden-then-show cycle (i18n-wait class, layout.tsx:202-206) so the first paint can be blank for up to 1.5 s on slow 4G.
- **Evidence:** LangSwitch.tsx:19-37 (min-h-8, text-xs); Playwright: RU/UZ 33x32; layout.tsx:202-206 (i18n-wait, 1500 ms timeout)
- **Principle:** Touch target size and preventing flash of wrong content for bilingual UI.
- **Impact:** Minor friction; can matter on a slow network or for a child who toggles by accident.
- **Skeptic:** The RU/UZ buttons are 33x32 with 12 px text (LangSwitch.tsx:27 min-h-8, text-xs), confirmed. The welcome dialog does have larger language buttons (fresh1.png). The i18n-wait code exists (layout.tsx:42, globals.css:265 body opacity 0, 1500 ms cap), but it only applies when lang is uz, or on week/parent/my-problems pages with a child name. The 'blank up to 1.5 s on slow 4G' effect was not reproduced because localhost is fast, so it is a theoretical risk. The finding's line numbers for layout.tsx are not verified exactly.

**Missed by the auditor (found by the skeptic):**

- (major) First tap on the lock or 'изменить' lets a child create the parent PIN — On a device with no PIN, /parent and /parent/settings both open a 'Раздел для взрослых' screen that asks to create a new PIN and repeat it, with a big 'Сохранить' button (qa-nav/parent.png and settings.png). The 🔒 link is in the header on every page, and 'изменить' sits in the hero. A curious 7-year-old can set their own PIN first and lock the parent out. This also shows the answers and observations screen to anyone who sets the PIN. The first-run flow never asks a parent to set the PIN.
- (minor) Welcome dialog does not move focus or offer a way to skip or leave — On a fresh Pixel 7 load, document.activeElement is BODY (no autofocus on the name field) and Escape leaves the dialog open (count stays 1). There is no close button or skip. role=dialog with aria-modal is set, but the page behind still scrolls (body overflow: visible). With an 840 to 420 px viewport the CTA moves to y=637 (below the fold) after the name is typed.
- (polish) Welcome header emoji row wraps and wastes the first screen — In fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg the '🤖🧠✨' decoration wraps onto 2 lines (robot and brain on top, sparkles dropped below) beside the RU/Oʻzbekcha pills. It takes about 300 device px (about 115 CSS px) before the heading, which pushes the name field lower (y=680).
- (minor) Home hero 'Начать' CTA and quest show different next steps without a priority order — The hero CTA at y=479 leads to math Day N, and the TodayCard quest rows (y=1391+) link to a puzzle trainer, a math task and a chess exercise (TodayCard.tsx goal links). Nothing on the hero says that the quest exists. A child who taps only the orange button never meets the daily quest or the chess card (y=1947), both far below.

### Solutions

#### ONB-S1 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — Staged welcome: two short screens, age before name, a CTA that is always visible and never dead

- **Addresses:** ONB-1, ONB-2
- **Proposal:** Replace the single scrolling sheet in Welcome (HomeDashboard.tsx:339-450, ~584 chars, CTA at y=970 in an 839 px viewport) with a 2-step bottom sheet. STEP 1 'Hello' (about 90 characters total): robot 96 px, two language buttons 64 px high ('Русский' / "O'zbekcha"), one 64 px round speaker button, and two icon chips showing the two worlds (🔢 Math and ♞ Chess), so chess is announced from second one. The first tap on a language button is a user gesture, so after it we play the short greeting clip once (autoplay-safe), with a visible stop control. CTA 'Дальше' is pinned to the bottom of the sheet. STEP 2 'About you' fits one phone screen with no scroll: legend 'Сколько тебе лет?', then ages 6..15+ as a 5x2 grid of 56 px buttons (was 44 px chips), then the name field (optional), then the sticky CTA. Age goes BEFORE name on purpose: ages are taps, and the keyboard only opens for the last field, so it can never hide the age row or the button. The CTA stays enabled (aria-disabled instead of disabled). If age is missing, a permanent 14 px line sits above it ('Осталось выбрать возраст'), and tapping the CTA pulses the age legend, moves focus to the first age button and the live region reads the same line. A name is optional: empty name falls back to the neutral 'Друг' / "Do'st" that nameFor() already returns, and the existing ChildNameBanner invites the child to name themselves later. A 44 px 'Пропустить' text link in the top corner sets welcomed=true with no age (age.ts already treats 'no age' as the junior profile) and Escape triggers the same path. The three rules leave the dialog (see ONB-S2). The ChildNameField live greeting 'Привет, Азиз!' stays, as it is the best moment of the current flow.
- **Revised after review:** Keep the 2-step sheet (step 1: 64 px language buttons, robot, 'Привет!', two non-tappable chips Math and Chess, 'Дальше'; step 2: age 5x2 grid of 56 px with check glyph on the selected one, then optional name, then a pinned CTA). Changes: (a) Add `interactiveWidget: 'resizes-content'` to the viewport export in layout.tsx and test on a real Android device or BrowserStack, not with a visualViewport stub. Make the name input the last field and call scrollIntoView on focus. (b) No autoplay. Keep the 64 px speaker button, tap-to-play with a stop state, and record new RU and UZ clips of about 10 words that match the new screen. (c) CTA uses aria-disabled. With no age, tap moves focus to the first age button and pulses it once. The 14 px hint is secondary, because Aziz will not read it. (d) 'Пропустить' is a 44 px link and Escape does the same. After a skip with no age, show a small dismissible parent-addressed line on /parent, not in the child's flow. (e) On finish, call updateSettings({age, bigText: age<=8}) so the 6-8 text size comes for free (see S7). (f) Add a 'show welcome again' action in /parent/settings (needs setWelcomed(false), which does not exist). (g) Update e2e/smoke.spec.ts:362-374, which asserts the disabled button.
- **UI spec:** Container: fixed inset-0, on phone align items-end (bottom sheet), rounded-t-[2rem], max-h-[100dvh], inner scroll area + footer sticky bottom-0 with bg-white, pt-3, pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))], shadow upward. Step dots (2) top centre, 8 px, not interactive. Step 1 layout, top to bottom: language buttons row (h-16, text-lg, gap-3, aria-pressed), robot SVG 96 px with a 600 ms wave on mount (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion), H2 text-2xl 'Привет! Давай знакомиться' on max 2 lines, speaker button 64 px circle with animated 3-bar wave while playing, chip row (🔢 Задачи, ♞ Шахматы; 48 px high, text-base, not tappable, role=img with label). Step 2: H2 text-2xl 'Сколько тебе лет?', age grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 each button h-14 text-xl font-black; selected state = brand fill + check mark glyph (not colour only). Under it one 14 px line 'Режим: 6-8 лет' (from PROFILES[...].ages) and NOT the long 'about' paragraph (profile.about moves to /parent/settings). Name field h-14 with label 'Как тебя зовут? (можно пропустить)'. CTA lg h-14 w-full sun variant. Motion: step change = 200 ms slide, CTA micro-pop on age select; no confetti. Sound: only the user-initiated greeting; a soft 'tick' (sfx.ts) on age select if sound is on. States: age missing (hint line + pulse on tap), keyboard open (sheet uses dvh so the CTA stays above the keyboard; name input calls scrollIntoView({block:'center'})), reduced motion (no wave/pulse, only outline), Uzbek (labels must fit 412 px: 'Necha yoshdasan?' is short).
- **Files:** src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/ChildNameField.tsx, src/lib/voice.ts, src/lib/store.ts, src/components/ui.tsx, src/app/globals.css
- **Inspired by:** NN/g kids research (long instructions go unread, 2x2 cm targets, tap over type); Duolingo/Khan Academy Kids 'experience before forms'; Nielsen 'visibility of system status' (never silently disable the primary button); Fogg (ability + prompt).
- **Guardrails:** No countdown, no 'only today', no sad robot if the child skips. Skip and Next have equal size and tone (no confirm-shaming). Ask only name (optional, nickname allowed) and age; never surname, city or photo. Say why age is asked in one short parent-readable line in /parent, not in the child flow. Audio plays only after a tap and has a stop control; respect settings.sound. The welcome must be re-openable from /parent/settings so a parent can redo it.
- **Test plan:** Playwright Pixel 7 (412x839), fresh profile: (1) on step 2 the CTA bounding box bottom <= viewport with NO scroll, also with visualViewport height 520 (keyboard emulation); (2) taps from launch to home <= 4 (language, Next, age, Go) and measure time-to-home; (3) CTA has no disabled attribute, aria-disabled='true' while age is empty, and a tap with empty age moves focus to the first age button; (4) Skip and Escape both set welcomed=true and leave settings.age undefined, home still renders the junior profile; (5) visible text in step 1 <= 120 characters; every target >= 56 px; (6) RU and UZ screenshots, no overflow; (7) greeting clip starts after the language tap only, never on load. Hallway test with 3 children aged 6-8 and no adult help: success rate to home, and where they hesitate.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. Right diagnosis, verified live: welcome text is 584 chars, dialog 969 px tall in an 839 px viewport, CTA at y=942 and disabled, age chips are 41 px (not 44), Escape leaves the dialog open. Age before name, a never-dead CTA, a Skip link and a 56 px age grid are all sound. Three defects. (1) Keyboard: the plan relies on dvh and a sticky footer to stay above the keyboard, but layout.tsx:25-29 sets no interactive-widget. Chrome Android 108+ defaults to resizes-visual, so the keyboard does not shrink dvh or the fixed sheet and the CTA is hidden. The visualViewport=520 test does not reproduce that. Age-first helps, but the name field and CTA would still be covered. (2) Auto-playing the greeting after the language tap contradicts the app's own no-autoplay rule (restated in S7) and surprises a child on a parent's phone in public. The current public/audio/welcome.mp3 narrates the old rules text, so it needs a new RU and UZ recording anyway. (3) Skip with no age silently gives an 11-year-old the junior profile and nothing in the child's path corrects it.

#### ONB-S2 · drop · effort M · impact 3 — Teach the three Lab rules in context with a 5-second robot tip, not in the welcome

- **Addresses:** ONB-2
- **Proposal:** Delete the three rules from the Welcome. Re-deliver each exactly when it is useful, as a small non-blocking RobotTip bubble (robot face 40 px + at most 8 words + speaker + 'Понятно'): Rule 1 'Не торопись' appears the first time task 1 opens ('Не спеши. Думать — самое главное.'). Rule 2 'Подсказки по одной' appears the first time a HintLadder is shown on tasks 1-3, anchored next to the 💡 button ('Трудно? Нажми 💡. Подсказки открываются по одной.'). Rule 3 'Объясни' appears after the first solved task inside AfterSolve ('Получилось? Расскажи маме или папе, как думал(а)' is gendered, so use: 'Получилось! Расскажи взрослому, как ты думаешь.'). Each tip is shown at most twice per rule (counter in settings.tips, e.g. {slow:1,hint:2,explain:0}), never during the first 3 seconds of a task so it does not fight the narration, and it never blocks input. This delivers the owner's pedagogy to a non-reader at the moment it can be acted on, and frees the welcome from reading load. Also, step 1 of the welcome shows the 🔢 + ♞ chips so chess is no longer invisible at first launch.
- **UI spec:** RobotTip: absolute/inline bubble under the task title (or above the hint button for rule 2), bg-brand-soft, border-2 border-brand/30, rounded-2xl, text-base font-bold, max 2 lines, left robot 40 px. Buttons: speaker 44x44 (plays a recorded clip if exists, otherwise hidden) and 'Понятно' 48 px high. Appear: fade+rise 200 ms, auto-hide after 12 s or on first interaction with the task. Reduced motion: no animation. No sound by itself. State 'seen' counters persist in settings.tips; parent can reset via 'Показать приветствие заново'.
- **Files:** src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/components/task/HintLadder.tsx, src/components/task/AfterSolve.tsx, src/components/task/RobotTip.tsx (new), src/lib/state.ts, src/lib/store.ts, src/lib/voice.ts
- **Inspired by:** Just-in-time teaching (Duolingo, Khan Academy Kids first activity before questions); Desmos 'short expository screens'; Hattie and Timperley feedback model (tell the next step at the moment of need).
- **Guardrails:** Tips teach process (think, use hints, explain), never praise ability and never mention speed. No guilt if ignored; counters stop the tip after 2 views so it never nags. Dismiss is as big as the tip. Tips must not delay or hide the answer field or the hint button.
- **Test plan:** Unit: tips counter increments and caps at 2 per rule; migration keeps old state valid (sanitize in state.ts). E2E: first open of week/1/day/1#task-1 shows tip 1, reload shows it once more, third open shows none. HintLadder tip never appears when hintPause is off and ladder is hidden. Measure with 5 children: share who open a hint within the first task before vs after (hint use is a process behaviour, not a score); no increase in time-to-first-answer beyond 3 s.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit False, manipulation risk low. The in-context rules already exist. HintLadder.tsx shows 'Застрял? Подсказки открываются по одной…' above the button when opened===0 and enforces the 15 s pause. AfterSolve.tsx already prompts 'Отметь, что получилось' with 'Я объяснил решение' and 'Я нашёл другой способ'. Task 1 already says 'Сначала посчитай так, как тебе удобно' (kid7-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg). A fourth bubble adds clutter and text on top of the answer field for Aziz. 'Не спеши' on open is generic: it scolds a child who has not yet done anything, and it contradicts the proposal's own guardrail 'never mention speed'. 'Расскажи взрослому' assumes an adult is present. It needs 3 x 2 new recordings, otherwise it is text-only, which is the wrong modality for Aziz. It also needs a new settings.tips field with sanitize in state.ts:282, a merge rule in sync.ts, and survives reset. The only valuable part, taking the three rules out of the welcome and announcing chess, is already in S1.

#### ONB-S3 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — Phone bottom tab bar with words: Math / Chess / Invent, parent lock moved out of the child's row

- **Addresses:** ONB-3, ONB-6, ONB-7, ONB-11, ONB-12
- **Proposal:** On screens below sm, remove the icon-only cluster from the sticky header (SiteHeader.tsx:42-46: 36x34 / 42x34 targets, gap-1) and show a fixed bottom tab bar with three labelled tabs, each at least 64 px tall: 'Математика', 'Шахматы', 'Придумай'. 'Мои задачи' is renamed to 'Придумай' / "O'ylab top" because today it reads like homework, while the page is where the child invents their own problems (ONB-6). The chess tab gets a coloured icon (♞ inside a 36 px amber circle) instead of the grey text glyph, so chess has equal visual weight with math (ONB-7). The header on phone keeps only logo + language switch. The 🔒 parent entry leaves the child's primary row: on phone it becomes a 48 px text link '🔒 Родителям' at the end of the home page and in the footer (SiteFooter), and stays in the header from sm up. This keeps adult controls away from small fingers while a parent can still find it (the welcome step 1 does not mention it, /parent is also reachable from print pages). The tab bar is hidden in focus routes (day sessions /week/_/day/_, a game in /chess/play, a lesson or puzzle in progress), where the child has a dedicated back arrow and a sticky 'Дальше' bar.
- **Revised after review:** Phone only (<sm): fixed bottom bar, wrapped in a <nav aria-label='Разделы'> so the e2e selector keeps working, 3 tabs min 64 px high: '🏠 Главная' / 'Bosh sahifa' (or the hub label of your choice), '♞ Шахматы' in a coloured 36 px amber circle, '✍️ Придумай' / "O'ylab top" (rename the page h1, title and DayFinish link in the same change). Show it only on exact paths '/', '/chess', '/my-problems' via usePathname. Subpages keep the header plus a 48 px back arrow. Header on phone = logo + language switch. Parent: a 48 px text link '🔒 Родителям' in SiteFooter and at the end of home; keep it in the header from sm up. Add bottom padding in SiteFooter and lift XpToast above the bar. No badges, no counters, no animation.
- **UI spec:** BottomNav: fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 sm:hidden, h-16 + env(safe-area-inset-bottom), bg-paper/95 backdrop-blur, border-t. 3 equal tabs (flex-1), each a Link min-h-16 with icon 28 px over a 14 px font-extrabold label (no 12 px text). Active tab: bg-brand-soft rounded-2xl inset 4 px, text-brand-dark, aria-current='page', plus a 3 px top indicator (not colour only). Tab labels: RU 'Математика / Шахматы / Придумай'; UZ 'Matematika / Shaxmat / O'ylab top'. Tap feedback: scale 0.96 for 80 ms. Main content gets pb-[calc(4rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] sm:pb-0 (put it in SiteFooter's spacer so each page does not change). Hidden on print (no-print). States: reduced motion (no scale), long Uzbek label wraps never (max 11 chars chosen), landscape phone (h-14). On sm and up the existing header links stay with labels.
- **Files:** src/components/SiteHeader.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/app/page.tsx, src/app/chess/page.tsx, src/app/my-problems/page.tsx, src/components/MyProblems.tsx
- **Inspired by:** NN/g (recognition over recall, 2x2 cm targets, icon plus word); Khan Academy Kids / Duolingo bottom tab navigation; Sesame Workshop touch research (bottom-edge dead zone handled by safe-area padding).
- **Guardrails:** The bar has no badges, no red dots, no 'you have N things to do' counters, no animation to attract taps. The parent area stays behind its PIN and is deliberately low-prominence, not hidden. Do not add a shop or any external link to the bar.
- **Test plan:** Playwright Pixel 7 on /, /chess, /my-problems: tab bar present, each tab >= 64x96 CSS px, label font >= 14 px, no horizontal overflow; header interactive count on / drops; audit-metrics 'phone /' small44 drops from 10 to <= 3 and tiny32 from 1 to 0. Focus routes (/week/1/day/1, /chess/play) show no tab bar. Check iOS-like safe area with env() emulation. Usability: ask 5 children 'where is chess?' and 'where do I invent my own problem?' and measure time and wrong-tab taps vs the old header; ask 5 parents to find the parent area.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Evidence is solid: audit-metrics 'phone /' small44=10, smallSamples show ♞ 36x34, ✍️ 42x34, 🔒 42x34, and icon-only labels. A labelled bottom tab bar is the right pattern and equal weight for chess is needed. Problems: (1) 'Математика' as the label for '/' is wrong, because home holds the daily quest, a chess card and (after S5) a chess next-step, so the tab contradicts the page. (2) SiteHeader is rendered on every chess subpage (play, puzzles, lessons, review, secrets and more), so the 'hide in focus routes' rule needs a route allowlist, not component state; /chess/play and puzzle boards are full-screen tasks where 64 px plus safe area (about 9% of 839 px) hurts. (3) XpToast sits at fixed right-4 bottom-4 (XpToast.tsx:38) and will sit under the bar. (4) The rename must also change the page h1 (MyProblems.tsx:47), the title and DayFinish.tsx:115 ('Запиши её в «Мои задачи»'), and e2e/smoke.spec.ts:379 uses the nav named 'Разделы'. (5) Parent link moves to the bottom of home, which is only reachable after the S4 shortening.

#### ONB-S4 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — Short home: a compact path, the current week open, the rest collapsed, habits merged into the days

- **Addresses:** ONB-4, ONB-10, ONB-8
- **Proposal:** Cut home from 9.1 viewports (7594 px) to about 3. Order: hero (ONB-S5), daily quest (TodayCard), slim chess card (ONB-S9), then 'Мой путь'. 'Мой путь' is a 3-row map of stations (one row per week, 7 round stations of 44-48 px, each with the day's emoji, ring = status: done = filled with check, current = pulsing ring, later = neutral outline; no padlocks, because every day is openable). Under the map only the CURRENT week is expanded as 7 compact day rows (about 64 px each: emoji 40 px, one-line title with line-clamp-1, 8 tiny task dots, 'сегодня' badge). Other weeks are an accordion row (48 px+) 'Неделя 2 · 0 из 7 дней' with a chevron and the line 'Любой день можно открыть' so Dilnoza knows she can jump ahead. The 'Мои привычки мыслителя' card is removed as a separate 7-item dashed list: each completed day row shows its habit sticker (earned stickers only, no ghost future list); a collapsed '<details>' 'Мои привычки' lists earned ones with their names. The four stat tiles move into a collapsed 'Мои успехи' block that appears only after the first solved task. Print week links move to /parent and the print screen, not on the child's week headings.
- **Revised after review:** Do not build a separate station map. Use an accordion per week with the current week open: header row min-h-12 shows 'Неделя 2' plus 7 small non-interactive status dots (this gives the visible finish line cheaply) and a chevron. Open week = 7 compact day rows (min-h-16, 40 px emoji tile, 1-line title, 8 task dots hidden on junior, status icon check / play / empty circle; done = soft green left border, no strike-through). No padlocks, no 'впереди' badge. No pulsing. Remove the habits card and show the habit sticker on completed rows only, with a collapsed 'Мои привычки' details for earned ones. Move the four stat tiles into a collapsed block that renders only after the first solved task, but keep a visible link to /my-problems elsewhere (the 'своих задач' tile is currently a discovery path; S3 now covers it). Remove week print links from the child list (parent already has print in ParentDashboard.tsx:141). Seniors (11+): all weeks open by default. Order: hero, quest, chess card, path.
- **UI spec:** Station map: grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5 inside a Card; each station is a Link 44-48 px square (aria-label 'Неделя 1, день 3, готово'), ring-2; current station scale-105 and a 2 s slow pulse (stopped under reduced motion). Week accordion header: button min-h-12, text-base font-black, chevron 24 px, aria-expanded. Current-week day rows: min-h-16 Link, left 40 px emoji tile, middle title (text-base, 1 line) + dots row, right status icon (✓ / ▶ / empty circle) 28 px. Done rows get a soft green left border, not strike-through. Replace 12 px meta lines by 14 px min. Mobile only: sm:grid for stats stays. Skeleton while hydrating: 3 grey rows of equal height to avoid layout shift. For age >= 11 (senior profile) keep all three weeks expanded by default as an option.
- **Files:** src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/home/WeekMap.tsx (new), src/components/home/WeekAccordion.tsx (new), src/content/summary.ts
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo path / Mathseeds world map; Hick's law and progressive disclosure; Math Academy 'visible finish line'; NN/g (kids avoid scrolling).
- **Guardrails:** Neutral treatment of skipped days (no red, no 'пропущено'); weeks 2-3 are never locked or labelled 'ещё не твой уровень'. No completion percentage shown as a debt ('осталось 80%'); show what is done, not what is left. Map has no streak flames or loss framing.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: docH of phone / for the rich scenario <= 3.2 viewports (was 9.1); chess card top <= 1.3 viewports; interactive count above the fold <= 8; every station/row target >= 44 px; hOverflow false; noName 0 (stations have aria-labels). Stats tiles absent on a fresh profile. Check 4G profile: DOM nodes and JS unchanged or lower. Task: 'open day 3 of week 2' for Dilnoza, count taps (target <= 3) and time.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. The core is right: rich phone home is 7594 px (9.1 viewports), and the habits card is a 1:1 duplicate of the 21 days (HomeDashboard.tsx:119-178 renders habit per day). Progressive disclosure, the current week open and the others collapsed, and hiding zero stat tiles on a fresh profile are all supported by evidence. Weaknesses: the 7x3 station map duplicates the expanded current-week rows right below it (two representations of week 1). Stations also do not fit the claim: Card padding p-4 on a 412 px screen gives about 44.1 px per cell with gap-1.5, so every cell is exactly on the 44 px limit and any padding change breaks it. The idle 2 s pulsing ring is an attention-grabbing animation that S3's own guardrail forbids. 'Любой день можно открыть' is more text for Aziz. The Hallway claim 'chess card top <= 1.3 viewports' only holds with S5, so the three solutions overlap (S4, S5, S8 all rewrite the quest and stats).

#### ONB-S5 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — One 'Next step' hero: drop the slogan, wire it to the daily quest, take adult controls out of the child's path

- **Addresses:** ONB-5, ONB-9, ONB-11, ONB-6
- **Proposal:** Rebuild the hero (HomeDashboard.tsx:56-107). Remove the 4-line slogan h1 (keep it as an sr-only h1 for SEO and screen readers; the 600 px it used goes away). The card is: greeting line 'Привет, Анна! 👋' (text-xl), then ONE big next-step card, then the 3 quest circles directly under it. A new pure function nextStep(state, ageProfile) in src/lib/nextStep.ts decides the single action: (1) a started, unfinished day or part -> 'Продолжим: задача 4'; (2) nothing done today -> next math part (day); (3) math part done and the daily quest still has an open chess/puzzle item -> a chess card 'Шахматная минутка ♞' that links to the same place the quest link goes (TodayCard.tsx:80-94), so hero and quest never disagree; (4) all three quest items done -> a calm rest card 'На сегодня всё! ⭐' with two equal buttons 'Ещё одну' and 'До завтра'. The hero shows real session length (see ONB-S6): '🧩 3 задачи · ⏱ 8 минут' for the junior profile instead of the hard-coded 'около 25 минут', and the habit name leaves the meta line (it is shown on the day intro as an icon). Parent actions leave the hero: 'Распечатать' moves to DayIntro/the print route and /parent; 'Режим занятий ... изменить' moves to /parent/settings (it already requires the PIN, so a child tapping it hits a gate for nothing). The CTA is full-width h-16 sun button with the label 'Начать ▶' / 'Продолжить ▶'.
- **Revised after review:** Hero = greeting (text-xl) + one next-step card + full-width h-16 CTA 'Начать ▶ / Продолжить ▶', slogan reduced to sr-only h1, no print or 'изменить'. nextStep(state, profile) in src/lib/nextStep.ts: (1) unfinished day -> continue (resume at the first unsolved task); (2) nothing done today -> next day; (3) a math task is done and the chess exercise or puzzle quest item is open -> chess card whose href is the deep link to the next unsolved exercise, not '/chess'; hide ChessHomeCard when the hero is already the chess step; (4) all quest items done -> calm rest card with two equal buttons: 'Ещё задача' (next math task) and 'До завтра'. Replace the TodayCard goal list with the 3 circles (partial ring for the 3-puzzle goal) in the hero and keep only XP, streak, week in TodayCard. No idle CTA animation. Show task count (icons), not minutes, until S6 measures real pace. Unit-test that hero href equals the matching quest href.
- **UI spec:** Hero card (violet gradient kept, it works): padding 20 px on phone. Row 1: robot 48 px + greeting. Row 2 card (rounded-3xl bg-white/12): 48 px emoji tile + title text-2xl font-black max 2 lines ('День 1. Смотри внимательно'), meta line 15 px with icons (no habit text). CTA: ButtonLink variant sun, size xl (new: min-h-16 text-xl), w-full. Below the card: quest row = 3 circles 64 px (✓ filled / open), tappable, labels 14 px under each ('Математика', 'Шахматы', 'Задачки') - same links as TodayCard. States: hydrating = skeleton card of the same height; completed-everything = rest card; chess-next = card uses amber tint and ♞ tile. Motion: CTA idle gentle 1.5 px float every 4 s (off under reduced motion, stops after 3 loops). No sound. The speaker 56 px pill 'Послушать' appears only when a clip for the day title exists.
- **Files:** src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/lib/nextStep.ts (new), src/lib/quest.ts, src/components/progress/TodayCard.tsx, src/components/session/DayIntro.tsx, src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx, src/components/ui.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Khan Academy Kids and Duolingo 'next best step'; Fogg (prompt + ability); Hick's law; NN/g one obvious next step per screen; ICO children's code (separate adult functions, natural stopping point).
- **Guardrails:** The rest card is a calm natural stopping point, never a gate: 'Ещё одну' is as large as 'До завтра' and neither is guilt-framed. The hero never shows what the child 'still owes'. The quest stays a suggestion and does not expire (no clocks). Chess is offered as next step only when the child has not just been doing it, to avoid pushing sessions longer. Do not reward speed or time spent.
- **Test plan:** Unit tests for nextStep() over a table of states (fresh, mid-day, math done, quest done, all days done, junior vs senior) incl. that hero href equals the matching quest link. Playwright Pixel 7 rich and kid7: the orange CTA top <= 420 CSS px (was ~480) and exactly one primary CTA in the first viewport; no 'Распечатать' or 'изменить' on home; no text node < 14 px in the hero. Metrics: aboveFoldInteractive on phone / <= 6 (was 9). Hallway test: 5 children return-visit, ask 'what do you do now?' and time to first tap.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. Best value-per-effort on home. The 4-line slogan costs about 500 px (kid7-phone-home-t1.jpg: CTA at y~1330/2.63 = 505 px), 'Распечатать' wraps under 'Начать' at 412 px, and the 'Режим занятий … изменить' line opens a PIN gate for a child (HomeDashboard.tsx:111-118). Removing these is correct; robots are noindex (layout.tsx:20) so the SEO justification for sr-only h1 is moot, though an h1 is still needed for screen readers. Corrections: (1) Quest links are not all useful: the 'task' goal href is '/' (quest.ts:56, i.e. home itself) and the exercise goal href is '/chess', a 7.5-viewport hub. 'Hero and quest never disagree' would link a child to the wrong place; the chess next step must deep-link to chessLevelHref(nextLevel), as ChessHomeCard already does. (2) Quest circles in the hero duplicate TodayCard's goal list that stays below; S8 also redraws it. Make one component. (3) The rest card's 'Ещё одну' is undefined (another task? day? puzzle?). (4) Print is already in the DaySession header (DaySession.tsx:60), so no need to move it into DayIntro. (5) A CTA idle float every 4 s is an attention hook that contradicts the guardrails. (6) '8 минут' depends on S6 and on invented pace data.

#### ONB-S6 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — Short parts for the junior profile: 'Часть 1 из 3', honest minutes, and a calm rest card

- **Addresses:** ONB-9, ONB-5
- **Proposal:** For ageProfile junior (6-8) split every day into parts of 3 tasks (8 tasks -> 3 + 3 + 2). The day session keeps the existing hash steps (#task-N) but after task 3 and task 6 shows a RestStop card instead of auto-advancing: robot waving, 'Часть 1 из 3 готова!', two EQUAL buttons: '🛋 Отдохнуть' (saves, returns home; hero then reads 'Продолжим с задачи 4') and '▶ Ещё 3 задачи'. Middle/senior profiles skip the card and keep the full day. Everywhere minutes are shown, compute them from the real part (about 2.5 minutes per task) instead of the hard-coded 25 (HomeDashboard.tsx:79-80), so a parent reads '8 минут' for part 1 and the honest total for the day. The parent also sees the same unit in /parent (parts done today). Stopping after a part still counts for the daily quest 'math task' and for the weekly goal, so stopping early never costs anything. There is no auto-start of the next task, and an optional soft break line after ~15 minutes of continuous play: 'Давай потянемся!' with a single 'Хорошо' button.
- **Revised after review:** Junior only (age 6-8 or no age): after tasks 3 and 6 the 'Дальше' bar opens a RestStop screen with robot, text 'Передышка' (no 'X из 3', no counts of what is left), and two identical 'soft' buttons h-14: '🛋 Отдохнуть' (go home; hero then shows 'Продолжим' and resumes at the first unsolved task) and '▶ Ещё' (next task). No stars, no chime, no looping animation. Part size 3/4/full day configurable in /parent/settings. Replace the minutes line with the task count (icons); show minutes only in /parent and only from the child's own median task time (startedAt to solvedAt) once there are 10+ samples. Drop the 15-minute stretch prompt. Add the resume-at-first-unsolved-task fix, which benefits every age.
- **UI spec:** RestStop: full-width card in the task column, robot 80 px with 'wave' then 'idle', title text-2xl, subtitle one line 15 px ('Ты решил(а)...' is gendered, so: 'Три задачи позади!'), buttons stacked on phone, each h-14 w-full, same variant weight (primary for 'Отдохнуть' on junior is a judgement call: use two 'soft' buttons of identical size so neither dominates). 1.5 s celebration (3 stars pop), non-looping; tap anywhere skips it. A thin 3-segment 'parts' bar replaces nothing in the existing task-strip, it is shown only above the strip on junior. Sound: one soft chime (sfx.ts) if sound on; muted otherwise.
- **Files:** src/components/session/DaySession.tsx, src/components/session/RestStop.tsx (new), src/components/session/DayFinish.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/lib/age.ts, src/lib/nextStep.ts (new), src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Round-based sessions with a natural stop (Duolingo rounds, Lingokids); ICO Standard 13 (pause and save, break nudges); Math Academy 'minimal doses'; developmental attention span for 6-8 (about 10 minutes, from the persona).
- **Guardrails:** Break is encouraged but never forced: 'Ещё 3 задачи' is always one tap and equal in size. No lock-out timer, no 'you must rest', no streak or XP bonus for continuing, and no penalty for stopping. Do not describe stopping as 'quitting'. Parent can set the part size (3 / 4 / full day) in /parent/settings.
- **Test plan:** Unit: part boundaries for 8 and 9 task days; resuming from hash after Rest returns to task 4; quest 'task' goal counts after part 1. E2E for kid7 scenario: RestStop appears after task 3 and 6 only for age <= 8; senior sees none. Check home meta line says minutes derived from the part, not 25. Observe 5 children aged 6-8: share who chooses 'Отдохнуть' vs 'Ещё' (neutral, not a KPI to push), and who finishes a full day in one sitting before vs after.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. The problem is real: hard-coded 'около 25 минут' for 6-8 (HomeDashboard.tsx:79-80) is dishonest to a child with about 10 minutes of attention, and a stopping point after 3 tasks is developmentally sound (ICO natural stopping points, short rounds). But: (1) '2.5 min per task' is invented; there is no measured pace in state and DayIntro.tsx:57 already says 'Около 20–30 минут. Не обязательно решить всё'. Fake precision for parents is worse than none. (2) Stopping already costs nothing: quest 'task' needs 1 solved task, weekly goal counts activity days, and the day header ← is always there; the real gap is that Home 'Продолжить' reopens the day intro, not task 4. (3) The RestStop headline 'Часть 1 из 3 готова' frames 2 parts remaining as owed work, and it fires on step 3 even if the child skipped tasks 1-3 with 'Дальше', so the text can be false. (4) 'Давай потянемся' after 15 min is a timer nag on top of a child's task and adds clock logic for little gain. (5) 3 stars + chime for continuing is a reward for session length.

#### ONB-S7 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — Junior reading profile: 16-18 px floor, bigText on by default for 6-8, large speaker button, no abstract habit strings on the child's screens

- **Addresses:** ONB-8
- **Proposal:** Make the 6-8 profile genuinely different, not only in task difficulty. (1) Expose the age profile on <html data-profile='junior|middle|senior'> from LangSync (LangSwitch.tsx:41-52). In globals.css, for junior: body text 18 px, and any text smaller than 14 px (Tailwind text-xs, 63 nodes on home) is lifted to 14 px with a blunt override scoped away from the board and the print views. (2) settings.bigText becomes tri-state (boolean | undefined): undefined means 'follow the age' (on for age <= 8), true/false is an explicit parent choice (state.ts:60, 227, 284; SettingsPanel.tsx:96). DaySession already honours big-text, extend the class to the home and the chess hub. (3) ListenButton gets size='lg': a 56 px pill with a speaker icon and the word, animated 3-bar wave while playing, a stop toggle; use it as the FIRST control in the task card and the day intro for junior (today it is a small chip beside 'Задача 1 из 8'). (4) On child-facing home, habit names ('Я перебираю по порядку', 'Я думаю шагами') and the lesson meta line are replaced by an emoji + at most 3 words; the full habit text lives in DayIntro, where the grown-up reads it. (5) Lesson-card meta text uses full white (not white/80) for contrast.
- **Revised after review:** (1) Raise the global minimum of small text to 14 px (change the few .text-xs usages and meta lines, not a CSS override), all ages; 10 px text on /chess is the worst. (2) ListenButton size='lg' (h-14 pill with icon and label, 3-bar wave while playing, 'Стоп', and a 'Нажми ещё раз' blocked state when play() rejects), first control in the task card and DayIntro for everybody who has a clip; keep tap-to-play and no autoplay. (3) At onboarding, write bigText: age<=8 explicitly (no tri-state, no migration). (4) Meta text on violet from white/80 to white/95. Skip data-profile and --tap-min unless a second feature needs them.
- **UI spec:** CSS: html[data-profile='junior'] { --fs-body: 1.125rem; } .text-xs, .text-sm get min 0.875rem/1rem there; line-height 1.5, left aligned, no justified text. ListenButton lg: h-14 min-w-36 rounded-full px-5, icon 24 px, label 16 px bold, states idle / loading (spinner, aria-busy) / playing (wave + 'Стоп') / blocked ('Нажми ещё раз', when audio is rejected by the browser, so it never fails silently). Keep NO auto-play on task open: tap-to-play only, the same rule as today. Contrast: ensure >= 4.5:1 for meta text on violet (switch white/80 to white/95).
- **Files:** src/components/ListenButton.tsx, src/components/LangSwitch.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/lib/state.ts, src/lib/age.ts, src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/task/TaskView.tsx
- **Inspired by:** NN/g (children skip long text, separate 6-8 and 9-12 designs); Cognitive load / Mayer modality principle; Duolingo ABC and Epic read-to-me; Khan Academy Kids voice-first.
- **Guardrails:** Audio is never auto-played on a shared parent phone, respects settings.sound, and always has a visible stop. Do not call the app 'dyslexia-friendly'; use size, spacing and audio, not a special font. Do not shame readers: no 'read it yourself' prompts.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: for junior profile audit-metrics textUnder14 on phone / drops from 63 to <= 5 and on /chess from 73 to <= 10; computed body font-size 18 px; explicit bigText=false by parent overrides the default. ListenButton lg measured >= 56 px high and first in DOM order of the task card; blocked-audio state shown when play() rejects (stub). Visual regression for RU and UZ at 412 px (Uzbek strings are longer: no truncation). Usability: 5 slow readers, count how many use the speaker unprompted.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Two parts are strong: a 56 px labelled ListenButton and fixing 12 px text. Measured: ListenButton is a 36 px chip squeezed beside 'Задача 1 из 8' (kid7-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg), min-h-9 at ListenButton.tsx:31, and audio is the primary modality for Aziz. 'Blocked' state for rejected play() is a good detail. Metrics: textUnder14 = 63 on phone '/' and 73 on '/chess' (plus 16 nodes at 10 px on chess). The rest is over-built. A data-profile attribute set by LangSync only after hydration would cause a visible size jump unless the head script also sets it. An 18 px body is unnecessary: task text is already large. Tri-state bigText touches state.ts:60,227,284, sync merge and SettingsPanel for a small gain. Item 4 (habit text off the home) is already done by S4/S5. Floor-lifting only for junior leaves Dilnoza and parents with 12 px on the same nodes, which is a general readability defect, not an age feature. A blunt .text-xs override across the app can break fixed-height chips.

#### ONB-S8 · modify · effort S · impact 3 — Positive empty states: no zero-tiles, a ghost first star, only true progress

- **Addresses:** ONB-10
- **Proposal:** On a profile with nothing done: hide the four stat tiles (HomeDashboard.tsx:273-287) until at least one task is solved; hide the 21 greyed habit slots (see ONB-S4); in TodayCard replace 'Звёзд дня: 0' and three '0/n' rows with the three quest circles drawn as open stars and a single warm line 'Первая звезда ждёт тебя'. Show the first real reward as soon as it exists: after the first solved task the circle fills with a short 400 ms pop. Do NOT fake progress (no pre-filled bar, no 'free' point for opening the app): the endowed-progress effect is used only through truthful, visible next-step framing (a ghost star that fills when something real happens). The level bar is hidden until the first XP is earned; the first XP toast (XpToast.tsx) explains 'Это опыт: он копится, когда ты думаешь' once. The week goal line ('5 из 7 дней') appears after day 1 is completed.
- **Revised after review:** Merge into the single S4/S5 TodayCard rewrite. Fresh profile: hide stats, hide level and XP bar until XP>0, hide streak and week-goal until day 1 has been done (no 'Начни серию' text), three quest circles with partial rings for multi-step goals and one line 'Первая звезда ждёт тебя'. Filled circle = amber with check glyph, 400 ms pop (instant under reduced motion). If you add a first-XP toast, say 'Это опыт за решённые задачи' and review the no-hints bonus (xp.ts taskClean) with the owner, because it penalises hint use.
- **UI spec:** Empty TodayCard: title 'Сегодня' text-xl, three 64 px star outlines with dashed borders, caption text-base 'Первая звезда ждёт тебя', no numbers. Filled star: amber fill + check overlay (not colour only), pop 400 ms scale 1 -> 1.15 -> 1, reduced motion = instant fill. After >= 1 XP: show level chip and bar as today. Stats block: rendered only when any value > 0, collapsed by default ('Мои успехи', 48 px summary, chevron).
- **Files:** src/components/progress/TodayCard.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/progress/XpToast.tsx, src/lib/quest.ts
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo/Khan Academy Kids 'first reward before counters'; Deci, Koestner and Ryan 1999 (informational, not expected rewards); Zeigarnik / endowed-progress used honestly.
- **Guardrails:** Never advertise the reward before the task as a prize ('Реши 3 — получи 50 XP'): only describe the next step. No fake head-start progress. Zero counts are hidden, not replaced by 'ты отстаёшь' text. The quest never expires and is not framed as a debt.
- **Test plan:** Playwright fresh scenario: no element with text matching /\b0\b/ among stat tiles on home; quest shows 3 open stars; after solving one task via seeded state the first star is filled and the stat block appears. Unit: quest progress derivation unchanged. Check the first XP toast shows once. Review copy list for any '0' / 'нет' / 'пока ничего'.
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk low. Correct instinct: the rich home shows 'Звёзд дня: 0', three '⬜ 0/n' rows and zeros in stats on a fresh profile (HomeDashboard.tsx:273-287, TodayCard.tsx:80-93). Hiding zero tiles and the level bar until there is something real is cheap and honest, and the ghost star is truthful because it fills only on real events. Much of it overlaps S4 (tiles, habits) and S5 (quest circles), so keep only the part they do not cover. Two problems. First, the proposed toast 'Это опыт: он копится, когда ты думаешь' is false: xp.ts gives XP for solving, and +5 only when taskClean (no hints) or puzzleClean, which actually discourages opening hints and contradicts the owner's hint principle. A toast that explains XP would cement the wrong lesson. Second, the TodayCard also shows 'Начни серию сегодня!' at zero streak, which is a nudge the proposal does not remove. Quest circles without numbers lose the 0/3 puzzle partial progress.

#### ONB-S9 · modify · effort S · impact 3 — Chess card second on home, slim, pictorial, with first-time wording a 7-year-old can follow

- **Addresses:** ONB-7, ONB-6
- **Proposal:** Put ChessHomeCard directly after the hero and quest (about y=700 CSS px, was 1947) and make it slim: one row with the six piece icons as a visible ladder (current rank highlighted, next as a silhouette), the rank name, a progress bar with label 'N из 43', and a full-width yellow CTA (min-h-14, already good at ChessHomeCard.tsx:281) whose label is context-aware: 'Продолжить: Пешка' / 'Сыграть с роботом' / first time 'Начать с Пешки'. For a fresh profile replace the sentence 'Шесть званий: от Пешки до Короля.' (ChessHomeCard.tsx:262-271) by 'Начни с Пешки ♟' plus the icon ladder, with a speaker button for the line. Senior profile (11+) additionally shows crown count and the robot ladder shortcut as a second 48 px chip row ('🤖 Робот', '🧩 Задачи'). The rest of the chess hub stays on /chess (see the long-hub issue in the research, not changed here).
- **Revised after review:** Do not rebuild. Small edits to ChessHomeCard: (1) highlight the current rank piece with a ring and show later ranks lighter without padlocks; (2) fresh state: 'Начни с Пешки ♟' (UZ 'Piyodadan boshla'); (3) CTA label by state ('Начать с Пешки', 'Продолжить: Конь', 'Сыграть с роботом' when all ranks are done); (4) 14 px progress label; (5) move the card directly after hero and quest as part of S4, and hide it when S5's hero already is the chess step. No senior chips, no speaker, no rating anywhere.
- **UI spec:** Card rounded-3xl p-4, row 1: 6 piece icons 40 px (current ring-2 brand, future opacity 60 but with outlines for contrast >= 3:1, silhouettes for next), row 2: rank title text-lg font-black + progress bar h-3 + 14 px label, row 3: CTA h-14 w-full. Total height <= 240 px. Speaker 48 px circle top right when a clip exists. Motion: current icon bobs 1 px once on mount; none under reduced motion.
- **Files:** src/components/chess/ChessHomeCard.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/lib/chessProgress.ts, src/lib/crowns.ts
- **Inspired by:** ChessKid bot ladder with a start-here badge; Chess.com crowns on avatars; Magnus Trainer short levels; equal discoverability of two product pillars.
- **Guardrails:** No rating number anywhere on the card for under 10 (owner rule); ladder shows ranks and crowns only. No loss framing when ranks are not progressing. Do not use red or 'locked' padlocks for upcoming ranks: silhouettes only.
- **Test plan:** Playwright rich and kid7: chess card top <= 1.3 viewports on phone; CTA label changes by state (seeded: fresh, mid, all done). No numeric rating text. noName 0. Check Uzbek label fit ('Peshkadan boshlash'). Child test: ask 'where do you play chess' on home without scrolling.
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. The proposal misreads the current card. ChessHomeCard.tsx is 70 lines; the cited lines 262-271 and 281 do not exist (the sentence is at line 48 and the CTA at line 64). The card already has the six-piece ladder (rich-phone-home-t3.jpg), a progress bar with 'N из 43' and a full-width h-14 yellow CTA that already deep-links to the next level. What is actually missing: the current rank is not highlighted, the fresh-state sentence 'Шесть званий: от Пешки до Короля' is not child language, the 12 px 'N из 43' label, and above all position (about 2.3 viewports down). Position is solved by S4's reorder, not by a rebuild. A senior chip row ('🤖 Робот', '🧩 Задачи', crown count) adds clutter and another chess entry; a speaker needs new clips; both are weak. Note S5's chess next-step card would duplicate this card.

#### ONB-S10 · modify · effort S · impact 3 — Bigger language switch, a global 48 px touch token, and a skeleton instead of a blank first paint in Uzbek

- **Addresses:** ONB-12, ONB-3
- **Proposal:** LangSwitch (LangSwitch.tsx:19-37) goes from 33x32 with 12 px text to two 48x44 segments with 14 px text; on phone it sits right of the logo with an 8 px gap from any neighbour. Introduce a CSS token --tap-min: 48px (56px for junior primary actions) and use it for header links, back arrows (DaySession back arrow is 40x40, DaySession.tsx:50-60), day tabs and the print button, as the design-token side of the fix; avoid per-page patches. For the Uzbek/i18n-wait flash (layout.tsx:42 and globals.css:265 hide the body up to 1.5 s): replace 'body hidden' by showing a branded skeleton (logo, robot and an empty hero card of the right height) while the language is resolved, so a 4G child never sees a white screen; the 1.5 s timeout stays as a safety net. Add a tiny 'language changed' check: switching RU/UZ keeps the scroll position and focuses nothing new.
- **Revised after review:** (1) LangSwitch segments min-h-11 (44 px) min-w-12 with 14 px text; DaySession back arrow h-12 w-12; skip the global token. (2) For i18n-wait, render a pure-CSS skeleton (logo block, hero-sized card) via html.i18n-wait body::before with a 150 ms animation-delay so fast devices see nothing, and keep the skeleton up to a longer cap (about 4 s) instead of revealing Russian after 1.5 s; reveal immediately when LangSync fires. (3) Verify switching language preserves scroll. Accept that this mostly matters on slow connections: measure first-uz-paint on a throttled run before and after.
- **UI spec:** LangSwitch: group rounded-2xl bg-black/5 p-1, segments min-h-11 min-w-12 text-sm font-black; selected = white + brand-dark text + underline bar (not colour only). Token: :root{--tap-min:3rem} html[data-profile='junior']{--tap-min:3.5rem}; utility class .tap { min-height:var(--tap-min); min-width:var(--tap-min) }. Skeleton: pulse 1.2 s opacity 0.6->1, disabled under reduced motion, shown only if hydration takes > 150 ms (no flash on fast devices).
- **Files:** src/components/LangSwitch.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/app/layout.tsx, src/components/SiteHeader.tsx, src/components/session/DaySession.tsx
- **Inspired by:** NN/g touch target guidance; WCAG 2.2 target size (minimum and enhanced); web.dev performance (avoid blank first paint on slow networks).
- **Guardrails:** No dark pattern in the language control: both options equal size and wording in their own language. Never auto-switch the language based on guesses. Do not hide the page behind a spinner longer than the safety timeout.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: LangSwitch segments >= 44 px high, 48 px wide; audit-metrics small44 for header items = 0 on /, /chess, /my-problems; Throttle to Slow 4G + 4x CPU, uz seed: first contentful paint shows skeleton within 300 ms and no blank white; layout shift < 0.05. DaySession back arrow >= 48 px.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Measured and real: LangSwitch segments are small (header 'RU/UZ' text-xs, min-h-8, LangSwitch.tsx:19-37) and the DaySession back arrow is h-10 w-10 (DaySession.tsx:53), the child's main escape. I also measured the Uzbek load on Slow 4G plus 4x CPU: the page became ready after 3.25 s, while html.i18n-wait is removed by a 1.5 s timer (layout.tsx:42). So an Uzbek child sees about 1.5 s of an empty page, then the server-rendered Russian, then Uzbek at about 3.2 s. A skeleton alone does not fix that: the proposal keeps the 1.5 s timeout, which is exactly what causes the Russian flash. A global --tap-min token and .tap utility is infrastructure with no consumer other than the header and back arrow. Larger language segments also make accidental language flips more likely, though reversible.

#### ONB-S11 · drop · effort M · impact 3 — NEW: 'Моя неделя' strip and a private share card for Dilnoza (no ranks, first name only)

- **Addresses:** ONB-4, ONB-5
- **Proposal:** Give the competitive 9-12 child a visible, brag-worthy but non-comparative home element. A 7-dot 'Моя неделя' row (filled dot per active day, rest days never break it) sits inside TodayCard and replaces any growing counter that can fall to 0. After a milestone (day finished, week finished, rank up, robot crown) a 'Поделиться' button (48 px) renders a card to a canvas (reuse certificate.ts / Certificate.tsx styling): robot, first name only (or nickname), 'Неделя 1 завершена', 4 icons (days, tasks, chess rank, crown). It uses the Web Share API (fallback: download PNG); nothing is sent unless the child taps. The card contains no rating, no accuracy %, no timer values, no other children. The same card is offered as 'Показать маме или папе' for the junior profile with a one-line talking prompt for the adult ('Спросите: как ты нашёл(ла) путь?' avoid gendered form: 'Спросите: как ты придумал решение?' is masculine, so use 'Спросите: как это получилось?'). Compared to the existing printable certificates this works on a phone in 2 taps and is Telegram-friendly.
- **UI spec:** Week strip: 7 dots 20 px with day initials 14 px; today ring; free-rest days shown as soft moon icons, not empty. Share sheet: preview 270x270 CSS px, 2 buttons: 'Поделиться' (primary) and 'Сохранить картинку' (secondary), both h-14; name field shows what will be printed with a 'Без имени' toggle. Card canvas 1080x1080, text >= 56 px, fonts embedded (Nunito).
- **Files:** src/components/progress/TodayCard.tsx, src/components/progress/ShareCard.tsx (new), src/lib/certificate.ts, src/components/chess/Certificate.tsx, src/lib/xp.ts
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo weekly dots and milestone celebration; Lichess Racer (no public leaderboard); printable certificates already in the product; Telegram-first sharing (local context).
- **Guardrails:** Sharing is explicit and per-card; default name = nickname or first name set by parent; no surname, city, school or photo. No leaderboard, no friend list, no 'beat your friend' counters. The streak never shows '0' or a broken state ('С возвращением!' instead). Share text carries no pressure or invitation to compare.
- **Test plan:** Unit: week strip derived from activityDays; free-rest days. E2E: share button appears only after a milestone, generates PNG with expected size; Web Share missing falls back to download; card has no digits except counts (check against a whitelist). Privacy review: canvas content equals preview. Ask 5 children aged 10-12 whether they would show it to a friend (qualitative).
- **Review:** feasibility hard, age fit False, manipulation risk low. Out of scope for first run, home and wayfinding, and the cost is understated: a canvas share card with embedded fonts, Web Share and a privacy review is more than 'M'. The Web Share sheet lists all of the parent's contacts, so a 10-year-old can post a picture with her name to the wrong chat from the parent's phone; that is a child-safety surface the product does not currently have (it has printable certificates and optional sync).
