(5) Seniors' two 8-chip task pickers stay but juniors should not read them.

#### TASK-S10 · modify · effort S · impact 2 — Render day-intro paragraphs through RichText and lint for stray markdown

Render each intro paragraph with <RichText text={p} />. Add a small content lint script that scans all src/content/**/\*.ts string literals shown as plain text (intro, habit, followUps, hints, feedback) for '**', '__' and backticks that are not supposed to render, and fails CI. Check that other components that print content directly (DayFinish habit name, AfterSolve) are covered.

- **Inspired by:** Polish and trust for parents; general QA practice.
- **Guardrails:** Do not allow RichText to render raw HTML from content (keep the current safe subset). Keep paragraph text identical for narration clips so the recorded voice still matches the text.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: open /week/3/day/5 and /week/3/day/2 in RU and UZ; assert the page text contains no '**'. Run the lint script against the repo (expect 0 hits after fix, hits before). Verify no clip text needs regeneration (the bold markers were not in the spoken text).
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Confirmed: DayIntro.tsx:39-40 prints {p} as plain text, while the intro strings in week3/day2.ts:12 and week3/day5.ts:12 contain '**предположи и проверь**' and '**не бывает**'; the UZ files contain the same markers (4 and 8 asterisk lines in day2.uz.ts and day5.uz.ts). RichText already exists and is safe (it only handles ** and backticks). One miss: PrintSheets.tsx:100-101 also prints day.intro as raw text, so the printed sheet shows the asterisks too (print styles). Intros are not narrated, so no re-recording.

#### TASK-S11 · keep · effort S · impact 3 — 'Проверить' that never looks broken: a gentle answer when the field is empty

- **Addresses:** TASK-9
- **Proposal:** Stop using the 45%-opacity, pointer-events-none look for the main action buttons. Introduce an 'aria-disabled' soft-disabled state in Button (ui.tsx:32): the button keeps full shape, a slightly muted colour with contrast at least 3:1, remains tappable, and on tap does a gentle action instead of nothing: the empty field gets focus with a mint outline pulse and a small bubble above the button says what is needed. Apply to Проверить in FieldsAnswer (empty field), ChoiceAnswers ('Выбери ответ'), assign tasks, and Запустить/Шаг in RobotPuzzle (empty program: bubble 'Сначала добавь команды' and the arrow pad pulses). Bubble stays 2.5s, is announced via aria-live, no sound, and a recorded clip is optional later. Keep hard-disabled (opacity) only for truly impossible actions such as ⌫ on an empty program, and then with the button visibly lighter, not invisible.
- **UI spec:** Soft-disabled: bg indigo at 70% on white text meeting 3:1 (e.g. #6d63e8 on white - verify), no 3D shadow lift, cursor default. Tap: field outline 3px mint pulse 400ms (opacity only under reduced motion), bubble 'Впиши число 🙂' placed above the button, 16px bold, max-width 280px, rounded-2xl, tail pointing down. Robot: bubble 'Нажми стрелки, чтобы собрать программу', pad border pulses.
- **Files:** src/components/ui.tsx, src/components/answers/FieldsAnswer.tsx, src/components/answers/ChoiceAnswers.tsx, src/components/robot/RobotPuzzle.tsx
- **Inspired by:** NN/g (children conclude 'the app is broken' if a tap does nothing); error prevention with explanation; Khan Kids always-responsive controls.
- **Guardrails:** The bubble is information, not a nag: no repeat or escalation, no sound, no red. It must not make the answer available (no hints about the value). Keep keyboard behaviour (Enter does nothing if empty, but shows the same bubble).
- **Test plan:** Playwright: day1-t1, tap Проверить with an empty field: assert focus is on the input, the bubble text is present and role/status announced, no feedback card; type 57 and assert normal flow. Contrast check of the soft-disabled colour with a contrast script (>= 3:1). Run on robot with an empty program. Manual: 3 children, count how many tap the disabled-looking button and what they do next.
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. The faded dead button is visible in kid7-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg (lavender Проверить, white label on pale background, low contrast) and robot 'Запустить' in rich-phone-day1-robot-t2.jpg; the base class is disabled:opacity-45 disabled:pointer-events-none (ui.tsx:32). A tap that does nothing is a known 'is it broken?' trigger for young children, and the fix is small and local (FieldsAnswer, ChoiceAnswers, RobotPuzzle). The proposed contrast #6d63e8 on white is about 4.5:1, so it passes. Keep it small: soft-disabled via aria-disabled, a short message, no sound, no repetition.

#### TASK-S12 · modify · effort S · impact 3 — Help is close and free: hint button beside the answer, equal XP with or without hints

- **Addresses:** TASK-10
- **Proposal:** (1) Add a persistent '💡 Подсказка' button inside the answer card header (next to 'Мой ответ'), 44px, with the dot counter (filled dots, 14px) showing used/total. Tapping it scrolls to and focuses the HintLadder (it stays in the aside/last block on desktop, or becomes an inline accordion directly under the answer card on phones, so the child no longer scrolls ~1000px). Also the retry card contains the same button (see S3). (2) Remove the hint penalty from XP: set XP.task to 15 and drop XP.taskClean for tasks (xp.ts:12-13, :34). This never lowers anybody's existing total: previously clean solves got 15, hinted ones 10; now both get 15. Adjust the unit tests and the toast copy; keep taskClean for chess puzzles if the owner wants it, but rename it as 'без повторов' only for chess where there are no hints. (3) Increase the ladder's step label from 12px to 14px and remove all-caps; show 'Подсказка 2 из 5'.
- **Revised after review:** Keep XP flat at 15 and update the gamification tests. Add a '💡 Подсказка' button (44-48 px, no dots) to the answer card header that scrolls to and focuses the ladder; keep the dots only inside the ladder. After solving, keep the ladder reachable (AfterSolve currently sits above it). Raise the step label to 14 px and drop the uppercase. Do not restructure the ladder into an accordion unless a test shows the scroll on tool tasks is a problem.
- **UI spec:** Phone: answer card header row: left '✏️ Мой ответ', right '💡 Подсказка ●●○○○' as a 44px high soft pill (dots 12px, with aria-label 'Открыто 2 из 5'). Ladder renders directly below the answer panel (above AfterSolve) on <1024px; on desktop it stays in the sticky aside. After opening, the 15s ring remains, label 'Подумай с этой подсказкой…' 16px. Toast shows +15 XP in both cases.
- **Files:** src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/components/task/HintLadder.tsx, src/lib/xp.ts, src/components/answers/Feedback.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Growth-mindset caution and the digest's anti-pattern 'rewards that shrink when a child asks for help' (Chess.com crowns); Khan Kids help button always near the activity; self-determination theory (do not make help-seeking costly).
- **Guardrails:** Do not display any 'hints used' count as a score or compare it to others; the parent view may show it as information only. Keep the pause setting (hintPause) as the rate limiter, not a penalty. Do not increase XP to push 'more hints' either: it is flat. Never reduce an existing XP total on migration.
- **Test plan:** Unit test in xp: xpTotal for a state with a hinted solve equals a state with a clean solve; compare xpTotal(old) <= xpTotal(new) over the fixtures (no regression). Playwright: the hint button is visible without scrolling after load at 412x839 on day1-t1 and opens the ladder (scrolls it into view). Check toasts: '+15 XP' in both cases. Measure hint-open rate before/after (expected to rise slightly; that is fine).
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Flat XP is the right call: xpTotal currently gives 10 + 5 clean (xp.ts:34), so a child who opens a hint sees '+10' instead of '+15', a small but real penalty for help-seeking, and the on-screen message says hints are normal. Changing XP.task to 15 and dropping taskClean cannot lower any total. Needed work: tests/gamification.test.ts:61 references XP.taskClean; chess puzzles still keep puzzleClean (inconsistent with the same logic, mention but leave). Hint access is already one block below the answer on phones (aside follows the answer card in TaskView.tsx), and hintPause defaults to true (state.ts:227), so abuse is rate-limited. The proposed dot counter in the header, however, puts 'hints used' in the child's focus, exactly the thing the guardrail says not to emphasise, and for Dilnoza it can become a score. The accordion-under-answer is mostly already how phone layout works; the real long scroll happens only for tall tools.

#### TASK-S13 · modify · effort M · impact 3 — Tap-size tokens by age: 48px floor for kids, labelled and spaced secondary actions

- **Addresses:** TASK-11
- **Proposal:** Introduce a --tap-min token and size variants driven by ageProfile: juniors 56px for primary actions and 48px for all others, middles 48px, seniors 44px. Implement as CSS variables on <html data-age='junior|middle|senior'> set by an existing client component, and make Button 'sm' use var(--tap-min) rather than min-h-9. Specific fixes from the audit: back arrow 40 -> 48 (DaySession.tsx:55), the print button is moved off the child header into the finish page and parent area (it is a parent action), ListenButton min-h-9 -> var(--tap-min) (ListenButton.tsx), robot 'Стереть' and 'Очистить' become md buttons with icons (⌫ and 🗑) and an 8px gap, Hanoi peg-count chips and cipher +/- 40 -> 48 and 36 -> 48, the task-strip buttons are replaced in S14. Add `::after` hit-area extension where visuals must stay small, with at least 8px between neighbouring targets. Add a Playwright audit assertion to the existing metrics script: on the day pages small44 must be 0 for juniors.
- **Revised after review:** No age tokens. Raise Button 'sm' to min-h-11 (44 px) globally, give icon buttons a 48 px floor, and give adjacent small targets an 8 px gap. Specific fixes: back arrow 40 to 48, ListenButton min-h-9 to 44 (S7 enlarges it further for junior), robot Стереть/Очистить as md buttons with icons and 8 px gap, Hanoi peg chips and cipher +/- to 44-48 px. Move the print button to DayIntro (start screen) and the parent area, not to the finish page. Keep the bottom nav buttons at 48 px (bar about 72 px). Add the small44 assertion for the day pages to the audit script as a test, not the junior-only version.
- **UI spec:** Tokens: --tap-min: 44px (senior) / 48px (middle) / 56px (junior primary, 48 others). Spacing between adjacent targets >= 8px. Icons keep 24px glyphs inside the larger hit area. Gear/parent entry keeps its own place and size but not near the main nav.
- **Files:** src/components/ui.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/components/session/DaySession.tsx, src/components/ListenButton.tsx, src/components/robot/RobotPuzzle.tsx, src/components/answers/HanoiPuzzle.tsx, src/components/answers/CipherPuzzle.tsx, src/lib/age.ts
- **Inspired by:** NN/g children's physical development (2 cm targets), WCAG 2.5.5 and Material 48 dp; Sesame Workshop touch research; digest: fine motor accuracy below 9.
- **Guardrails:** Do not enlarge by hiding content: if space runs out, move secondary actions into a menu rather than shrinking primary ones. Keep both choices of a pair (e.g. 'Закончить' and 'Ещё одну') equal in size so there is no lopsided nudge. Do not alter parent-area density.
- **Test plan:** Re-run the audit script after the change: phone /week/1/day/1 small44 from 11 to 0 for junior profile, and no new hOverflow in RU or UZ (UZ labels are longer). Manual tap-accuracy check: 5 children try to hit 10 targets (strip, Назад, Стереть, Очистить); compare mis-tap count to the baseline.
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Raising tiny targets is justified (audit-metrics.json: phone day 1 small44 = 11, back arrow 40, print 45x36, strip buttons 40, Button sm min-h-9 in ui.tsx:25, robot 'Стереть' and 'Очистить' sm). But the age-driven token system is over-engineered: Dilnoza (middle, 44 px) and Aziz (junior, 48 px) differ by 4 px, and it needs a new client component and head-script change to avoid layout flash (tests/head-script.test.ts). A 56 px junior primary on the day nav bar would make it about 80 px tall (24 px padding), working against the space saved by S14 and S6. Moving the print button to the finish page is wrong: day printing is a pre-session action for parents, who need it at the start (DayIntro) or in the parent area, not after the day is done. The strip buttons are replaced by S14, so that part overlaps.

#### TASK-S14 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — Progress you can read at a glance: segmented day bar with a counter, 64px header

- **Addresses:** TASK-12, TASK-5
- **Proposal:** Replace the emoji strip (ProgressDots, DaySession.tsx:103-163) and the 112px two-row header with a compact bar. Row 1 (48px): ← back, title 'День 1 · Почти двадцать' truncated, and the counter pill '3 из 8 ⭐' (solved count, not position). Row 2 (16px): a segmented progress bar with one segment per task plus a flag segment for the finish; colours: solved mint, current brand with a ring, started sun outline, untouched grey. The visual segments are 10px high but each has a hit area of 44px height via padding, and tapping a segment goes to that task. Tapping the counter pill opens a bottom sheet with an 8-item numbered list (big 56px rows with the section emoji, number, title, a check if solved, a speaker for narration) for navigation, which also resolves identical-emoji ambiguity. 'Задача N из M' text on the task card is removed (the bar shows it). This frees about 48px on the phone and removes the clipped 🏁 chip. 'Назад' in the bottom bar stays.
- **Revised after review:** Keep the segmented bar and make it navigational but modest: segments 10 px tall visually in a 28-32 px tall button, header about 76-80 px total (title row 48, bar row about 28). Show the section emoji only on the current segment, or keep tiny icons above segments for week-1 days, whichever fits at 380 px; the flag segment must be fully visible. Replace the bottom-bar '3 / 8' with the solved counter or remove it; a single number means one thing: solved count in the header, current position shown by the ringed segment. Drop the bottom sheet. Remove 'Задача N из M' text on the card only after the counter is in place. Segments only fill up; unsolved are neutral grey. Keep it reachable at bigText.
- **UI spec:** Header: sticky, 64px on phone (48 + 16), bg paper/90. Segment gap 3px, width flex-1 (8 tasks + flag fit within 380px: about 38px each). Counter pill: 36px high visual, 48px hit, text '3 из 8' 16px bold plus ⭐ (star outline when 0). Bottom sheet: slides up 200ms (fade only under reduced motion), max 70% height, rows with task title wrapping 2 lines, close handle 48px. aria: bar is an <ol> of buttons with aria-label 'Задача 3: название, решена'. Segment pop animation (scale 1.2, 200ms) when a task becomes solved.
- **Files:** src/components/session/DaySession.tsx, src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/lib/store.ts
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo lesson progress bar; goal-gradient effect (visible quantity toward a goal); Khan Kids/Mathseeds visible path; NN/g 'icon plus word, no two identical icons'.
- **Guardrails:** The bar only fills up; unsolved tasks are neutral grey, never red, and the counter shows what is done, not what is left or failed. No countdown or time estimate. Skipping around remains free (no locked tasks), so progress is a mirror, not a gate. Keep the finish segment reachable without pressure messages.
- **Test plan:** Playwright 412x839 RU and UZ: header height <= 64px, no horizontal scroll in the bar, flag segment fully visible, hit areas >= 44px (getBoundingClientRect on the button wrappers), segment colours match status for a seeded state (3 solved, 1 started), counter text updates after solving. Measure the visible content area: task title top moves up by about 48px. Manual: ask Dilnoza-like participants 'how many have you done?' without counting ticks (time to answer under 2 seconds).
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. A readable progress bar with a 'solved' counter is useful for Dilnoza, and identical emoji (🔢 🔢 in the strip) plus the clipped 🏁 chip (kid7-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg) are real flaws. But the numbers do not add up: the claim of a 64 px header and about 48 px saved conflicts with the 44 px hit area per segment; a 48 px row plus a 44 px interactive row is about 92 px, saving only about 20 px, and overlapping hit areas with the back button and counter pill would cause mis-taps. Also the header would show 'solved count' while the bottom bar shows position '3 / 8' (S1 keeps this), two different numbers on one screen with different meanings, which confuses a 7-year-old. Removing section emoji drops the only type cue; Aziz recognises robot or magnifier icons faster than numbers. The numbered bottom sheet with narration speakers on every row is another new hidden panel and scope creep.

#### TASK-S15 · drop · effort M · impact 3 — NEW: 'Угадай сначала' - predict, lock in, then reveal (one task in three)

- **Addresses:** (new idea)
- **Proposal:** For about 25 numeric and tool tasks add an optional estimate beat before the answer: three big chips ('ближе к 40 / 50 / 60?', picture-based when possible) the child taps to lock a guess; then the normal answer UI opens. After a correct answer the card shows the guess next to the result ('Ты думал 50, вышло 57 - близко!'). For tools it works like 'Как думаешь, сколько ходов нужно?'. Content: task.estimate?: {ru; uz; options: number[]; unit?}. Appears on 1 task in 3 per day, always with 'Пропустить' as an equal-size button. The beat is never scored, never affects XP, and never says right or wrong; it only reveals the distance in a friendly way. Narration clip for the prompt line only. It also reduces blind guess-and-check since the child commits to an idea before typing.
- **UI spec:** Estimate card above 'Мой ответ': three chips 96x72px, 20px numerals, tap to select (ring + check), 'Запомнить мою догадку' button appears after selecting (or auto-lock on second tap) and the answer section unlocks with a 200ms slide; 'Пропустить' sits at equal size to the right. After solve: a mint line in the feedback card: 'Ты думал 50 - вышло 57. Почти!' (or 'Угадал(а)' avoided: 'Догадка совпала!'). No animation beyond a tick.
- **Copy:** RU: Как думаешь, сколько получится? / Ближе к 40, 50 или 60? / Пропустить / Ты думал 50, вышло 57. Почти! / UZ: Qancha chiqadi deb o'ylaysan? / 40, 50 yoki 60 ga yaqinmi? / O'tkazib yuborish / Sen 50 deding, 57 chiqdi. Deyarli!
- **Files:** src/content/types.ts, src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/components/answers/EstimateStep.tsx, src/components/answers/Feedback.tsx, src/content/week1/day1.ts
- **Inspired by:** Desmos 'predict before reveal' and 'delay feedback'; Brilliant pretests; for Dilnoza: a mini-challenge ('beat my own estimate').
- **Guardrails:** Skippable and sparse (max 1 in 3 tasks) so it never becomes a chore. No score, XP, streak or badge for good guesses (would be an expected reward and invite gaming). No 'you were wrong' wording. For 6-7 use visual or 3 options only.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: estimate beat shows on flagged tasks, 'Пропустить' unlocks the answer without a guess, locked guess shows in feedback. Content lint that no more than 1 in 3 tasks in a day has estimate. Pilot: compare attempts per task on tasks with and without estimate (target fewer rapid repeated submissions within 10 seconds). Parent question: does it feel like extra homework?
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit False, manipulation risk low. Prediction before reveal works for tasks with real intuition (estimation, conceptual), not for arithmetic like 19+19+19. Offering three chips such as 40/50/60 for an answer of 57 narrows the answer to a range, supporting the guess-and-check the proposal claims to reduce. It inserts an extra step before the answer on about a third of tasks, adding reading and tapping for Aziz, whose attention budget is about 10 minutes, and for Dilnoza it is a pointless gate. Authoring task.estimate options for 25 tasks in RU and UZ is a content burden. The result copy 'Ты думал 50, вышло 57. Почти!' is masculine (violates S2's own rule) and the 'Почти!' distance feedback is a hot/cold cue. There is no evidence in the proposal that predictions reduce rapid resubmission in this age group; Desmos uses it for older students.

#### TASK-S16 · drop · effort L · impact 4 — NEW: Robot workshop - progress as a capped, growing robot, not a counter

- **Addresses:** TASK-7, TASK-12
- **Proposal:** Give the child a personal robot built from 12 parts (antenna, gear, arm, eyes, wheels, etc.) displayed on the home screen above the day card and on the finish page. Parts are earned by process behaviours, not speed or time: finishing a day (1 part per day for the first 12 days then recolours/hats), 'нашёлся другой способ' mark, 'подсказка помогла дойти до решения', 'попробовал новый инструмент', and a first win against the chess robot (re-using crowns). Parts derive from existing stored progress (like xpTotal, no new state needed: compute from tasks marks, days.completedAt, crowns), so they restore with sync. Seniors see the same robot plus an 'Мой прогресс' sheet with XP/level, personal bests and the printable certificate. The collection is finite (12 parts + 6 colours) and ends with a short 'Робот готов!' celebration. The robot is also the character on the finish page and in the S1 result bar (small, 32px).
- **UI spec:** Home: card 412x200 with the robot SVG (placeholder silhouette for missing parts, labelled 'Ещё 4 детали'), tap opens a sheet with all 12 slots (64px) each with a one-line reason in the child's language ('Другой способ'). New part animation: part slides in 600ms with a soft chime, only at a finish moment, never mid-task. Use compressed SVG (under 40 KB total) with lazy loading for 4G.
- **Files:** src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/progress/TodayCard.tsx, src/components/Awards.tsx, src/lib/awards.ts, src/components/visuals/RobotBuddy.tsx, src/components/session/DayFinish.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Khan Academy Kids (accumulating sparkles toward a payoff), Lingokids sticker album and Mathseeds hatching pets; the digest pattern 'progress as a growing world'; Lepper/Deci caution (informational, not payment).
- **Guardrails:** Finite and capped so it cannot become a compulsion loop; parts are never random or hidden-odds (no loot box), never purchasable, never lost; no streak dependency, no countdown. Do not announce the reward before the task ('solve 3 to get a part'): show it afterwards. Reward process and variety, not speed or answer count. Avoid comparison with other children (no public view). Provide a way to hide it (quiet mode).
- **Test plan:** Unit: parts computed from fixtures (0 progress = 0 parts; completing day 1 = +1; marks add specific parts; reloading from sync gives the same result). Playwright: home renders the robot for rich and fresh profiles, no layout overflow in RU/UZ, bundle size delta under 40 KB gzip. Pilot with 5 children: do they ask to continue after the part appears; ensure it does not push repeated easy tasks (watch for farming).
- **Review:** feasibility hard, age fit True, manipulation risk high. This adds yet another reward layer to an app that already has XP and levels, a daily quest, a gentle streak, awards (src/lib/awards.ts, which already derives badges from state), crowns and certificates, on a home screen that is already full. Parts are partly earned through self-report marks ('нашёлся другой способ', 'подсказка помогла') which are free toggles in AfterSolve, so a child can farm parts by tapping marks; this would also corrupt the reflection data parents rely on (insights.ts counts the marks). 'One part per day for 12 days' rewards completing days, which can be done empty (see S9). The proposal lists src/components/visuals/RobotBuddy.tsx, which does not exist, and 40 KB of new SVG, a sheet, slots and animation make it L effort. A finite collection is better than open-ended, but the over-justification risk (Deci) and clutter outweigh the benefit; there is no evidence it increases learning, and the same motivation is served by the S9 finish celebration.

#### TASK-S17 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — NEW: Rounds for juniors - a day split into 3 short rounds with a calm stop

- **Addresses:** TASK-7, TASK-5
- **Proposal:** For age 6-8 (junior) split the 8-task day into 3 rounds (3 + 3 + 2 tasks, about 7 minutes each) with a 'Round complete' beat after each round. The round screen is a light version of S9: 3 stars for the 3 tasks, the robot waving, and two equal buttons: 'Передохнуть' (saves position and goes home, counts for the daily quest) and 'Ещё раунд' (continues). The home card for juniors reads 'Раунд 1 · около 7 минут' instead of '8 задач · около 25 минут', and a 'next round' resume deep-links to the first unsolved task. The existing strip and all tasks stay reachable, so nothing is locked; seniors keep the whole-day flow with an optional break suggestion after about 20 minutes. Add a soft break prompt after 12 minutes of continuous play for juniors: 'Можно размяться! Робот подождёт.' with a single dismiss button (no repeat for 10 minutes). Parent settings gets 'Длина раунда' (2/3/4 tasks).
- **Revised after review:** Junior only (ageProfile 'junior'), with a parent setting to turn rounds off or choose length 2/3/4. After tasks 3 and 6 (by step transition, forward only) show a full-screen light round beat: robot, 3 stars for that round's solved tasks (outline otherwise), and two equal-size buttons 'Передохнуть' (saves position and goes home, no streak or XP effect) and 'Ещё раунд'. TodayCard shows 'Раунд 1 · 3 задачи' without minutes for juniors; minutes may appear in the parent area. Resume deep-links to the first unsolved task. Drop the 12-minute break prompt and the senior break suggestion. Reuse the S9 celebration component and keep the beat skippable. Test with fake timers is then unnecessary.
- **UI spec:** Round beat is a full-screen card (not a modal) that replaces the task area after task 3 and task 6 for juniors: robot 96px waving, text 'Раунд 1 завершён' 28px, three stars, buttons stacked 56px, equal size. Progress bar from S14 shows round boundaries as slightly larger gaps. Home: TodayCard shows 'Раунд N' chip with a 7-minute estimate. No countdowns, no timers visible.
- **Files:** src/components/session/DaySession.tsx, src/components/progress/TodayCard.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/lib/quest.ts, src/lib/age.ts, src/components/parent/ParentSettings.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Round-based sessions in Duolingo and Khan Kids; ICO Children's Code (breaks, pause and save); the digest: Aziz's 10-minute attention and the parent's wish for short safe sessions.
- **Guardrails:** The 'Передохнуть' button must be as large and as prominent as 'Ещё раунд' (no lopsided nudge, no confirmshaming, no guilt on stopping). Break prompt is dismissible, shown once, never blocks; no autoplay of the next task. Stopping early does not cost streak or XP, and the daily quest counts a finished round. Parent can change round length or turn rounds off.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: junior profile on day 1 sees the round beat after task 3 and 6 and resume goes to the first unsolved task; senior profile sees no beat. Check that both buttons are equal width/height. Check break prompt appears once after simulated 12 minutes (fake timers) and not again for 10 minutes. Pilot: average minutes of play per session for juniors (target 6-10), rate of returning next day, and parent feedback on 'short and safe'.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. This best matches Aziz's profile (about 10 minutes of attention, 25-minute days of 8 tasks) and the parent's wish for short safe sessions; round-based sessions are standard in kid apps and the 'Передохнуть' equal-size button is the right guardrail. Needed fixes. DaySession steps are hash-based (#task-N, #finish), so a round beat needs its own step state and Back-button behaviour. 'Раунд 1 · около 7 минут' shows a time estimate to a slow reader, who then feels late when a round takes 15 minutes; minutes are for the parent, not the child. The 12-minute continuous-play prompt adds a timer layer that overlaps with the round beat (two interruptions) and the 'senior break after 20 minutes' is not needed. The round beat duplicates S9's celebration, so it should share one component. Skipping around the strip must not trap the child in extra beats, and 'counts for the daily quest' must match the quest definition: quest counts solved tasks (quest.ts), not rounds.

## Chess school learning flow

The chess school has a strong core: a real interactive board, soft feedback with no word "wrong", narrated lessons and legends, and a six-rank structure that a child can understand (Pawn to King). Two things undercut the "journey" feeling. First, the hub buries the path under 12 equal cards. Second, the level pages put roughly two screens of reading before the first lesson board, with no audio on exercises. Aziz (7) would lose focus before he touches a piece. Dilnoza (10) has no sense of mastery beyond a binary "solved". Separately, the Encyclopedia page is physically broken on phones: its layout is 869 px wide on a 412 px screen, so everything renders at about half size. The Endgame page is a 15-screen scroll of adult-level content shown to every age. I did not find a case where a child is completely blocked, but strict all-or-nothing rank gating plus a single all-at-once hint comes close for a 7-year-old. Housekeeping: while testing I accidentally wrote four PNG screenshots into the repo root. I removed exactly those four files and confirmed no .png files remain there. Nothing else in /home/user/Davlatjon was touched.

**Keep (strengths):**

- Level exercises give soft, specific feedback with no word 'wrong': 'Это клетка e5. А нужна e4' with a how-to-find-it sub-line, 'Так фигура не ходит. Точки показывают, куда можно пойти', and 'Подумай ещё. Вспомни урок' (ChessExercises.tsx:120-130, 281-290, 619-626). Keep this register everywhere.
- Lesson cards are one step at a time with a progress strip and a 'Послушать' (listen) button on every step (ChessLesson.tsx:65-92). The interactive DemoBoard ('👆 Нажми на фигуру', then dots show moves) is exactly the kind of learn-by-touching interaction children need.
- The seven exercise types (find the square, mark the moves, collect stars, find the move, pick a square, quiz, queens) are varied and all touch the real board. Taps and drag both work. After solving, 'Почему так' explains in one sentence.
- Rank earned is a genuine milestone: a gold banner 'Звание «Пешка» получено! Теперь открыт уровень «Конь»', a certificate button, a next-level button and a +55 XP toast (verified live; see solvedlast.png in the audit-agents/chess folder).
- Level lock cards are respectful, not punishing. They show a hook question ('Здесь ты узнаешь: ...') and the plain reason 'Откроется после звания «Слон»'. The dashed, greyed card style reads clearly as 'not yet' (rich-phone-chess-t7).
- 'Тайны и легенды' is the best-designed screen in the section: a curiosity question as a title, accordion open on tap, narrated audio, a 'Для тех, кто постарше' fold for the 10+ detail, and local Uzbek and Khorezm heritage (Secrets.tsx:131-175). Level legends with a 'Открыть тайну уровня' reveal button (ChessLevelView.tsx:219) are a strong hook.
- Age gating is respectful of the child: junior profile opens only level 1 and goes in order, middle opens 3, senior opens all (age.ts:41-65), and a parent can open all (chessProgress.ts:16).
- Exercise number chips are 44 px with a green check on solved ones, so a child can see 'how many are left' at a glance (ChessLevelView.tsx:149-157). Free navigation between exercises means a child can skip a hard one and come back.

### Findings

#### CHESS-1 · major · partly — The 'journey' (6 ranks) is buried below 12 equal-weight cards, and nothing says 'do this next'

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** The hub order is: hero, daily-quest/XP/streak card (TodayCard), 12 identical section cards (Play, Puzzles, Openings, Famous games, Review, Endgames, Analysis, Coordinates, Drills, Awards, Secrets, Encyclopedia, Diary), and only after that 'Уровни и звания' with the six ranks. There is no 'Continue: next exercise / next level' button. The only link between the hero and the path is a thin progress bar that reads 'Упражнений решено: 7 из 43', which makes a child who just earned a rank look 16% done. The levels are flat cards with the same 'открыт' pill, not a visible road with a 'you are here' marker.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-chess-t1..t8: hub is 7.5 viewport heights (metrics 'phone /chess' ratio 7.5, 48 interactive, 256 text nodes); levels list begins on t5-t6; Playwright (age 7, Pixel 7): hub scrollHeight 6333 px, 'Уровни и звания' h2 at y=3664 (about 4.4 screens down); ChessSchool.tsx:260 (TodayCard), :262-282 (12 cards), :284-366 (levels after them); hero bar :249-256 uses total over all 43 exercises; rich-phone-chess-t6/t7: Knight 'открыт' 0/7 and Bishop 'открыт' 0/7 appear identical for age 9, with no recommended next step
- **Principle:** Primary action first (Hick's law / one clear thing at a time); goal-gradient effect: progress must be shown toward the NEXT milestone; journey metaphors (path with 'you are here') drive motivation in Duolingo/Khan Academy Kids.
- **Impact:** A 7-year-old sees a menu, not a quest. A child who has finished Pawn may wander into Openings or Endgames instead of continuing the rank path. The rank loop (the core retention mechanic) is the least visible part of the page.
- **Skeptic:** The core numbers are real. At age 7 on Pixel 7 the hub is 6333 px high, 'Уровни и звания' h2 sits at y=3665, and the hero bar says 'Упражнений решено: 0 из 43' (ChessSchool.tsx:249-256). The hero has no link or button at all. Overstated points: (a) there are 13 section cards, not 12; (b) 'nothing says do this next' is too strong. TodayCard sits at y=605 with a 3-item quest, and the RankEarned banner has a 'Уровень «Конь» →' button; (c) 'identical open pills' is true only for age 9, where 3 levels are open. For age 7 only Pawn is open and levels 2-6 are dashed with '🔒 закрыт' and 'Откроется после звания…', which is a visible path. The real defect is that the path sits 4 screens down and the hero has no 'Continue' button.

#### CHESS-2 · major · confirmed — Level page opens with ~2 screens of reading (legend + portrait) before the lesson, and lesson text comes before its board

- **Who:** AZIZ
- **Problem:** On every level, the 'Legend of the level' card (hook, subtitle, four paragraphs of about 20 words, a reveal button and a large engraving) is placed above the lesson (ChessLevelView.tsx:128-132). The first lesson step 'Шахматная доска' therefore starts at about y=1887 on a phone. Inside a lesson card on mobile the layout is one column with the text first and the board last (ChessLesson.tsx:77-92; md:grid-cols is only used from tablet up), so the child must read about 70 words before seeing the highlighted e4 square the text is talking about. The step dots are also tiny.
- **Evidence:** Playwright, /chess/pawn at age 7: first h3 (lesson step title) at y=1887 px; kid7-phone-pawn-t1 (hero + tabs + start of legend), rich-phone-pawn-t2/t3 (legend text and portrait fill two tiles), rich-phone-pawn-t4 (board appears only after the full paragraph); Step dots measured 91x10 px (four of them), ChessLesson.tsx:73 (h-2.5); metrics 'phone /chess/pawn': ratio 4.3, textUnder14 27, small44 20, tiny32 11
- **Principle:** Segmenting and signaling principle (Mayer): show the picture with, or before, the words; one idea per screen for slow readers; the main action must be above the fold on a 6.3-inch phone.
- **Impact:** Aziz hits a wall of text and an old portrait before he does anything. The first 'play' moment (tap a piece, see dots) is 3-4 screens away. Fatigue arrives before the first success.
- **Skeptic:** Age 7 /chess/pawn: the lesson article starts at y=1835, its h3 'Шахматная доска' is at 1887, and the board is at 2458, below the text. The article has about 99 words. The lesson is one column on mobile (ChessLesson.tsx:77-92, md:grid-cols only). The four step dots measure 91x10. Mitigations the audit skips: the legend has a 'Послушать легенду' button (kid7-phone-pawn-t1) and the lesson card has a ListenButton plus a 'Шаг 1 из 4' label. Both reduce the fatigue but do not remove the 3-4 screens before the first interaction.

#### CHESS-3 · major · confirmed — Exercises have no audio and use long text prompts; some quiz questions about the board show no board

- **Who:** AZIZ
- **Problem:** Lessons have a 'Послушать' (listen) button, legends and secrets have one, but ChessExerciseView/ExerciseShell has none: the task prompt (e.g. 'Одна из белых пешек может взять чёрную фигуру. Сделай этот ход: нажми на пешку, а потом на клетку, куда она пойдёт.') can only be read. The first quiz for level 1 asks 'Какого цвета клетка h1 — в правом нижнем углу доски?' and 'Какого цвета клетка a1…' with two text buttons and no board; the board is shown only for question 3. The hint, the 'Почему так' explanation and the retry sub-lines are all text-only as well.
- **Evidence:** Playwright: /chess/pawn#exercise-1 contains 0 'Послушать' buttons; ChessExercises.tsx:52-54 (prompt only as RichText, no ListenButton); ChessLesson.tsx:84 does use ListenButton; pawn.ts:94-103 (quiz question 1-2 have no fen), pawn.ts:134-143 (long capture prompt); kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t1/t2: text-only question with 'Светлая / Тёмная' buttons
- **Principle:** Dual-coding and accessible instruction for pre-/early readers: every instruction should be speakable and have a picture; instructions must be 'show, don't tell' for 6-8-year-olds (also the product's own 'read aloud' pledge).
- **Impact:** The narration investment stops exactly when the child needs help most: when told what to do. A slow reader either guesses or asks a parent, so the platform loses its independence.
- **Skeptic:** On /chess/pawn#exercise-1 and #exercise-2 there are 0 listen buttons (the only ListenButton in the chess level code is the legend, ChessLevelView.tsx:203). The ExerciseShell prompt is RichText only (ChessExercises.tsx:52-54). Exercise 2 (hash #exercise-2), question 1, reads 'Какого цвета клетка h1 — в правом нижнем углу доски?' with only 'Светлая / Тёмная' buttons and no board (my screenshot hint.png and the page text dump). Prompts such as 'Пешка берёт' are long (pawn.ts:134-138).

#### CHESS-4 · major · confirmed — Exercise hint is one all-at-once text block (not the 'hints open one by one' ladder used in maths), with no way to show the answer or highlight on the board

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** ExerciseShell offers a single 'Подсказка' button that reveals the whole hint in a single click (ChessExercises.tsx:65-76). The maths tasks have a proper 5-step HintLadder with a thinking pause (HintLadder.tsx:17-60), and the owner's principle is 'hints open one by one'. In chess the hint is plain text, never points at the board, and is the only help. There is no 'Show me' fallback and no easier version.
- **Evidence:** ChessExercises.tsx:40,65-76 (single boolean 'hint'); HintLadder.tsx comment 'Лестница из 5 подсказок … открываются по одной'; kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t2: 'Подсказка' is a small grey ghost button at the bottom of the card, below the answer buttons; pawn.ts:146-156 (the level-1 'Путь в ферзи' hint needs capture-promotion reasoning); grep: settings.hintPause is read only in HintLadder.tsx and the settings panels, never in chess
- **Principle:** Scaffolding / zone of proximal development: help should come in graduated steps (nudge, narrower, almost-the-answer), and strong hints should be visual for young children.
- **Impact:** Hard exercises (promotion puzzle, 'pawn-blocked' with two blockers) are either solved by luck or abandoned. Hint-seeking children get either nothing or the entire idea at once. The product's own principle is broken in the school that most needs it.
- **Skeptic:** ExerciseShell has one boolean `hint` (ChessExercises.tsx:40,65-76). One click on '💡 Подсказка' reveals the whole hint and the button disappears (reproduced; the hint button counts 0 afterwards). The button is 119x36 px. settings.hintPause is read only in HintLadder.tsx and the settings panels. Support: OpeningsView.tsx:359 already marks the expected square after 2 misses, so a board-visible hint exists elsewhere but not in exercises. The 'Путь в ферзи' hint (pawn.ts:154) is close to giving the answer, so the all-at-once problem is real there.

#### CHESS-5 · minor · partly — Rank gating is all-or-nothing: all 7 exercises (including a puzzle) must be solved for the 7-year-old to unlock the next level, with no partial reward

- **Who:** AZIZ
- **Problem:** For the junior profile only level 1 is open (age.ts:41); level n+1 opens only when every exercise of level n is solved (chessProgress.ts:24). Level 1 ends with exercises of unequal difficulty (a colour quiz, then 'Пешка упёрлась', 'Пешка берёт', 'Путь в ферзи' with capture-promotion). The hub rank only changes at 100%; there is no 'half-way' star or checkpoint. Exercises can be skipped freely, but the lock still waits for them. A parent can override with 'open all', but a child cannot.
- **Evidence:** chessProgress.ts:20-25 (passed = solved === total; unlocked = i < open || previous.passed); pawn.ts:123-156 (blocked, capture, promotion exercises); only 1 hint level per CHESS-4; ChessSchool.tsx:223-258 hero shows only rank + overall bar; no mid-level reward; rich-phone-chess-t6: level progress 7 из 7 / 0 из 7 bars
- **Principle:** Mastery learning needs a path that adapts: minimum-viable progression with intermediate wins (small, frequent rewards) prevents discouragement for the 6-8 band; a stuck child should have a safe alternative, not a closed door.
- **Impact:** Aziz can be stuck for days on one exercise with the Knight, Bishop and Rook levels locked, and the platform records only the miss. This is the closest thing to a blocker in the flow and it is invisible until a child hits it.
- **Skeptic:** The gating rule is real (chessProgress.ts:20-25: passed = solved===total, unlocked = i<open || previous passed; junior openLevels=1). The 'closest to a blocker' and 'stuck for days' framing is speculative and overstated. Every exercise can be retried without penalty. Level 1 is mostly a recognition quiz, find-square and move exercises. Only 'Путь в ферзи' is hard, and its hint nearly gives the answer. The other hub sections (play, puzzles, drills, openings) are not gated. A parent override exists (chessOpenAll). The missing mid-level reward is a design gap, not a closed door. No evidence of a real stuck child was shown.

#### CHESS-6 · major · confirmed — Encyclopedia page is broken on a phone: the layout is 869 px wide on a 412 px screen, so the page renders at about half size

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA, PARENT
- **Problem:** On /chess/history, document scrollWidth and innerWidth are 869 on a Pixel 7 (visual viewport 412). The page therefore zooms out to fit, and all text appears at roughly 47% (the screenshot shows content filling only the left half of a 2000-px canvas). The cause is the image credits list: each li is 837 px wide because the grid is not constrained and a child span is 'truncate' with an unbounded min-content width (Figure.tsx:121-133). The same page is also the longest in the section.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-history-t1 / t4: content occupies the left ~47% of a 2000-px wide tile; metrics 'phone /chess/history': vh 1770 (vs 839 on other pages), ratio 13.5, interactive 133, small44 133, tiny32 120, textUnder14 402 (minFs 11 x 309); Playwright: innerWidth 869 / visualViewport.width 412; li.flex.items-center.gap-2 width 837, right edge 869; Figure.tsx:121-133 ImageCredits ul uses grid without minmax(0,1fr); metrics 'desk /chess/history': ratio 16.1, 766 text nodes
- **Principle:** Responsive layout must never exceed the viewport (WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow); touch targets 44x44 (WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple HIG). Long reference text needs chunking for 7-10-year-olds.
- **Impact:** The Encyclopedia is unreadable and untappable on the main target device unless the child pinches. 120 of 133 targets are under 32 px at that zoom. Aziz cannot use the page at all.
- **Skeptic:** Reproduced on Pixel 7 at age 7 and age 9: innerWidth=869, scrollWidth=869, visualViewport 412 (about 47%), scrollHeight 23850. The culprit is the ImageCredits ul with 63 li items, each 837 px wide (right edge 869). Injecting `ul.grid{display:none}` brings the width back to 412/412. The table is not the cause, because its parent has overflow-x-auto. The cause matches Figure.tsx:121-133 (grid without minmax(0,1fr), truncate child). Screenshot rich-phone-history-t1 shows content in the left half of a 2281-px canvas. The metrics file has hOverflow False, so the audit's own detector missed this. Severity stays major (not core flow, but unreadable at 100% on the target device).

#### CHESS-7 · minor · partly — Endgame school is a 15-screen scroll of 15 boards and 5,000+ characters, aimed at 11+ but shown to every age

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** The endgame page puts all lessons and all 15 drills on a single page (phone 12,887 px = 15.4 screens, 77 boards, about 5,278 characters). The hub card is shown to every profile. The topics (square rule, opposition, key squares) are abstract for 7-year-olds. Tasks are stacked rather than served one at a time ('Ход чёрных. Хитрая: пешка ещё на начальной клетке. Догонит ли король?'). The page shows board coordinate labels at 10.3 px and 294 text nodes under 14 px.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-endgames-t1 (four anchor chips, '0 из 15'), t5 (two nearly identical boards with 'Догонит / Не догонит' buttons stacked); metrics 'phone /chess/endgames': ratio 15.4, interactive 88, noName 54, textUnder14 294 (10.336 px x 240); ChessSchool.tsx:108-122 (Endgames card for all ages; no profile filter on the section list at :45-210); Playwright: body text length 5,278; scrollHeight 12,887
- **Principle:** Progressive disclosure and 'one clear thing at a time' (cognitive load for ages 6-10); age-appropriate content ladders; a long scroll with many repeated boards removes any sense of progress.
- **Impact:** A 7-year-old sees a card that suggests this is for him, opens a wall of material, and bounces. A 10-year-old can learn here but has no 'task 3 of 5' flow to keep momentum.
- **Skeptic:** Measurements confirmed: /chess/endgames is scrollHeight 12887 (15.4 screens), about 5278 characters, about 90 board elements, and textUnder14 294. The hub card is built without any age filter (ChessSchool.tsx:108-122). Overstated: 'aimed at 11+' and 'bounces' are inference, not evidence. The page has anchor chips and a '0 из 15' counter. It is a reference-style page, off the rank path, and the hub card says 'Начни с правила квадрата'. The one-task-at-a-time point is a fair UX improvement, not a major defect.

#### CHESS-8 · polish · partly — The rank banner stays at the top of a completed level forever and pushes the lesson down; the praise is repetitive

- **Who:** DILNOZA, AZIZ
- **Problem:** Once a level is passed, RankEarned sits above the tab bar on every visit (ChessLevelView.tsx:96), about 480 px tall on a phone, so returning to review a lesson puts tabs and content below it. At the moment of earning, the celebration is a static banner and a bottom XP toast; no sound or animation marks the biggest milestone. Praise on quizzes and square-finding is hard-wired to praise(0) (ChessExercises.tsx:105,612), so every time the text starts 'Ответ совпадает! 🎉', which is dry and robotic for a child.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-pawn-t1: banner 'Звание «Пешка» получено!' with two buttons occupies about 480 px above the 'Урок / Упражнения / Словарик' tabs; solvedlast.png (audit-agents/chess): banner + '+55 XP' toast overlapping the 'Правила пешки ✓ решено' title; feedback.ts:9 (praise list begins 'Ответ совпадает! 🎉'); live feedback text: 'Ответ совпадает! 🎉 Все ответы верные.'
- **Principle:** Peak-end rule: celebrate the milestone with a distinct, short moment, then get out of the way; vary positive reinforcement to avoid habituation; keep primary navigation stable.
- **Impact:** The best moment in the flow feels flat, and for a returning child the banner becomes clutter. Dilnoza, who wants to show her rank, has to scroll past it every time.
- **Skeptic:** The banner persists above the tabs on every visit once the level is passed (ChessLevelView.tsx:96). But its height is 184 CSS px, not '480 px': 480 is image pixels at DPR 2.625 (measured via Playwright: banner [438, 184]). The banner also holds 'Сертификат' and 'Уровень «Конь» →' CTAs, which are useful. praise(0) is hard-wired in only two places (ChessExercises.tsx:105 and :612); the others use praise(n) with 4 variants. 'No sound or animation' on the milestone was not verified. Dilnoza scrolling past about 184 px is minor.

#### CHESS-9 · minor · partly — Hub copy and controls are adult-register and small: 12 cards of 14-px grey text, 12-px stat lines, repeated icons, icon-only header

- **Who:** AZIZ
- **Problem:** Card descriptions are 15-20 words with jargon ('Подбираются по силам; задача дня, серия и «Дятел»', 'оппозиция, ключевые поля', 'робот оценит и покажет лучший ход'), set at text-sm in muted grey with text-xs stat lines (ChessSchool.tsx:277-278). Two cards use the same 🎯 emoji (Задачи and Координаты), and the shield, medal and robot icons are not distinctive. The hub hero intro is 45 words. The top bar uses three icon-only buttons (♞ ✍️ 🔒) measured at 36x34 and 42x34 px.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-chess-t2/t3/t4: card text in grey, 14 px, stat lines 12 px; metrics 'phone /chess': textUnder14 73, small44 12, tiny32 4; smallSamples: '♞Шахматы 36x34', '✍️Мои задачи 42x34', '🔒Родителям 42x34'; ChessSchool.tsx:62-65 and :133-135 (🎯 twice), :226 (hero about text)
- **Principle:** Plain-language and recognition over recall: cards for early readers need a big icon, a 2-4 word title and at most one short line; targets 44x44.
- **Impact:** Aziz navigates by the emoji only, and two identical emoji for two different sections leads to mistaps. Parents may read the cards, but the child is the user.
- **Skeptic:** Confirmed: sections text is text-sm text-muted and the stat is text-xs (ChessSchool.tsx:277-278); 🎯 is used for both Задачи and Координаты; card copy is long and jargon-heavy ('оппозиция, ключевые поля'). The header-button measurement (♞ 36x34, ✍️ 42x34, 🔒 42x34) is accurate but belongs to the global header, not the chess hub. The same samples appear on every page in the metrics, so it should not be scored as a chess-hub issue. The 45-word hero intro was not counted.

#### CHESS-10 · minor · confirmed — Curiosity features are buried: 'Знаешь ли ты?' is the last item on the hub, and Secrets headlines are 4 lines of all-caps small labels

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** DidYouKnow is in the right-hand aside, which on a phone stacks after the six level cards, so it appears at about y=5.5 screens (rich-phone-chess-t7). It is a great one-tap hook (question, listen, 'Показать ответ', 'Ещё вопрос'), but few children will ever see it. On the Secrets list each card has a 4-line headline followed by a 12-px ALL-CAPS label ('КАК ПРИДУМАЛИ ШАХМАТЫ: СКАЗАНИЕ О ДВУХ БРАТЬЯХ · «ШАХНАМЕ» · ЛЕГЕНДА ОБ ИНДИИ'), which is hard for slow readers.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-chess-t7: 'ЗНАЕШЬ ЛИ ТЫ?' card at the bottom, after the lock cards; rich-phone-secrets-t2: uppercase sub-labels at 12 px under 4-line titles; metrics 'phone /chess/secrets': small44 41, textUnder14 47; ChessSchool.tsx:367-368 (DidYouKnow in aside after levels); Secrets.tsx:152-154 (text-xs uppercase)
- **Principle:** Variable-reward curiosity loops work only if they are seen early; all-caps text reduces reading speed (esp. for beginners).
- **Impact:** The most 'fun' micro-feature is missed by the child who most needs a reason to come back, and the Secrets list is slower to scan than it needs to be.
- **Skeptic:** On the age 7 hub, 'Знаешь ли ты?' is at y=5249 of 6333 (about 6.3 screens down, after all levels). On /chess/secrets the sub-labels are uppercase 12 px ('Зерно, которое разорило царя · Индия · легенда'). Both checked in Playwright via computed text-transform and font-size. Not verified: the '4-line headline' count.

#### CHESS-11 · minor · partly — No mastery signal beyond 'solved': no stars, no clean-solve indicator, no way for Dilnoza to see or share improvement

- **Who:** DILNOZA, PARENT
- **Problem:** Each exercise is either solved or not. The store records misses (chessMiss) and best move-count for stars exercises, but the child never sees them; hints used are not recorded for chess exercises. There is no 'solved without a hint' star, no re-play for a better result, and the certificate button is visible only after 100% in a banner. The six ⭐ per level on the hub are decorative (level number), not earned.
- **Evidence:** store.ts:211-212 (misses stored); ChessExercises.tsx:351-355 (best only on stars exercise); ChessSchool.tsx:302 ('⭐'.repeat(level.order) is difficulty, not progress); ChessLevelView.tsx:96,281-283 (certificate only inside RankEarned); rich-phone-chess-t6: stars next to 'УРОВЕНЬ 2 · ⭐⭐' for a level the child has not started
- **Principle:** Competence feedback for 9-12-year-olds (self-determination theory): visible mastery and a reason to improve a result; avoid decorative symbols that look like rewards.
- **Impact:** A fluent, competitive child solves exercises once and has no reason to go back or to show anything to friends before the whole level is done. Parents see 'solved 7 of 43', not whether learning is solid.
- **Skeptic:** Confirmed: ⭐ x level.order on the hub is a difficulty marker, not progress (ChessSchool.tsx:302). Misses are stored (store.ts:211) but never shown. 'Certificate only after 100% in a banner' is wrong: Awards.tsx:138 also links certificateHref for earned ranks. The competition/mastery gap for Dilnoza is real, but it is a feature wish, not a defect.

#### CHESS-12 · polish · confirmed — Lesson step dots, hint button and small-print controls fall below touch-target size on level pages

- **Who:** AZIZ
- **Problem:** The four lesson step dots are 91x10 px, so they are hard to tap and give no label to a child (ChessLesson.tsx:65-76). 'Подсказка' is a ghost small button. Level pages measure 20 targets under 44 px and 11 under 32 px; the dictionary tab is a three-column text block (rules, glossary, 'Интересные факты') with no audio. These are polish items next to the issues above, but easy fixes.
- **Evidence:** Playwright: step dots 91x10 on /chess/pawn; metrics 'phone /chess/pawn': small44 20, tiny32 11, textUnder14 27 (11.56 px x 16 are board file/rank letters); ChessExercises.tsx:73 (size sm ghost); ChessLevelView.tsx:294-346 (Dictionary has no ListenButton); kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t2: pale 'Подсказка' under the answer buttons
- **Principle:** Fitts's law and motor-skill limits of young children: 44x44 px minimum, 8 px spacing; recorded voice for every text block aimed at the 6-8 band.
- **Impact:** Occasional mis-taps and a smaller feeling of control; low harm individually but they compound the 7-year-old's fatigue.
- **Skeptic:** Measured: the four step dots are 91x10 px (aria-label present, plus a 'Шаг N из M' text); the hint button is 119x36 px; /chess/pawn small44=20, tiny32=11 in the metrics. The Dictionary section has no ListenButton (only ChessLevelView.tsx:203, the legend). Polish level as stated.

**Missed by the auditor (found by the skeptic):**

- (major) Hub 'do this next' CTAs are dead or circular: the hero 'начни с уровня «Пешка»!' is plain text, and the daily-quest item 'Реши упражнение шахматной школы' links to /chess, the page the child is already on — Playwright on /chess (age 7, fresh): hero section has 0 links or buttons. TodayCard links inside the page are '/chess/puzzles#practice', '/' and '/chess' (the third is a 68 px tall row href=/chess while on /chess). Tapping the chess quest item from the chess hub does nothing visible. Screenshot hub7-quest and hub7-top show 'Звания пока нет — начни с уровня «Пешка»!' as unlinked text. This is the concrete form of the CHESS-1 gap, and the audit missed it.
- (polish) Board squares are unnamed focusable/interactive elements in mini-boards (hub 16, endgames 54), which makes boards unusable with assistive tech — Playwright: on /chess 16 interactive elements have no aria-label, text or title (DIV 33x33); on /chess/endgames 54 (DIV 35-37 px). Matches metrics noName 16 and 54. The audit quotes 54 only as supporting evidence, not as an issue. I did not check what the 33 px DIVs are (likely mini-board squares).
- (polish) Positive: lesson and legend narration, 'Следующее упражнение →' and the cross-link block 'Что ещё есть на этом уровне' (play, puzzles, openings, famous games) keep a child moving after the exercises. The audit should record them. — Exercise page text dump at age 7 (/chess/pawn#exercise-2) and screenshot hint.png: '← Назад / Следующее упражнение →' then four cross-link cards. The level hero progress ('0 из 7', '7 из 7') and the numbered 1-7 exercise tabs are big targets. The legend has 'Послушать легенду'.

### Solutions

#### CHESS-S1 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — Path-first chess hub: one big 'Continue' button and a 'you are here' road of six ranks

- **Addresses:** CHESS-1, CHESS-9, CHESS-10
- **Proposal:** Reorder the hub so the first screen answers 'what do I do now?'. Order becomes: slim hero (name + current rank piece), ONE large Continue card pointing to the next unsolved exercise or lesson of the current level, a horizontal/vertical rank road (Pawn to King) with a 'you are here' marker and the next piece as a silhouette, then the daily quest (TodayCard, collapsed to one line for age <10), then a 'More to explore' fold holding the 12 section cards. The hero progress bar stops saying 'solved 7 of 43' and instead shows progress to the NEXT rank ('3 of 7 until Knight'). For age >=11 the 'More' fold is open by default; for age 6-8 it is closed and only 4 sections are visible when opened (Play, Puzzles, Drills, Secrets) with Endgames/Analysis/Review/Openings/Encyclopedia under a nested 'For older players' fold. Continue target comes from a small pure function nextStep(levels, state) in chessProgress.ts: first unlocked level with unsolved exercises, then first unsolved exercise index; if the level has no lesson viewed yet, link to #lesson.
- **Revised after review:** Hub order: slim hero (piece + 'Привет, {name}!' + one short line; drop the 45-word 'about' from the child view) -> ONE Continue card (>=96 px, whole card is the link, piece icon, 'Продолжить', subline 'Пешка · Упражнение 3 из 7'; no audio button in release 1) -> compact rank road as a static 3x2 grid or vertical list of the 6 existing level cards (done = gold check, current = static ring + 'Ты здесь', further = dimmed; lock icon only on the next locked one; keep the respectful 'Откроется после...' text) -> TodayCard unchanged -> 'Ещё для любопытных' details with the section cards as 2-col tiles (icon + title + one short line, no stat line under 10). nextStep(levels, state) in chessProgress.ts: first level that is unlocked and not passed; if it has zero solved exercises link to #lesson, otherwise to #exercise-(first unsolved index+1); all passed -> 'Сыграть с роботом'; fresh profile -> 'Начать: Доска и фигуры'. Hero bar shows 'До звания «X»: N упражнений' where X is the first not-passed level. Fold open by default for senior (age 11+), closed for junior/middle with ONE level of folding only (no nested 'for older players'); Awards, Play, Puzzles, Drills, Secrets stay in the first visible row for junior. Fix the duplicate 🎯 (Puzzles and Coordinates). Never auto-start, no countdowns, no streak text in hero. Unit-test nextStep for fresh, mid, all-done and open-all states.
- **UI spec:** Phone 412 px. (1) Hero shrinks from ~600 px to ~150 px: rank piece 56 px + 'Привет, {name}!' (text-xl) + one 14-px-min line. The 45-word 'about' text is removed from the child view (kept in /parent or on a 'About the school' link). (2) Continue card directly under hero, full width, min-h 96 px, brand color, 72 px piece icon on left, title 'Продолжить' (text-2xl black), second line 'Пешка · Упражнение 3 из 7' (text-base), a 56-px round play button on the right, plus a 48-px speaker button with audio of the title. Whole card is one link (min 96x340 target). (3) Rank road: 6 nodes 64 px piece icons connected by a line; done = filled gold ring with check, current = pulsing ring (no pulse under prefers-reduced-motion) + small 'Ты здесь' tag, next = full-color, further = 40% opacity silhouette with lock only on the NEXT locked one; tapping a node goes to the level page. On phone the road is a horizontally scrollable snap strip auto-scrolled so the current node is centered; below it a single caption 'До звания «Конь»: 4 упражнения'. (4) 'More' fold: details/summary, 56 px tall header 'Ещё для любопытных', cards become 2-column icon tiles (icon 40 px, title text-lg, ONE line of max 6 words, no grey 15-word paragraph, no stat line for age<10). Fix duplicated 🎯 (Coordinates gets 🧭 or a grid icon), keep every tile >=88 px tall. (5) 'Знаешь ли ты?' becomes a single tile 'Вопрос дня' directly under the road (see CHESS-S11). States: fresh profile (no rank) shows Continue = 'Начать: Доска и фигуры'; all levels done shows 'Сыграть с роботом' as Continue; parent 'open all' still highlights the first unfinished level.
- **Copy:** RU: Продолжить · Пешка, упражнение 3 из 7 · Ты здесь · До звания «Конь»: 4 упражнения · Ещё для любопытных · Для тех, кто постарше / UZ: Davom etish · Piyoda, 3-mashq (7 tadan) · Sen shu yerdasan · «Ot» unvonigacha: 4 ta mashq · Qiziqqanlar uchun yana · Kattaroqlar uchun
- **Files:** src/components/chess/ChessSchool.tsx, src/lib/chessProgress.ts, src/components/progress/TodayCard.tsx, src/lib/age.ts, src/components/ui.tsx, tests/ (unit test for nextStep), e2e/ (hub path test)
- **Inspired by:** ChessKid Adventure / Mathseeds world map (journey with 'you are here'), Hick's law and goal-gradient (progress toward the NEXT milestone), Khan Academy Kids one-obvious-next-step; digest patterns 'Progress as a journey', 'One obvious next step per screen'.
- **Guardrails:** Continue is a convenience, not an autoplay chain: it never auto-starts anything and never changes after a delay. No countdown, no 'only today' framing, no streak threat in the hero. The road shows what is next, not what the child 'lost'; locked nodes use the existing respectful 'Откроется после...' text. Do not add a 'you are behind' message. No rating or accuracy numbers; progress is counts of exercises only. Keep the 'More' fold fully reachable for Dilnoza (open by default at 11+, one tap otherwise) so nothing is hidden for competitive older kids. Use the code's Uzbek apostrophe convention (oʻ, gʻ as the codebase writes them) when copy is added to the t(ru, uz) pairs.
- **Test plan:** Playwright Pixel 7, age 7 and age 9 seeds: Continue card fully inside first 839 px viewport; rank road visible without scrolling past 1.3 screens; hub page height drops from 7.5 viewports to <=3 (target; metric 'phone /chess' ratio) and interactive elements above the fold <=8; unit test nextStep for fresh/mid/all-done/parent-open-all states; verify all 12 sections remain reachable in <=2 taps; check Uzbek strings do not wrap past 2 lines at 412 px (richuz-phone-chess); small44 on /chess goes from 12 to 0 for child-facing controls; 5 real children (6-8) run: time-to-first-board-touch from hub, target <20 s.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. Right diagnosis, verified: ChessSchool.tsx renders hero (about text, 'Упражнений решено 0 из 43'), TodayCard, 13 equal section cards, and only then the level cards plus 'Знаешь ли ты?' in the aside (kid7-phone-chess-t1 shows the hero alone is ~1450 px tall at 1082 px width, no 'next step' anywhere; metrics 'phone /chess' ratio 7.5). Continue card + 'you are here' road is the best single change in this batch and fits Aziz. But the spec over-builds: nested folds for 6-8, a horizontally scrolling snap strip (hides ranks, needs auto-scroll JS), a pulsing ring, a speaker button that needs a new recorded clip per Continue title (none exists; ListenButton hides without a clip), and nextStep() depends on 'lesson viewed', which is not stored anywhere (grep finds no lessonViewed state). The junior 'only 4 sections' list omits Awards (medals/certificates, which children like) and Diary.

#### CHESS-S2 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — Child-sized controls: 48/56 px tap tokens, labelled header, bigger step dots, readable card text

- **Addresses:** CHESS-9, CHESS-12
- **Proposal:** Introduce two CSS tokens (--tap-min 48 px for all, --tap-kid 56 px for primary actions when age <10 or bigText) in globals.css and apply them in ui.tsx Button sizes, ListenButton, lesson step dots, exercise number chips, header icons and hub cards. Header (SiteHeader.tsx) shows an icon plus a visible one-word label under it for age <10 (Шахматы / Мои задачи), and 'Родителям' is moved away from the main row (end of the bar, 48 px, word visible). Lesson step dots become 44-px-tall hit areas (visible dot stays 10 px via padding/::after) with the step number inside the active one. Minimum body/caption size 14 px for child-facing text (hub stat lines, board coordinate letters excepted but raised to 12 px bold). Replace text-xs uppercase sub-labels (Secrets) with sentence case 14 px.
- **Revised after review:** 1) Raise Button 'sm' to min-h-11 (44 px) and 'md' to min-h-12; ListenButton to min-h-11 with a 24 px speaker icon. 2) Make header links 44x44 hit areas by padding only (no visible labels, keep aria-label/title); keep the lock quiet and last in the nav. 3) Lesson step dots: each button h-11 flex-1 with the visible 10-px bar drawn by an inner span; role=group/tablist and aria-current stay. 4) 'Подсказка' becomes a 48-px outlined button (visual coordination with S5). 5) Raise text-xs stat/sub-labels on child-facing chess pages to text-sm (14 px); raise board coordinate letters to 12 px bold. 6) Keep 8 px gaps between answer buttons. Drop the sound-wave animation, the 56-px 'kid' ListenButton variant and the header labels. Target metrics: phone /chess small44 12 -> <=3, /chess/pawn 20 -> <=5, tiny32 -> 0.
- **UI spec:** Button size 'sm' min-h 44 px (was ~36), 'md' 52 px, new 'kid' 60 px with text-lg; 8-px minimum gap between neighbours. ListenButton min-h 48 px, speaker icon 24 px; on lesson/exercise cards at age <10 a 'kid' variant: pill 56 px tall, speaker + word, sound-wave bars animate (3 bars, 600 ms loop) while playing, stop toggle on second tap. Step dots: container role=tablist, each button h-11 flex-1 with inner bar h-2.5 and a number badge on the current one. Header icons: 48x48 hit area, label text-xs->text-sm (14 px) under icon, bottom-edge dead zone 16 px for sticky bars. 'Подсказка' becomes a 48-px outlined button with a lightbulb, same width as the answer buttons (not a ghost link). Keep 8 px spacing between answer buttons.
- **Copy:** RU: Шахматы · Мои задачи · Родителям · 💡 Подсказка / UZ: Shaxmat · Mening masalalarim · Ota-onalarga · 💡 Maslahat
- **Files:** src/app/globals.css, src/components/ui.tsx, src/components/ListenButton.tsx, src/components/SiteHeader.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLesson.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessExercises.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLevelView.tsx, src/components/chess/Secrets.tsx
- **Inspired by:** NN/g children and physical development (large targets, tap before drag), WCAG 2.5.5, Fitts's law; digest patterns 'Touch targets and gestures sized for the youngest', 'Icon plus word'.
- **Guardrails:** Larger targets must not push the main action below the fold: reduce vertical padding elsewhere instead of stacking more rows. Do not enlarge the parent lock to look inviting; it stays visually quiet, only touch-safe. The sound-wave animation is decorative, short and respects prefers-reduced-motion. No attention-grabbing pulsing buttons.
- **Test plan:** Re-run the audit-metrics script: small44 on 'phone /chess' 12 -> 0, '/chess/pawn' 20 -> <=3 (board squares excluded), tiny32 11 -> 0, header samples >=48x48; textUnder14 for child-facing text on /chess from 73 to <=10 (board letters only). Visual regression at 412 px for ru and uz (labels fit in one line). Manual: 3 children aged 6-8 tap each dot/chip/answer 5 times, count mis-taps (target <1 in 20).
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Evidence is real: ui.tsx:26 sets Button 'sm' to min-h-9 (36 px), ListenButton is min-h-9, SiteHeader links are text-sm px-2.5 py-2 (about 36x34), ChessLesson step dots are h-2.5 (10 px) with no hit area, and the Подсказка button is ghost 'sm' (ChessExercises.tsx:72). Metrics: phone /chess small44 12, /chess/pawn small44 20 and tiny32 11, secrets small44 41. Fixing tap size is high value for Aziz on a 6.3-inch phone and is mostly a few class changes. However the header idea does not fit: the header row is already full at 412 px (logo + 3 icons + RU/UZ, see kid7-phone-chess-t1 and richuz-phone-chess-t1); visible 14-px labels under three icons would force a taller or scrolling header. The icons already have aria-label and title. Moving the parent lock and giving it a visible word contradicts the proposal's own guardrail that the lock stays quiet. Wave-bar animation and a 'kid' variant of ListenButton are decoration.

#### CHESS-S3 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — Level page: board first, legend as a tap-to-open story card, rank banner collapses after the celebration

- **Addresses:** CHESS-2, CHESS-8
- **Proposal:** Change the level page so the first thing after the tab bar is the lesson (or Continue), not the legend. Move LevelLegend out of the lesson flow into a compact story card that is closed by default for age <10 ('Легенда уровня' with portrait thumbnail 64 px, one-line hook, a 56 px 'Послушать' button). On open it expands in place; the four paragraphs are split into 4 short screens 'Дальше' with the portrait shown at 160 px max. Inside a lesson card on phones, put the DemoBoard ABOVE the text (order-first on <md) so the child sees the highlighted square the text talks about, and show only the first 1-2 text blocks with a 'Ещё' expander for the rest; the voice button is the first control. RankEarned: shown full only on the visit when it is earned (session flag) and is then collapsed to a 56 px slim bar ('Звание «Пешка» ✓ · Сертификат') on later visits, placed under the tab bar.
- **Revised after review:** On the level page: (1) in ChessLesson put DemoBoard first on <md (order-first) with a one-line caption, then title + Listen button, then the paragraphs; keep all text, no 'Ещё' expander. (2) Move LevelLegend below the lesson/tabs content for everyone and render it collapsed for age <10: an 88-px row with portrait thumbnail 64 px, the one-line hook and a Listen button (existing legend-{id}.mp3), opening in place. (3) RankEarned: render the full banner only when a level flips to passed during the current visit (compare previous passed with useRef; no stored flag), otherwise a slim 56-px bar 'Звание «Пешка» ✓' with a 48-px 'Сертификат' button, placed under the tab bar. No confetti or new sound; the existing praise clip and XP toast stay. (4) Move the XP toast above bottom UI with a 16 px margin. Test: age 7 on /chess/pawn, first h3 y <=900 px, DemoBoard top <=620 px, certificate reachable in one tap.
- **UI spec:** Phone: [level hero 120 px] -> [tabs 56 px] -> lesson card. Lesson card: step strip (see S2), 'Шаг 2 из 4' + title + 56 px Listen pill on one row, DemoBoard full width (>=360 px square, taps give legal-move dots), caption 1 sentence under board, then 'Ещё' expander for the extra paragraphs, then Back/Next row (Next is the primary 56 px button). Legend card closed: 88 px tall row. RankEarned slim bar: gold left border, piece icon 36 px, text, 'Сертификат' 48 px button; tap on bar expands the full banner. Celebration moment (first time only): full-width banner animates in 400 ms with a one-shot confetti of 12 pieces (2 s, no loop, skippable by tap), plays a 1-second soft chime if sound is on, and the XP toast no longer overlaps the exercise title (toast positioned above the bottom bar with 16 px margin).
- **Copy:** RU: Легенда уровня · Послушать историю · Дальше · Ещё · Звание «Пешка» ✓ · Сертификат / UZ: Daraja afsonasi · Hikoyani tinglash · Keyingisi · Yana · «Piyoda» unvoni ✓ · Sertifikat
- **Files:** src/components/chess/ChessLevelView.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLesson.tsx, src/components/chess/Figure.tsx, src/lib/store.ts (flag rankSeen[levelId]), src/lib/feedback.ts
- **Inspired by:** Mayer's signaling/segmenting principles, Lichess interactive lesson player (one thing per screen), peak-end rule for the rank moment; digest 'Short instructions: icon plus audio' and 'One short, skippable celebration per round'.
- **Guardrails:** Nothing is removed for curious kids: the legend remains one tap away and is still narrated. The celebration is shown once, is skippable, short, and non-looping; no repeated animation on every visit. Reward text names the achievement (rank earned) not ability ('умница' is avoided). The collapsed banner must still let Dilnoza reach the certificate in one tap.
- **Test plan:** Playwright age 7 on /chess/pawn: first h3 y from 1887 px to <=900 px; DemoBoard top <=620 px on step 1; no horizontal overflow; step 1 text visible without scrolling past the board. rankSeen flag test: full banner once, slim bar after reload. Check XP toast does not overlap title (screenshot diff). Manual with Aziz-like testers: time from opening level to first piece tap, target <25 s (baseline: 3-4 screens of scroll).
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. Verified in code: ChessLevelView.tsx:128-132 renders LevelLegend before ChessLesson, and ChessLesson.tsx:77-92 puts the text column before the demo board (grid only from md), so on a phone the highlighted square appears after about 70 words (kid7-phone-pawn-t2 shows a full screen of legend text still going). RankEarned at ChessLevelView:96 sits above the tab bar on every visit. The core of the proposal (board before text on phones, legend as a collapsed card that keeps its narration, compact rank bar) is sound and cheap. Too much is bolted on: splitting the legend into 4 screens, a 'Ещё' expander that hides lesson text while the recording reads all of it, a confetti piece + chime (new assets) for a moment the app already marks with XP toast and a praise clip, and a stored rankSeen flag that needs a state field plus a sync.ts merge for a 'show once' effect that can be derived.

#### CHESS-S4 · modify · effort L · impact 5 — Exercises you can hear and see: recorded prompt on every exercise, a board for every colour question, icon-first answer buttons

- **Addresses:** CHESS-3
- **Proposal:** Add a ListenButton to ExerciseShell using a new clip kind 'exercises' (same pipeline as 'tasks'/'lessons': recorded map keyed by exercise id + prompt fingerprint in voiceText.ts, mp3 in public/audio/exercises and public/audio/uz/exercises, generated with the existing ElevenLabs workflow). Read only: title + prompt (not why/hint) for the first release; then add short recorded 'why' lines. For quiz questions without a FEN (h1/a1 square colour), show the board with the named square pulsing softly and answer buttons rendered as two big colour chips (light/dark square swatch + word) instead of text-only buttons. Keep the existing ex.prompt for older kids. Exercise cards start with the speaker button first, then the title, then a 1-line prompt, then the board.

Record levels 1-2 first (14 exercises), ru then uz. Skip promptShort: shorten any prompt over ~20 words at source in both languages instead, and let audio carry the load. Colour-quiz questions get an empty-board fen with the named square marked (ChessBoard already supports marks) and answer buttons with a light/dark swatch + word, 64 px tall, neutral feedback. Drop the one-time tooltip. Make Feedback readable for screen readers (already aria-live) and scroll it into view when it appears below the fold. Create the missing generation script in scripts/ as part of the task.

Board directly below (full width). For colour quiz: board 100% width with target square outlined in brand color; two answer buttons, each 72 px tall, with a 40 px swatch (cream #f0d9b5 / brown #b58863) and word 'Светлая' / 'Тёмная'; selecting gives soft feedback (no red). Audio is tap-to-play (no autoplay) with a one-time tooltip 'Нажми, чтобы послушать' on the first ever exercise only. If no clip exists in the UI language the button hides (existing rule); a build check lists exercises lacking clips. Feedback line is also readable: Feedback() gets aria-live=polite and scrolls into view when it appears below the fold.
- **Copy:** RU: Послушать задание · Светлая · Тёмная · Нажми, чтобы послушать / UZ: Topshiriqni tinglash · Och rangli · Toʻq rangli · Tinglash uchun bos
- **Files:** src/components/chess/ChessExercises.tsx, src/lib/voice.ts, src/lib/voiceText.ts, src/content/chess/*.ts (promptShort field, types.ts), public/audio/exercises, public/audio/uz/exercises, scripts/ (new clip generation script mirroring the lesson one), src/lib/feedback.ts
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo ABC / Khan Academy Kids voice-first instructions, dual coding, NN/g 'long instructions go unread'; digest patterns 'Audio-first', 'Short instructions: icon plus audio'.
- **Guardrails:** Audio only plays on a tap (no autoplay on a shared parent phone; respects the existing sound setting). No browser speech: only recorded voice. This addresses the biggest gap for Aziz and it is verified: Playwright on /chess/pawn#exercise-2 finds zero 'Послушать' buttons, ExerciseShell (ChessExercises.tsx:36-80) has no ListenButton, and prompts like the pawn-capture one are 25+ words. The colour-quiz point also checks out: QuizExercise renders a board only when q.fen is set (line ~533), and the first two level-1 questions (h1, a1 colour) have none.
