The suggested fix (min-w-0 on the table parent, turn champions into cards) would not fix the page. Metric false-negative (hOverflow:false) is true. Other audited phone pages (/, /chess, /chess/pawn, /chess/play, /chess/secrets, /chess/awards, /chess/endgames) have scrollWidth=412.

#### VIS-2 · minor · partly — No thumb-zone or labelled global navigation on phones; the header is icon-only with 34px targets

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** The only persistent navigation is a sticky top header whose links collapse to bare emoji glyphs (♞ ✍️ 🔒) on phones. They are about 36-42px wide and 34px tall, and their labels are hidden. Home is only the logo. On deep pages (play, drills, puzzles, pawn) the way back is a small text link at the very top-left, the least reachable spot for a thumb. The sticky bottom bar exists only inside a day session.
- **Evidence:** audit-metrics smallSamples on every phone page: '♞Шахматы 36x34', '✍️Мои задачи 42x34', '🔒Родителям 42x34', and the logo link 129x40.; SiteHeader.tsx:34-36: `<span className="hidden sm:inline">{label}</span>` hides all labels below 640px; `py-2 text-sm` gives the 34px height at :17.; Screenshots: rich-phone-home-t1.jpg, kid7-phone-drills-t1.jpg (back link '← Шахматная школа' at y≈255px of 1082), kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t2.jpg.; DaySession.tsx:83 is the only `fixed bottom-0` nav in src.
- **Principle:** Fitts's law and thumb-zone reachability (primary navigation within the bottom 40% of the screen); recognition over recall; a non-reader needs icon plus label. Khan Kids and ChessKid use a labelled bottom tab bar.
- **Impact:** Aziz must reach to the top corner and guess what an unlabelled glyph does. Pre-readers hit '✍️' and '🔒' blindly. A bottom tab bar with 4 large labelled tabs (Математика, Шахматы, Награды, Родителям) would fix reachability for every screen.
- **Skeptic:** Measured: header links 36x34, 42x34, 42x34, logo 129x40, RU/UZ 33x32; labels hidden below sm (SiteHeader.tsx:34-36); no bottom nav except DaySession.tsx:83. But header links do carry aria-label/title and the active section is highlighted (kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t1.jpg shows tinted chip), and the glyphs are standard (knight, pencil, lock) with only 3 items. 'Blind guessing' is speculation, no evidence of confusion. The back link '← Шахматная школа' is real (y=88 CSS px, but its box is only 146x20, see missed items). A bottom tab bar is a design preference, not a demonstrated defect.

#### VIS-3 · minor · partly — Chrome and heroes push the actual task below the first screen; the home page is nine screens long

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** On chess level pages the dark hero (about 413px) plus tabs plus number chips fill the first screen, and the exercise is below the fold. On the home page the order is hero, a 700px 'Мои привычки' card, and only then the daily quest and XP. The child's goal on arrival, 'play now' or 'see my progress', is not above the fold.
- **Evidence:** Phone viewport height is 1770/2.625 ≈ 674 CSS px (metrics vh). In kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t1.jpg the question 'Какого цвета клетка h1' starts at y≈1820/2.625 ≈ 693px, i.e. below the first screen. The board follows below that.; rich-phone-home-t2.jpg and t3.jpg: 'Привычки мыслителя' is ~7 dashed rows plus Week 2/3 icon rows in greyscale; 'Задание дня' begins around 1,370 CSS px down; XP/streak at ~1,600px.; audit-metrics: phone / ratio 9.1 (7,594px), /chess 7.5, /chess/history 13.5, /chess/endgames 15.4, /chess/puzzles 6.8.; Home hero 'Начать' (rich-phone-home-t1.jpg) is ~130px wide, not full width.
- **Principle:** Progressive disclosure and 'one clear thing at a time' for an attention span of about 10 minutes (Aziz). Content above the fold should be the main action; hierarchy follows what the child came to do.
- **Impact:** Aziz opens the exercise tab and sees a banner. The task's first line is under his thumb, and the page may look empty of interaction. Compact the level hero to a one-line sticky header after first view, move 'Привычки' below 'Задание дня' or make it a collapsed row, and make 'Начать' full-width.
- **Skeptic:** Overstated. Real part: home is 7594px tall (ratio 9.05 on the 839px viewport) and the 'Мои привычки' card (7 dashed rows + two greyscale icon rows, rich-phone-home-t2.jpg) sits between hero and the daily quest; hero 'Начать' is ~340/1082 px wide (130 CSS px), not full width. Wrong part: the viewport is 839 CSS px, not 674 (metrics vh=839; 1770 is a stray full-page value for one page), so 'Начать' (y~507 CSS px, rich-phone-home-t1.jpg) and the first pawn exercise question (y~693 CSS) are INSIDE the first screen; the chess hero is ~282 CSS px (740/2.625), not 413. Only the board is below the fold on chess exercises. The home page's primary action is above the fold.

#### VIS-4 · major · partly — Tap targets below 44px are widespread, including chess exercise board squares at about 35px

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** Many controls fall under 44px and, in places, under 32px. The 'sm' button is 36px (min-h-9), the task-dot buttons are about 40px, header links are 34px, and board squares in exercise cards are about 35px because the board is nested in extra padding. On the play page the same board is about 44px per square.
- **Evidence:** audit-metrics small44/tiny32: /chess/history 133/120, /chess/play 37/1, /chess/secrets 41/1, /chess/pawn 20/11, /chess/knight 20/10, /chess/analysis 16/2, /chess/endgames 21/1; day pages 11-14 each.; ui.tsx:23 `sm: 'min-h-9 px-3 py-1 text-sm ...'` (36px).; Board widths: rich-phone-endgames-t3.jpg exercise board ≈798px/1082 (304 CSS px, squares ≈35px, with card padding) vs kid7-phone-game-robot-t1.jpg board ≈997px/1082 (380 CSS px, squares ≈44px).; task-vp.png: task dots about 94px wide at scale 2.386 → ≈40 CSS px.
- **Principle:** WCAG 2.5.5 (44px) and child motor-control research (children's fine motor accuracy lags adults; 7-year-olds need 48px+). Chess requires precise tap and hold, so squares are critical.
- **Impact:** Mis-taps on pieces and squares cause wrong-move frustration that is not the child's fault. Raise 'sm' to 44, give exercise boards the full card width (remove card inset or use negative margins), and give small links 44px hit areas without changing visuals.
- **Skeptic:** Small targets are real: Button size sm = min-h-9 (ui.tsx:26), measured 'Прочитать' 122x36, header 34px high, task dots 40x40, small44 counts as cited (pawn 20, play 37, history 133). BUT the specific board claim is refuted for chess exercises: on /chess/pawn Упражнения the board is 348px and each square is 43.5x43.5 (same as play), inside a card with only p-1 (372 of 380px). Only /chess/endgames boards are small (284-299px, squares 37.4px). Also WCAG 2.5.5 is AAA; AA 2.5.8 is 24px, so most of the 'tiny32' hits are credits/links on history, not child controls.

#### VIS-5 · minor · partly — Task screen: ambiguous primary action, toast covers 'Next', feedback sits under the fixed bar

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** On a task page two identical indigo primary buttons compete: 'Проверить' (about 145px wide, left-aligned in the answer panel) and 'Дальше →' (fixed bar, always enabled). The disabled state of 'Проверить' is a washed-out lavender at 45% opacity that looks broken and gives no reason. After a correct answer 'Проверить' stays active-looking while the real next step is 'Дальше'. The '+15 XP' toast is fixed right-4 bottom-4 and sits directly on top of 'Дальше' for 1.8s, hiding the label at the moment the child wants to continue. The feedback card appears below the answer button and is partly hidden under the fixed bar.
- **Evidence:** task-vp.png, task-wrong.png, task-right.png (my Playwright run, age 7): 'Проверить' left-aligned and short; feedback card 'Давай проверим твою идею!' and 'Так и есть!' cut by the bottom bar at y≈1835/2000.; task-right.png: orange '+15 XP ⭐' badge covers the 'Дальше' button.; XpToast.tsx:35 `fixed right-4 bottom-4 z-50` vs DaySession.tsx:83 bar `fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-20`; Button disabled style ui.tsx:35 `disabled:opacity-45`.; kid7-phone-day1-t1-t2.jpg shows the bar over the hint block.
- **Principle:** One primary action per state (Hick's law, clear affordance); feedback must be visible next to the action (proximity); do not cover a target with transient UI.
- **Impact:** Aziz may press 'Дальше' without checking, or not see the success message at all. Make 'Проверить' full-width and morph it into 'Дальше' after success, keep one primary colour at a time, add bottom padding equal to the bar height, and move the XP toast above the bar or into the feedback card.
- **Skeptic:** Confirmed on a live run (age 7, task 1): disabled 'Проверить' is a washed-out lavender 145x56, left-aligned, with no reason shown (t1.png). After a correct answer the +15 XP toast (123x44 at x=274,y=779) sits exactly over 'Дальше' (112x44 at x=284,y=783) for 1.8s (right.png), and 'Проверить' stays full indigo after success. But: toast is pointer-events-none so it does not block taps; 'Дальше' is plain navigation, not an answer-check, so 'two competing primaries' is a style issue, not a functional trap; the feedback card is just below the fold at scroll-top and fully visible when scrolled (t1-bottom.png shows content clears the bar; no content permanently hidden). Only the temporary XP overlap and the weak disabled state are solid.

#### VIS-6 · minor · partly — Too much 11-14px text and ALL-CAPS labels for early readers

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** Large parts of the chess and award pages use 11-13px text, and eyebrow labels are uppercase with tracking, sometimes spanning three lines. Uppercase words lose their silhouette and slow decoding for a child who finishes a sentence 'with difficulty'. Credits, captions, meta lines and chips are 12px.
- **Evidence:** audit-metrics textUnder14: /chess/history 402 (minFs 11px ×309, 12px ×93), /chess/endgames 294, /chess/chess 73, /chess/awards 70, / 63, /chess/puzzles 59, /chess/openings 56, /chess/secrets 47.; `text-xs` is used 87 times in src (grep) and 6 more arbitrary 10-13px sizes; Encyclopedia.tsx:151, 185, 201, 234.; rich-phone-secrets-t1.jpg: 'ЗЕРНО, КОТОРОЕ РАЗОРИЛО ЦАРЯ · ИНДИЯ · ЛЕГЕНДА' and 'ЗАГАДКА ИНДИЙСКОГО ПОСЛА · «ШАХНАМЕ» · ПЕРСИЯ, ОКОЛО 1010 ГОДА — О СОБЫТИЯХ VI ВЕКА' in 3-line caps.; kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t2.jpg: 'ИГРАТЬ', 'ЗАДАЧИ', 'ДЕБЮТЫ' small caps labels.
- **Principle:** Minimum 14-16px for child body copy (Nielsen Norman Group, kids' usability studies); sentence-case aids word-shape recognition; do not rely on tiny text for meaning.
- **Impact:** Aziz cannot read the secondary text at all and gets no value from it. Set a floor of 14px (16px for ≤8 age), replace uppercase eyebrows with sentence-case or an icon, and shorten the secrets meta line.
- **Skeptic:** Metrics hold (history 402 text nodes <14px, 11px x309; endgames 294; text-xs 87 uses; uppercase 59 uses) and caps eyebrows exist (rich-phone-secrets-t1.jpg: 'ЗЕРНО, КОТОРОЕ РАЗОРИЛО ЦАРЯ · ИНДИЯ · ЛЕГЕНДА' two lines, 'ЗАГАДКА ИНДИЙСКОГО ПОСЛА ... VI ВЕКА' three lines of caps). But they are secondary meta lines under 22px bold question titles; the task body text on the task page is ~20px and clear (t1.png). Much of the sub-14 count is credits/captions and board-coordinate labels (endgames 10.3px x240, 10.9px x48), not child body copy. 'Aziz gets no value' is an assumption.

#### VIS-7 · polish · partly — Card-on-card nesting up to four levels; inner cards waste width and shrink content

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** The answer area is a lavender-bordered panel containing a white card containing a grey input well. The hint block is another yellow panel. Chess exercises sit in a tab panel card containing a question card containing the board with its frame, so each level steals about 26px of width and adds borders and shadows that compete with the actual task.
- **Evidence:** task-vp.png: 'Мой ответ' panel (y≈1090-1715) → white card (1230-1460) → input well (1320-1435); the task statement is in yet another white card above.; kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t1.jpg: question card inset to x=52 vs page cards x=42; rich-phone-endgames-t3.jpg shows a question card inside a card, board narrower than the play page's.; ui.tsx:55 Card always uses `rounded-3xl border bg-white shadow-card`, so nested cards double borders and shadows.
- **Principle:** Reduce visual noise and container depth; gestalt grouping should use whitespace rather than boxes. Every extra border increases cognitive load for a young reader.
- **Impact:** The screen feels busy and the real content (task, board) gets less space on a 412px screen. Use one card per screen section, and a flat divider or a tinted background for inner groups.
- **Skeptic:** Task page nesting is real (t1.png: task card, then lavender 'Мой ответ' panel containing a white card containing a grey input well, plus a yellow hint panel). But the chess claim is overstated: in pawn exercises the question card sits in a card with p-1, losing only ~8px (board 372px of 412), not 26px per level. Visual busyness is a taste judgment; no function is impaired.

#### VIS-8 · minor · confirmed — Emoji are the only icon and illustration system; duplicates, greyscale 'locked' icons and no mascot layer

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** All task types, habits, awards and navigation use platform emoji. Two different task types share the identical 🔢 chip (both in the day cards and the dot strip), so Aziz cannot distinguish them. Done state in the day cards is only a faint mint tint on the chip. Locked habits and awards are greyscale emoji, which reads as 'disabled' or 'failed' rather than 'coming'. Emoji look different on every Android vendor, so quality varies on a parent's mid-range phone. The cute robot logo exists but is not used in hero, feedback or empty states, so there is no character to attach to. Compared with Duolingo, Khan Kids and ChessKid, the illustrated characters, animated celebrations and badge art are missing.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-home-t4.jpg: day-card chips '🔢 🔢 🧩 🔍 🤖 📐 🌍 ⭐' with identical first two; Day 1 mint vs beige chips differ only subtly.; rich-phone-home-t2.jpg: greyscale 7+7+7 dashed habit slots; rich-phone-awards-t2.jpg: grey brain, speech bubble and flame for unearned awards.; task-vp.png: the first two dot-strip chips are both 🔢.; SiteHeader.tsx:10-35 emoji passed as glyph text (aria-hidden). The only mascot is LogoMark (rich-phone-home-t1.jpg).
- **Principle:** Recognition over recall, distinctive icons per item (no two meanings for one symbol); positive framing for locked content; an emotional anchor such as a character improves child motivation and engagement.
- **Impact:** Aziz navigates by icon, so duplicates are a real orientation bug. Give each task type a unique icon plus a ✓ ring for done, show locked items as colourful silhouettes with a small lock, and reuse the robot mascot in feedback and celebration states.
- **Skeptic:** Seen directly: the first two progress dots on day 1 are identical 🔢 (t1.png; both 40x40 buttons), the task chip 'Разминка' uses 🔢 too. Locked habit slots are greyscale dashed icons for weeks 2-3 (rich-phone-home-t2.jpg). Day-state is conveyed by a green check badge on the dot when solved (right.png), which is a decent cue. The vendor-variance and mascot comments are opinion, but the duplicate-glyph orientation issue is real though small.

#### VIS-9 · minor · partly — Home hierarchy: identical progress bars for four different meanings, small hero CTA, no clear 'next' target

- **Who:** DILNOZA, AZIZ
- **Problem:** XP level, week progress, day-card progress and chess level progress all use the same indigo-to-violet gradient bar of similar height, and one white card stacks the quest, XP bar, streak and week bar in a long list. The hero 'Начать' button is not full width. On the mobile home there is no single 'continue where you stopped' card at the top; the chess 'Продолжить' (full-width, good) is below the quest.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-home-t3.jpg: bars at y≈460 (XP) and y≈740 (week) both look the same; day cards in t4/t5 repeat the same bar ×7.; ui.tsx:117-125 ProgressBar has a single gradient style (from-brand to-[#7c3aed]); no variant prop.; rich-phone-home-t1.jpg hero button is 340px of 1082 wide; chess card CTA in t3 spans the card.
- **Principle:** Visual hierarchy: what shouts should be what matters most; colour should carry meaning (Duolingo reserves a distinct colour per currency: XP, streak, gems).
- **Impact:** Dilnoza cannot scan the numbers that matter (level, streak), and Aziz does not know which bar to look at. Give each currency its own colour and icon, put the 'continue' CTA full-width at the top, and shorten the day list to today plus two upcoming days with a 'show all' control.
- **Skeptic:** ProgressBar has one gradient style and no variant (ui.tsx:117-125, used in 29 places), and 'Начать' is a ~130px-wide button inside the hero (rich-phone-home-t1.jpg). But the home hero does have a clear 'today' card with 'Начать' above the fold, so 'no clear next target' is wrong; the claim concerns the chess/XP area only. Whether four same-colour bars confuse a child is untested.

#### VIS-10 · minor · partly — Historical imagery: engaging photos, but English caption leaks, 11px credits and table-based champions

- **Who:** DILNOZA, AZIZ
- **Problem:** The large museum and miniature images are appealing and give the Uzbek heritage real weight. Under them, raw Wikimedia descriptions in English appear in the middle of a Russian page, followed by 11px grey credit text. The champions are shown as 40px faces in a dense table (the same table that breaks the layout in VIS-1). I only reviewed the first tiles of the page, so the rest of the gallery is not assessed.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-history-t3.jpg: caption 'The Shâhnâmeh (Book of Kings) is major epic work of persian poetry...' above '· общественное достояние · Wikimedia Commons'.; audit-metrics: /chess/history minFs 11px ×309; Encyclopedia.tsx:198-221 champions table with Face size={40}.; rich-phone-history-t1.jpg: timeline illustration labels about 9-10px (city names under icons).
- **Principle:** Content in the child's language only; images need a human-scale hook (large faces, story caption) rather than raw metadata.
- **Impact:** A Russian-reading child sees unreadable English, and the parent may judge the product as unfinished. Replace the English descriptions with the Russian/Uzbek caption, move credits into an expandable 'Откуда картинка' line, and render champions as large portrait cards.
- **Skeptic:** English leak is real but mis-scoped: it is not a caption, it is the credit line. A proper Russian caption exists above it ('Шатрандж — так шахматы называли в Персии. Миниатюра из «Шахнаме», XV век'), and below it the raw English 'author' field from images.json:860 ('The Shâhnâmeh (Book of Kings) is major epic work of persian poetry "Ferdowsi Tousi".') is rendered as the credit author (found in page innerText). Only one such English-only line was found on the page. The 11px credits and champion-table claims are real; champion table is internally scrollable and fine.

#### VIS-11 · minor · partly — Welcome dialog: broken emoji row and a wall of text before the name field

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** The first-launch dialog shows a robot, brain and sparkle emoji whose row wraps (sparkles drop onto a second line), then a three-line heading, three rules of two lines each (about 60 words), a listen button, and only then the 'Как тебя зовут?' field, below the fold. The dialog blocks the page behind it, so Aziz has to read before he can start.
- **Evidence:** fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg: emoji group occupies y≈100-360 and wraps; rules at y≈940-1400; name field at y≈1850 (≈705 CSS px, on the edge of the first screen).; The three rules are in bold 18-20px text that all look equally important.
- **Principle:** First-run experience should be one action per screen and show, not tell (Khan Kids onboarding is a character plus a single tap).
- **Impact:** A slow reader may give up before the first interaction, or a parent may do it for him. Split into: pick language, type name, then the three rules as an icon strip with audio; fix the emoji alignment.
- **Skeptic:** Emoji row wrap is confirmed: robot and brain sit beside the language buttons while the sparkles drop to a second line (fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg). Text is long (3-line H1, 3 bold two-line rules). But the claim that the name field is below the fold is wrong: 'Как тебя зовут?' is at y~1620/2.625 = 617 CSS px and the input at ~1860/2.625 = 708 CSS px, both inside the 839px viewport; there is also a 'Послушать приветствие' audio button. The dialog does not need scrolling to reach the name field on Pixel 7.

#### VIS-12 · polish · partly — No dark theme or colour-scheme, no safe-area handling, small decorative collisions

- **Who:** PARENT, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** There is no dark-mode support, so a child using a phone at bedtime gets a bright cream page. There are no safe-area insets, so the fixed bottom bar on notched or gesture-bar phones in PWA mode may sit under the system gesture area. The chess hero's knight silhouette overlaps the title letters ('школа', 'maktabi'). Container widths are inconsistent on desktop (page content max about 990px vs header max-w-6xl).
- **Evidence:** grep: 0 `dark:` classes in src, no `prefers-color-scheme` or `color-scheme` in globals.css or layout.tsx (only themeColor #4f46e5 at layout.tsx:26).; No `env(safe-area-inset-*)` anywhere in src; DaySession.tsx:83 bar uses plain `py-3`.; rich-phone-chess-t1.jpg, richuz-phone-chess-t1.jpg: knight silhouette crossing 'школа' / 'maktabi'.; rich-desk-pawn-ex.jpg: content column narrower than the header container.
- **Principle:** Respect system preferences and device safe areas; avoid decorative elements that reduce title legibility.
- **Impact:** Small comfort and polish issues; the safe-area item can make the 'Дальше' button harder to hit on some devices. Add a simple dark palette via CSS variables, `padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`, and push the knight art behind a lower-opacity gradient.
- **Skeptic:** No dark: classes / no color-scheme (computed colorScheme 'normal'), no env(safe-area-inset-*) in src, and the knight silhouette crosses 'школа' in the chess hero (rich-phone-chess-t1.jpg, text stays legible with a tint change on 'ла'). But the safe-area argument is weak: layout.tsx viewport only sets themeColor (no viewport-fit=cover), so in the browser the env() insets are 0 and the bar is not drawn under system bars; it is only a PWA/standalone concern. Dark mode is a nice-to-have, not a defect for this audience.

**Missed by the auditor (found by the skeptic):**

- (major) Real horizontal-overflow cause on /chess/history is the credits grid, not the table — Playwright: <LI class='flex items-center gap-2'> inside UL.grid sm:grid-cols-2 in #credits is 837px wide (x=32..869); its inner span.min-w-0/truncate children also end at x=595..626 and an A.underline at x=521..626. The parent grid item has no min-w-0, so the document is 869px wide. The champions table wrapper is 380px with its own overflow-x scroll. Fix target: Encyclopedia.tsx credits list (:356 area), not the champions table.
- (minor) Back link on every chess subpage is a 146x20px target at the top-left — Playwright on /chess/play: '← Шахматная школа' y=88, 146x20 CSS px (kid7-phone-drills-t1.jpg, kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t1.jpg y~255/2.625). It is the only way back to the section, is 20px high and is in the least reachable zone; smaller than the 34px header links criticised in VIS-2.
- (minor) 'Прочитать' (read aloud) button is only 36px high and tucked beside the counter — Task page, Playwright: '🔊Прочитать' 122x36 at x=253,y=190 (ui.tsx:26 size sm = min-h-9), right-aligned next to 'Задача 1 из 8' (t1.png). For Aziz the audio button is the main reading aid, yet it is smaller than Назад/Дальше (44px) and the hint button (186x44) and visually weaker than them.
- (polish) Day progress-dot strip: 9th dot is clipped at the right edge with no scroll cue — Playwright: dots are 40x40 at x=16,62,...,384; the 🏁 dot at x=384 ends at 424 > 412 viewport (t1.png shows 🏁 cut at the right edge). The ol is overflow-x-auto (DaySession.tsx progress dots) with no fade or arrow.
- (minor) Endgame exercise boards are smaller than elsewhere (37px squares) and expose 54 unnamed controls — Playwright /chess/endgames: board divs 299px/284px wide, cell 37.4x37.4 CSS px vs 43.5px on /chess/pawn; audit-metrics 'phone /chess/endgames': noName 54, small44 21, text 10.3px x240. Board width is limited by a lg:flex side column (340px) pattern rather than full card width.

### Solutions

#### VIS-S1 · modify · effort S · impact 4 — Fix sideways scroll on /chess/history: champions become cards, plus an overflow guard in tests

- **Addresses:** VIS-1
- **Proposal:** The champions table (Encyclopedia.tsx:198-221) has whitespace-nowrap cells and w-full table inside an overflow-x-auto wrapper, but one of its flex/grid ancestors lacks min-w-0, so the document itself grows to 869px. Replace the table on phones with a card list (the same data, same Face component) and keep the table only from md up. Add min-w-0 to the section wrapper as a belt-and-braces fix. Add a Playwright check that asserts document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth on every phone page, which also repairs the metrics false negative (hOverflow=false).
- **Revised after review:** 1) Root-cause fix: in Figure.tsx ImageCredits add min-w-0 to the li and use grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] (sm:grid-cols-2 with minmax(0,1fr)); let Credit wrap with break-words instead of one long unbroken line. 2) Add an e2e spec e2e/no-hscroll.spec.ts for Pixel 7 over all child-facing pages in RU and UZ: assert document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth. Fix scripts/audit to use scrollWidth. 3) Champions: keep the table from md up; on phones the cheap change is a 2-line row (face 48, name + №, then country · years) and the 'interesting' note shown below it in 16px. Do not add an expander. Drop uppercase in the thead (agrees with VIS-S6). 4) Regression: the new e2e should fail on the current build. Test on /chess/history in RU and UZ at 360 and 412 px.
- **UI spec:** Phone (<md): each champion is one white row-card, grid [56px face | text]. Face size 56 (was 40). Line 1: name (font-black, 18px) with number badge '№ 3' as a small pill on the right. Line 2: country + years, 14px muted. Line 3: the 'interesting' note, 16px, max 3 lines with a 'Ещё' tap to expand (44px high). Cards are full width, gap-3, no horizontal scroll anywhere. Women champions list stays a grid but goes 1 column on phone (grid md:grid-cols-5 already) with Face 64. md and up: keep the table, wrapper gets 'min-w-0 max-w-full overflow-x-auto'. Remove 'uppercase tracking-wide' in the thead. Table cells in md: drop whitespace-nowrap on the name cell, allow wrap.
- **Copy:** RU: Ещё / Свернуть / UZ: Yana / Yopish
- **Files:** src/components/chess/Encyclopedia.tsx, e2e (new spec, e.g. e2e/no-hscroll.spec.ts), scripts (audit metric script, if the project has one: use scrollWidth not hOverflow)
- **Inspired by:** WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow; NN/g kids research (avoid unpredictable scrolling); ChessKid-style simple profile cards
- **Guardrails:** No pressure risk. Do not turn the champions into a ranking or quiz. Keep Wikimedia credits intact (licence obligations) when restyling cards.
- **Test plan:** Playwright Pixel 7 on /chess/history (ru and uz): scrollWidth === 412, no element with getBoundingClientRect().right > 412+1. Regression guard on all 15+ phone pages. Visual check against rich-phone-history-t1.jpg (should be 1082px wide, no blank right half). Manual: try dragging page left/right with the thumb.
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. The symptom is real: I measured scrollWidth 869 vs clientWidth 412 on /chess/history at Pixel 7. The diagnosis is wrong. The champions table sits inside overflow-x-auto at Encyclopedia.tsx:198 and is not the cause. A Playwright scan for elements with right > 412 outside any overflow-clipped ancestor returned only the `<li class="flex items-center gap-2">` rows of ImageCredits (Figure.tsx:121-133). They are 837px wide, and the inner Credit span is text-[11px] with a long author string. Those li elements are grid items (`grid sm:grid-cols-2`) with min-width:auto, so the track grows. Turning champions into cards would leave the sideways scroll in place. The metrics false negative (hOverflow=false everywhere) is real and worth fixing with a scrollWidth test.

#### VIS-S2 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — Labelled thumb-zone tab bar on phones; header slimmed to logo, language and a 48px 'Родителям' lock

- **Addresses:** VIS-2, VIS-3
- **Proposal:** Add a BottomNav component with three big labelled child tabs: Математика (/), Шахматы (/chess), Награды (/chess/awards). 'Мои задачи' moves into the home page as a card (it is a power-user feature). The parent lock stays in the header, but at 48px with a visible word and separated from the child's main row, so the child does not hit it by accident. On md and up the old header nav remains and the tab bar is hidden. The tab bar is hidden on the day-session task step (it already has its own fixed bar) and during a chess game (/chess/play board, puzzles) to avoid two bars; on those screens a 48px '← Домой' pill is added at the top-left of the page chrome instead. Active tab: filled brand-soft pill plus bold label, aria-current=page.
- **Revised after review:** Add a BottomNav with 3 labelled tabs (Математика / Шахматы / Награды, UZ Matematika / Shaxmat / Mukofotlar), 56-64px tall, safe-area padded, shown below md only, and only on a route allow-list: /, /chess, /chess/awards, /chess/secrets, /chess/history, /chess/openings, /chess/games, /my-problems. Keep the bar hidden on every task/game/board route and on /parent and print routes. Header on phones: logo, LangSwitch and an icon-only lock at 44x44 with aria-label; the word 'Родителям' goes on the home footer. Make the Awards tab link to one combined awards page, or call it 'Шахматные награды' until it is. 'Мои задачи' becomes a home card. Never show badges or counts on tabs. Test: tab targets >= 48px at 360 and 412px in RU and UZ, no horizontal overflow of the header, bar absent on /week/1/day/1 and /chess/play.
- **UI spec:** Bar: fixed bottom, height 64px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom), white/95 with blur, top border line, 3 equal tabs, each min-w 0, 64px tall target. Tab content: 28px emoji/icon (later the SVG set) over a 14px extrabold label ('Математика', 'Шахматы', 'Награды'); active tab has brand-soft rounded-2xl background and brand-dark text; inactive muted. Press: scale 0.96, 120ms. Body gets padding-bottom: 72px + safe-area on pages where the bar shows. Header on phone: LogoMark 36 + wordmark, LangSwitch (min 44px), '🔒 Родителям' pill 48px high with label always visible (text-sm), placed far right with 8px gap from LangSwitch. Uz labels: 'Matematika', 'Shaxmat', 'Mukofotlar'; lock 'Ota-onalarga'. Uzbek label width check at 412px: each tab has 137px, 'Mukofotlar' at 14px bold fits.
- **Copy:** RU: Математика · Шахматы · Награды · Родителям · ← Домой / UZ: Matematika · Shaxmat · Mukofotlar · Ota-onalarga · ← Bosh sahifa
- **Files:** src/components/BottomNav.tsx (new), src/components/SiteHeader.tsx, src/app/layout.tsx, src/components/session/DaySession.tsx (pb-28 stays; hide bar on task step), src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx (add 'Мои задачи' card), src/app/globals.css (safe-area padding utility)
- **Inspired by:** Khan Kids / ChessKid bottom navigation; Fitts's law and thumb-zone; NN/g (icon plus label for 6-8)
- **Guardrails:** Only three tabs, no badges, no red dots, no counters that nag. Parent area stays behind PIN. No auto-switching tabs and no 'unread' pressure. Tab bar must never cover the Next/Check controls: always pad content.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: tap target sizes >= 48 for all tab/lock controls (small44 on phone / should drop from 10 to under 3). Check Uzbek label wrapping at 360px and 412px. Check the bar does not appear on /week/1/day/1 task steps and /chess/play game. Usability: give Aziz-like child 'go to chess' and 'find your awards' and time it, vs current header. Android back button still works.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. A labelled three-tab bar is good for Aziz and for Fitts's law. Measured header links are 36x34 and 42x34 px (icon-only, labels hidden below sm). Home is reachable only via the logo (129x40). The bar is the highest-value item in this set. Problems: (a) The 48px 'Родителям' pill with a visible word will not fit at 412px next to the logo, wordmark and LangSwitch, especially in UZ ('Ota-onalarga'). (b) 'Награды' pointing to /chess/awards is chess-only awards under a tab shared with math; confirm what Awards.tsx shows or the label misleads. (c) Many routes must hide the bar: /week/*, /chess/play, /chess/puzzles, drills, review, /parent, /print, /chess/print, /chess/certificate, and any fixed bottom UI. The XpToast (bottom-4 right-4, z-50) and the DaySession bar already use the bottom edge. (d) SiteHeader is rendered per page, not in layout.tsx, so the nav has to read the pathname. (e) Moving 'Мои задачи' off the header removes the only entry to a power-user page; the home card is fine. The parent lock is behind a PIN, so a stray child tap there costs little.

#### VIS-S3 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — One primary action per state: full-width 'Проверить' that becomes 'Дальше', toast above the bar, feedback always in view

- **Addresses:** VIS-5
- **Proposal:** Make the task screen state-driven: (1) Before the check, the answer button is the only primary-coloured button; the bottom-bar 'Дальше' is demoted to secondary (white with border). (2) After a success the answer button disappears or morphs into a mint 'success' button 'Дальше →' placed directly under the feedback card, and the bar's 'Дальше' becomes primary; both do the same thing. (3) Answer buttons become full width on phones (w-full sm:w-auto, size lg, min-h-14). (4) The disabled state stops being 45% opacity lavender: use a solid light-indigo background with indigo text and a one-line reason below ('Сначала введи ответ'). (5) XpToast moves out of the way: bottom = bar height + 12px + safe-area, centered, and is merged into the success feedback card as a '+15 XP' chip, with the floating toast kept only on pages that have no bar. (6) After any feedback appears, call scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) with scroll-margin-bottom of 112px so the card is never under the fixed bar. Add a shared TaskAction component so the ~12 answer kinds (FieldsAnswer, ChoiceAnswers, NumberPuzzles, GridPuzzles, SudokuPuzzle, VennPuzzle, CipherPuzzle) stop duplicating button markup.
- **Revised after review:** Do these four, in this order. (1) Move XpToast above any bottom bar (bottom: calc(5rem + safe-area)) and merge it into the success feedback only where there is no bar. (2) Replace disabled:opacity-45 on primary with a solid light-indigo background, indigo text, no shadow, plus aria-disabled; no reason sentence, use a pointing icon or placeholder text in the field. (3) Answer button full width on phones (w-full sm:w-auto, lg) for the answer kinds that use Button. (4) After feedback appears, scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) with scroll-mb of 112px. After success, keep only the bar 'Дальше' as the single primary: give it a short 300ms attention pulse (none under reduced-motion) and relabel the in-panel check button 'Проверить ещё раз' as secondary. Do not add a second 'Дальше'. Defer the shared TaskAction component until the four changes are in. Use ʻ in UZ copy.
- **UI spec:** States: idle-empty (disabled-looking, reason line 14px muted), ready (primary indigo, full width, 56px, label 'Проверить'), checking (instant, no spinner), retry (amber feedback card + the same button relabelled 'Проверить ещё раз', primary stays; hint button stays secondary), solved (feedback card mint with chip '+15 XP ⭐' top-right, button morphs to mint 'Дальше →' with 200ms scale-in; bar 'Дальше' becomes primary). Feedback card gets scroll-mt/-mb 112px, role=status. The last task's button reads 'Итоги дня 🏁'. Motion: card pop 350ms (existing animate-pop), reduced-motion: no scale. Sound: existing cheer clip; retry uses a soft two-note 'hm', never a buzzer.
- **Copy:** RU: Проверить · Проверить ещё раз · Дальше → · Сначала введи ответ · Давай проверим твою идею! / UZ: Tekshirish · Yana tekshirish · Keyingi → · Avval javobni kiriting · Keling, fikringni tekshirib ko'ramiz!
- **Files:** src/components/answers/Feedback.tsx, src/components/answers/FieldsAnswer.tsx, src/components/answers/ChoiceAnswers.tsx, src/components/answers/NumberPuzzles.tsx, src/components/answers/GridPuzzles.tsx, src/components/answers/SudokuPuzzle.tsx, src/components/answers/VennPuzzle.tsx, src/components/answers/CipherPuzzle.tsx, src/components/progress/XpToast.tsx, src/components/session/DaySession.tsx, src/components/ui.tsx (disabled style), src/components/answers/TaskAction.tsx (new)
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo bottom check/continue button; Hick's law; Desmos 'feedback visible next to the action'; Khan Kids non-verbal feedback; NN/g (visible adjacent feedback)
- **Guardrails:** Keep the no-'wrong' rule: amber 'Давай проверим идею', no red, no cross, no buzzer. Never lock the 'Дальше' bar button (child may skip). XP chip is informational, not advertised before the task (avoid expected-reward over-justification). No timers, no streak text on this screen.
- **Test plan:** Playwright task-vp/task-wrong/task-right scenarios at Pixel 7: after success, assert 'Дальше' bounding box does not intersect [data-xp-toast]; feedback card bottom <= viewport height - bar height; Check button width >= 90% of container. Measure taps-to-next after success (target 1). Watch 5 children: does anyone press bar 'Дальше' before checking? Accessibility: aria-live announces feedback once.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. The diagnosis is right. XpToast is `fixed right-4 bottom-4 z-50` (XpToast.tsx) and the DaySession 'Дальше' button sits in the same bottom-right corner, so the toast covers it for 1.8s. That is a one-line fix. The disabled state is `disabled:opacity-45` (ui.tsx BASE), which makes primary look broken. Feedback is below the answer button and can end up under the bar. The weakness: after success the proposal puts a mint 'Дальше →' in the panel and also makes the bar 'Дальше' primary, which recreates two competing identical primary buttons, the very problem it is meant to fix. Demoting the bar 'Дальше' before checking nudges the child to answer instead of skipping; it is mild but it is a hierarchy that changes under the child's finger. AnswerPanel has about 20 answer kinds with their own check logic (many are interactive tools with their own run buttons), so a shared TaskAction across all of them is an L, not M. Feedback.tsx already has aria-live=polite. New retry audio is not needed: voice.ts already has retry-1 and retry-2 clips. The UZ copy uses an ASCII apostrophe ('ko'ramiz'); the codebase uses ʻ (U+02BB).

Board squares are excluded from the rule but exercise boards get the width fix in VIS-S5. The audit-metrics small44 numbers become a CI budget (e.g. <= 3 per child-facing page).

Skip the .hit utility for text links; either make them real buttons/rows (44px) or leave inline links alone. Set the CI budget by category: primary controls and nav must be >= 44 (zero allowed), inline links and board squares excluded. Re-run the audit metrics and report per page. Keep Cancel/Skip the same size as Continue.

Button: SIZES.sm 'min-h-(--tap-min) px-3.5', md 'min-h-[calc(var(--tap-min)+4px)]', lg 'min-h-14'. .hit { position:relative } .hit::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-6px } for text links. - **Guardrails:** Larger targets are never used to push purchases or sneaky buttons: keep 'cancel/skip' the same size as 'continue' (ICO nudge standard). Do not shrink content to compensate; hide secondary items under 'Ещё'.

SIZES.sm is min-h-9 (36px), ListenButton min-h-9, ProgressDots h-10 w-10 (DaySession.tsx), and header links are 36x34 / 42x34 (measured). The claim that small44 falls from 37 to <=3 on /chess/play, 41 to <=3 on /chess/secrets and 133 to <=3 on /chess/history is not credible. In the metrics the small-target samples are the header links, and the 133 history items are mostly credit and timeline text links 11px high. A ::after of inset -6px on an 11px link gives about 23px, and overlapping hit areas between neighbouring rows create mis-taps. Inline links inside text are exempt from WCAG 2.5.8. A data-age attribute needs the head script to change (tests/head-script.test.ts covers it) and can flash. The board squares are already 43.5px at 412px (measured on /chess/pawn#exercises), so the VIS-4 claim of 35px squares is not reproduced here.

Colour-blind users would not distinguish them. Day letters Пн..Вс at 11-12px in 20px circles break the 14px floor of VIS-S6. 'Best week' adds a comparison for a kid who may feel pressure. Putting level and streak by the greeting is fine for Dilnoza.

- **Addresses:** VIS-11

Remove the three rules from the dialog and show them as three dismissible tips on the first tasks (reuse the existing welcome clip text for the first one; record two new ones only if the first test shows value). Body per step as described, text 20px. Button: sticky bottom, 56px, brand primary. Transitions: slide 200ms, reduced motion = fade. Robot tip card: white card with robot 40px, 18px text, speaker 44px, 'Понятно' button 48px; shown once per tip. Default age mode if skipped: 6-8.

The problem is confirmed in fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg: the emoji row '🤖🧠✨' wraps (sparkles drop onto a second line), the heading takes 3 lines, there are three 2-line rules, then a listen button, and the name field only at the bottom. The current Welcome also makes Start disabled until both name and age are set (ready = name && age), which is a form wall and contradicts the 'never block' guardrail in the proposal. A 3-step wizard adds taps and rework for e2e (name.spec.ts, smoke.spec.ts use the one-screen form) and new voice clips (3 tips x 2 languages with the cloned voice) with cost. The welcome clip already exists (VOICE_CLIPS.welcome). Robot tips shown later on the first three tasks are a good place for the rules.

Combine with the ImageCredits overflow fix in VIS-S1.

The leak comes from the `author` field of one image (images.json:860), which Credit prints as the author. So an audit of all captions plus a new unit test for Latin-only captions would not catch it. Credits are 11px (Credit uses text-[11px]) and also cause the page overflow (see VIS-S1). Collapsing the credits under 'Откуда картинка' is acceptable if the licence and Wikimedia link stay one tap away.

#### VIS-S13 · modify · effort L · impact 4 — Robot mascot with four non-verbal states in feedback, empty states and a short skippable celebration

- **Addresses:** VIS-8, VIS-5
- **Proposal:** Build a Mascot SVG component from LogoMark with four states: ready (idle blink), thinking (head tilt 12 degrees, hand on chin, shown when a hint opens or on 'retry'), happy (smile, after a solved task), cheer (arms up, at day finish). Replace the emoji (🤔, 🎉, 💬) in Feedback.tsx with the mascot (48px) beside the text. At DayFinish and rank earned, play one 2-second celebration (confetti burst of 24 pieces, robot cheer, one recorded neutral line) that is skippable by tap and shown once per round/day, not per answer. 'Retry' uses a soft two-note 'hm' sfx and a head tilt, never a shake or buzzer (the existing animate-shake is not used for kids' mistakes). Add the mascot to empty states ('пока пусто') and the Awards header. Reduced motion: static poses, no confetti.
- **Revised after review:** Phase it. Now: a static robot face (from LogoMark) in Feedback.tsx instead of 🎉/🤔/💬, two or three static poses (neutral, thinking for retry, happy for success), no animation beyond the existing animate-pop; reuse existing clips. Later, one skippable 1.5s celebration only at DayFinish, off with reduced-motion and a 'тихий режим' option in /parent. Use only praise that is true ('Задача решена', 'Ты нашёл другой способ' only when the app knows it). No new sounds in this round.
- **UI spec:** Mascot sizes 48 (inline), 96 (modals), 160 (finish). Idle: blink every 4s, 150ms. Thinking: rotate -10deg 400ms ease-out, hold. Happy: scale 1.05 bounce 350ms (animate-pop). Cheer: arms up 600ms, confetti with 5 palette colours, 1.8s total, pointer-events none, tap anywhere to skip. Sound: three cues only (soft-correct chime, soft-retry 'hm', round-complete jingle), same in RU and UZ, volume respects settings.sound, and a 'тихий режим' toggle in /parent disables confetti and loops but keeps essential motion.
- **Copy:** RU: Ты проверил каждый шаг — отличный способ! · Давай посмотрим ещё раз вместе · Хорошая работа на сегодня! / UZ: Har bir qadamni tekshirding — ajoyib usul! · Keling, yana birgalikda ko'rib chiqamiz · Bugungi ish uchun rahmat!
- **Files:** src/components/Mascot.tsx (new), src/components/Logo.tsx, src/components/answers/Feedback.tsx, src/components/session/DayFinish.tsx, src/components/Awards.tsx, src/lib/sfx.ts, src/lib/voice.ts, src/app/globals.css (keyframes, reduced-motion), public/audio (3 short cues)
- **Inspired by:** Khan Academy Kids bear (non-verbal reactions); Duolingo milestone animation (+1.7% D7 reported); Lingokids reward moments; NN/g (exaggerated, explicit feedback)
- **Guardrails:** The robot is never sad, angry or disappointed when the child stops, fails or leaves (no confirmshaming). Celebrate effort and process ('Ты проверил второй шаг'), not 'умный'. One celebration per round, never per tap; skippable; no countdown; no purchase hooks; no random loot.
- **Test plan:** Reduced-motion emulation: no animation. Measure animation durations <= 2s. A/B with 5 children: do they look at feedback next to the button? Check 'retry' never uses shake or red. Parent review of sounds on a shared phone. Lighthouse perf: mascot SVG inline < 6 KB.
- **Review:** feasibility hard, age fit True, manipulation risk low. A friendly character can help 6-8-year-olds and the logo asset exists, but this is an L item that packs several things. Retry audio already exists (voice.ts has retry-1 and retry-2 clips and Feedback calls cheer('retry')), so 'new soft two-note hm sfx' duplicates it. The claim about Duolingo +1.7% D7 retention is an adult-app metric and not evidence for these children. The copy 'Ты проверил каждый шаг' states a behaviour the app cannot verify; praising what did not happen is dishonest and undermines trust. Confetti and a celebration per day finish add motion and sound on a shared parent phone. The guardrail about a never-sad robot is good. 48px mascot beside feedback text is a modest and safe change.

#### VIS-S15 · modify · effort S · impact 3 — Make the Uzbek apostrophe letters (o', g') read as one letter

- **Addresses:** VIS-6
- **Proposal:** The wide modifier-letter apostrophe (U+02BB) splits words for an early reader ('o ʻ zingga'). Define an @font-face for U+02BB only (unicode-range: U+02BB, U+02BC) that uses the same Nunito files copied to public/fonts with size-adjust ~70% and ascent tweaks, listed first in the font-family stack, so every Uzbek string benefits without touching 500+ call sites. Fallback if the glyph still looks detached: wrap in a .tutuq inline span through a small helper used by RichText. Never swap to ASCII apostrophe in stored text (search and screen readers need the right character; here copy uses plain ' in new strings and normalizeText already collapses variants).
- **Revised after review:** Try it as an experiment: @font-face for U+02BB-02BC with size-adjust around 85% (not 70%) and an ascent-override so the mark keeps its height, in front of the font stack; target advance of oʻ <= 1.3x width of o and verify the mark stays visible at 14px and 18px on a real Android phone. Skip the .tutuq span fallback. Keep stored text unchanged. Add a visual check of /chess and a day page in UZ.
- **UI spec:** CSS: @font-face { font-family:'Nunito Tutuq'; src:url(/fonts/nunito-var.woff2); unicode-range:U+02BB,U+02BC; size-adjust:70%; } font-family stack: 'Nunito Tutuq','Nunito Variable',... Check headings, buttons, task titles and big-text mode.
- **Copy:** RU: (no new copy) / UZ: (no new copy)
- **Files:** src/app/globals.css, public/fonts (copy of the Nunito woff2 from @fontsource-variable/nunito), src/components/RichText.tsx (fallback span), tests (visual check on richuz pages)
- **Inspired by:** Digest local pattern 'Fix the wide Uzbek ʻ'; Duolingo ABC emphasis on decoding support
- **Guardrails:** Typography only; no text altering. Verify that selecting/copying text still yields the original character.
- **Test plan:** Compare richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg before/after at 100% and bigText; measure advance width of 'oʻ' via canvas measureText (target <= 1.15x width of 'o'). Check Android Chrome real device since font rendering differs.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. The issue is real and measurable: in the page's own font (Nunito Variable, weight 800, 18px) I measured advance widths o = 11.0px, ʻ (U+02BB) = 9.0px, oʻ = 20.0px, versus 5.0px for a plain apostrophe. So the modifier letter takes almost as much width as a full letter, and the screenshot of the Welcome dialog shows 'O ʻ zbekcha' with a visible gap. The font that renders it is the latin-ext subset, which includes U+02BB. The fix mechanism (unicode-range face with size-adjust) is feasible. Risk: shrinking the glyph to 70% makes the sign small, and ʻ is what separates o from oʻ and g from gʻ, which are different letters, so a too-small mark hurts decoding. The plan also says to copy the font to public/fonts, which duplicates a font file and an offline cache entry; a package-path url or a local() source might do. Confidence stays low until checked on a real Android.

#### VIS-S16 · drop · effort L · impact 4 — NEW: Robot workshop - the 21 habits and XP become a growing robot with a capped parts set

- **Addresses:** (new idea)
- **Proposal:** Replace the 700px 'Мои привычки' grid (21 greyscale emoji slots) with one 'Мастерская' card: a coloured robot illustration with 12 attachable parts (antenna, gear, arm, wheels, hat...). A part is earned for process behaviours (tried a different way, opened a hint then solved, explained why, tried a new tool, finished a round), shown as a colourful silhouette until earned. Level-ups change the robot's colour/hat. Dilnoza gets a 'Мой прогресс' details view with numbers, XP and the printable certificate (shareable image of her own robot, first name only). Collection is capped (12 parts) and finishable.
- **UI spec:** Card height ~260px on phone: robot 180px centered, parts positions highlighted with a pulsing ring only for the next-earned part (no pulse loops over 5s). Tap a silhouette: bottom sheet 'Как получить: попробуй другой способ'. Earned part flies to the robot 700ms, with a happy mascot state. Details page lists the 21 habits as rows with icon + word + earned/not yet (coloured).
- **Copy:** RU: Моя мастерская · Новая деталь для робота! · Как получить: попробуй другой способ / UZ: Mening ustaxonam · Robot uchun yangi detal! · Qanday olish: boshqa usulni sinab ko'r
- **Files:** src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/progress/Workshop.tsx (new), src/lib/awards.ts, src/lib/state.ts (parts derived from existing habits, no new tracking), src/components/Awards.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Khan Academy Kids sparkles toward a payoff; Lingokids stickers/album; Mathseeds creature growth; Self-Determination Theory competence made visible
- **Guardrails:** Parts are informational, cosmetic only, non-random, non-purchasable, never lost; do not announce the reward before the task ('решите 3 — получите деталь'), reveal after. Cap and let it finish. No leaderboard; sharing is private by tap and shows only the child's first name.
- **Test plan:** Home page ratio drop (700px card -> ~260px). Unit: parts derive deterministically from habits. Kid test: ask 'what did you get?' and note recall; watch for task-farming behaviour (rapid easy tasks) in logs. Parent comprehension of the details view.
- **Review:** feasibility hard, age fit True, manipulation risk low. The app already has XP and levels, a daily quest, a gentle streak, 21 'habits', awards, certificates and crowns. A robot-parts collection is yet another currency on top of five, which is the clutter the brief asks us to avoid. It is an L item with new art, a new screen and sync implications. It says 'no new tracking' but maps 21 habits to 12 parts, which needs new rules, and 'earned for process behaviours (tried a different way, explained why)' cannot be verified by the app, so parts would be awarded for what it can count. Collections create completionism and task-farming (the proposal itself plans to look for it) and a 'finishable' goal invites rushing for the last parts. Evidence from Lingokids or Khan Kids does not show it helps these ages learn. The part of the idea that is useful, a smaller and more readable habits block with coloured 'not yet' items, is already covered by VIS-S7 and VIS-S8.

#### VIS-S17 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — NEW: Rounds of three tasks with a warm 'На сегодня хватит' stop, default for ages under 9

- **Addresses:** VIS-3
- **Proposal:** Home and day cards promise '8 задач · около 25 минут', which exceeds Aziz's ~10 minutes. For age < 9, split each day into 3 rounds (about 3 tasks, 6-8 minutes): the day screen header says 'Часть 1 из 3'; at the end of a round show a calm card with the mascot, 'Часть готова!', and two equally sized buttons: 'Закончить на сегодня' (counts for the daily quest) and 'Ещё часть'. Progress auto-saves. Ages >= 10 see the whole day and optional 'Ещё' bonus tasks. Home card shows '1 часть · 7 минут'. A parent setting later for suggested session length (no hard lock).
- **Revised after review:** Do not change the day model. (1) Make the time honest: show '~N минут' computed per age, and for age<9 mention the first 4 tasks as 'можно остановиться после 4-й'. (2) For age<9 add an optional break card after task 4 (not blocking, one screen, mascot, two equal 56px buttons 'Закончить на сегодня' and 'Продолжить'), with progress already saved per task. Stopping there counts as started, not finished, with no loss copy. No countdowns. Keep the full day for 10+.
- **UI spec:** Round card: full-screen sheet over the bar, mascot 96px, title 24px, two 56px buttons side by side on tablet and stacked on phone, identical size and wording weight (no confirmshaming). No autoplay of the next task. Dot strip highlights the current round's dots, others dimmed but tappable.
- **Copy:** RU: Часть 1 из 3 · Часть готова! · Закончить на сегодня · Ещё часть · Робот подождёт, всё сохранено / UZ: 3 qismdan 1-qism · Qism tayyor! · Bugunga yetarli · Yana bir qism · Robot kutib turadi, hammasi saqlandi
- **Files:** src/components/session/DaySession.tsx, src/components/session/DayFinish.tsx, src/components/session/RoundBreak.tsx (new), src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/lib/quest.ts, src/lib/age.ts
- **Inspired by:** Math Academy minimal doses; ICO Children's Code (breaks, pause and save); Magnus Trainer short levels; Duolingo short rounds
- **Guardrails:** Stopping never loses anything and never shows loss copy; both buttons equal size; no countdown; no extra reward for continuing ('Ещё часть' is not rewarded more than stopping). Parent-controlled length only.
- **Test plan:** Funnel: share of age<9 sessions that finish a round (target 80%) and share choosing to stop vs continue (both fine). Check state save/resume mid-round. Parent feedback on '7 минут' clarity.
- **Review:** feasibility hard, age fit True, manipulation risk low. The underlying problem is real: the home card promises '8 задач · около 25 минут' (rich-phone-home-t1 shows it), far over Aziz's roughly 10-minute attention. Equal-sized 'Закончить на сегодня / Ещё часть' buttons are a good, non-shaming pattern. But splitting each day into three 'parts' changes the content model: DaySession runs on a hash step 1..N through DayFinish, and day completion, the habit award, the quest 'task' goal and the home day status are all tied to finishing the day. 'Counts for the daily quest' would need the quest and the awards to be redefined. Also, tasks are 8 per day, which does not divide cleanly by 3, and 'Часть 1 из 3' adds a new concept to read.

#### VIS-S18 · modify · effort S · impact 4 — NEW: Big speaker pill as the first control on every task and lesson for under-9s

- **Addresses:** VIS-2, VIS-6
- **Proposal:** Make 'Прослушать' the first, largest control in each task/lesson card for age < 9: a 56px full-width-on-phone pill with speaker icon and an animated sound wave while playing, placed at the top of the card (not the 36px chip beside 'Задача 1 из 8'). Tap-to-play only (no autoplay in public); if audio is blocked or the clip is missing, show 'Нажми, чтобы послушать' state instead of silently failing. Keep existing recorded clips; add a quiet-mode toggle (effects off, narration on). Later: highlight the current sentence using ElevenLabs timestamps stored as small JSON. Offline caching of audio per week is a separate item for sw.js.
- **Revised after review:** For age<9 add a 'hero' variant of ListenButton: min-h-12 (48px), full width on phones, speaker icon and label 'Послушать', first element of the task/lesson card; for 9+ keep the compact chip. Show the pill only when a clip exists. Show a small error state only if playClip fails (blocked or network on 4G). Skip the sentence highlight and offline caching in this item (do the sw.js audio cache separately). Test: pill >= 44px high, aria-pressed toggles, no autoplay.
- **UI spec:** ListenButton variant 'hero': min-h-14, w-full on phone, brand-soft bg, 22px icon, 18px bold label, 3 wave bars animating 1s steps while playing (static when reduced motion), stop state 'Стоп' with brand fill. Position: first row of TaskView card and ChessLesson. For age >= 9 retains the compact chip.
- **Copy:** RU: Послушать задачу · Стоп · Нажми, чтобы послушать / UZ: Masalani tinglash · To'xtatish · Tinglash uchun bos
- **Files:** src/components/ListenButton.tsx, src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLesson.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessExercises.tsx, src/lib/voice.ts, public/sw.js (audio runtime cache, separate task)
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo ABC / Epic read-aloud; Khan Kids voice-first instructions; NN/g (short text, audio can fail silently)
- **Guardrails:** No browser speech (owner rule): only recorded clips; no autoplay on mobile data; narration praises process only, never 'умница'. Respect sound=false by hiding the pill.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: pill present with width >= 300px for age 7 and height >= 56; tap toggles aria-pressed; blocked-audio fallback visible. Track share of tasks where the pill is used by age < 9 and the time to first answer. Check bundle/audio request size on Slow 4G.
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Strong fit for Aziz, who reads with effort. In the day screenshot the 'Прочитать' button is a small chip (about 36px high, ListenButton min-h-9) next to 'Задача 1 из 8', easy to miss. A large first-row pill with tap-to-play, no autoplay and recorded clips only matches the owner's rules. Issues: ListenButton returns null when there is no clip (src missing), so the 'Нажми, чтобы послушать' fallback for a missing clip would promise audio that does not exist; only a playback failure/blocked state is real. 56px full-width on every task pushes the question down about 70px on a 674px viewport. The sentence-highlight idea needs timestamps and is a separate project. Quiet mode toggle is fine.

## Accessibility, inclusivity, age fit

The platform is calm, gentle and well built. Body contrast is excellent (ink on paper 14.7:1), feedback never relies on colour alone, the 3px focus ring is global, reduced motion is honoured, and nothing is sent off-device on first load (0 external hosts). Recorded narration covers all 165 task statements in both languages, and the owner's soft-feedback principles are visible in the copy. The weak spots sit exactly where Aziz (7, slow reader) and girls like Dilnoza meet the product.

1. Audio stops at the task statement. Hints, day intros, chess exercises and the onboarding rules are text only. The Read-aloud button is a 36px secondary chip.
2. Reading level is the same at age 6-8 and age 11+. The age profile (age.ts:31-67) changes order and difficulty, not wording or length.
3. The Russian copy breaks the owner's gender-neutrality rule in child-facing buttons shown after every solved task ("Я объяснил решение", "Я нашёл другой способ").
4. Header targets are 32-42px, and RU/UZ sits flush against the parent lock.
5. bigText and hintPause are parent-only. bigText touches only the math session. There is no dyslexia or spacing option.
6. Mini chess boards create 554 unnamed tab stops on /chess/openings.

I rate none as a blocker: every flow can be finished with a parent's help. The first four are major for the main personas.

**Keep (strengths):**

- Task statements are short, with one instruction per sentence and an inline math chip (rich-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg: 'Посчитай: 19 + 19 + 19 = ?'). Day pages are navigable by emoji tabs with ✓ badges alone, which suits a pre-reader.
- Narration is real: 165 task clips plus 23 lesson clips plus 52 'Знаешь ли ты?' clips exist in both RU and UZ (voice-clips.json). Praise and retry clips play after answers (voice.ts:cheer). Nothing autoplays on page load, so audio is never a surprise. There is no browser speech synthesis.
- Feedback never relies on colour alone: Feedback.tsx pairs an emoji, text and a tone (🎉 / 🤔 / 💬). The wording is soft and has no 'wrong'. Hints arrive one by one with an optional 15s pause and an honest dead-end line, 'Обсуди задачу со взрослым' (HintLadder.tsx:93).
- Contrast of primary text is excellent: ink on paper 14.7:1, muted on paper 5.84:1, brand-dark on brand-soft 8.77:1, ink on the orange 'Начать' button 7.28:1, board coordinates 5.58:1. Fonts are Nunito at a generous line-height, never justified. The app has no horizontal overflow on any page (hOverflow false), and zoom is allowed (viewport has no maximum-scale).
- Global 3px brand focus ring (globals.css:102), and the tab order on task pages is clean with descriptive names ('Задача 5: Робот идёт к флажку'). prefers-reduced-motion is handled globally (globals.css:253). noName is 0 on home, day, parent and puzzle-less pages.
- Privacy and safety are strong for a children's product: no chat, no accounts required, no external requests on first load, robots noindex, progress local only, PIN gate for the parent area, a two-step reset ('Точно удалить весь прогресс?'), and a confirm on file import. Undo exists in the robot game.
- Chess board help shapes: target dot vs capture ring are different shapes (ChessBoard.tsx:16-17), not just colours. The promotion picker has named buttons and Escape/cancel (ChessBoard.tsx:298-317). Board taps are tolerant of finger wobble (dragActivationDistance: 8).
- The language switch is visible on every screen as RU/UZ, and the Uzbek UI is idiomatic and complete (RU/UZ pairs for every string). The Uzbek audio is a separate clone voice (UZ_CLIPS).

### Findings

#### A11Y-1 · major · confirmed — Narration stops at the task statement: hints, day intros, chess exercises, and after-task questions cannot be listened to

- **Who:** Aziz, Parent
- **Problem:** The ListenButton is used in only six places: task statement, chess lesson step, level legend, 'Знаешь ли ты?', secrets, and the welcome. The text that a stuck first-grader most needs is silent: the five hints, the day intro paragraph, chess exercise questions, drill and puzzle instructions, the robot-game status and the after-solve questions ('Объясни…'). The 'cheer' audio only says a generic praise/retry line. So a pre-reader gets the problem read aloud but not the help for it.
- **Evidence:** grep: ListenButton imported only by TaskView.tsx:57, HomeDashboard.tsx:401, ChessLesson.tsx:84, ChessLevelView, Secrets, DidYouKnow. Not in HintLadder.tsx, AfterSolve.tsx, DayIntro.tsx, ChessExercises.tsx.; HintLadder.tsx:71: hint text is rendered in a plain span with no audio; the first-hint line 'Застрял? Подсказки открываются по одной…' is also unvoiced (HintLadder.tsx:57-62).; DayIntro for /week/3/day5 measured at 131 words of main text with no Listen button (probe: main innerText), including 'Доказательство строится, как стена из кирпичей… математики умеют доказывать, что чего-то не бывает'.; voice-clips.json: ru and uz each hold 240 clips = 165 tasks + 52 dyk + 23 lessons; no 'hint', 'intro', 'exercise' or 'drill' kind (voice.ts:58-75).; kid7-phone-pawn-ex-t1.jpg: the exercise question 'Какого цвета клетка h1 — в правом…' has no audio control.
- **Principle:** Pre-readers need every instruction available in a non-text channel (dual coding; UDL 'multiple means of representation'). Help must be as accessible as the problem. Kids' products such as Khan Academy Kids and Duolingo ABC read every instruction aloud.
- **Impact:** Aziz solves the first sentence by audio, then stalls on hints and exercises he cannot read. He needs a parent for each hint, which defeats independent practice and the 'hints open one by one' principle for his age group.
- **Skeptic:** Reproduced. Only six components import ListenButton (grep of src/). HintLadder.tsx:68-73 renders hint text in a plain span, and the 'Застрял?' line at :57-62 is unvoiced. Voice clips cover tasks, lessons and DYK only (voice.ts VOICE_CLIPS). Live probes: after opening a hint on /week/1/day/1#task-1 the only Listen button on the page is the task one; /week/3/day/5 has 0 Listen buttons with 146 words in main; /chess/pawn#exercise-2 has 0 Listen buttons.

#### A11Y-2 · minor · partly — The Read-aloud button is a small, low-key chip, not the primary action for a pre-reader; no autoplay or opt-in default

- **Who:** Aziz, Parent
- **Problem:** The button is 36px tall at 14px text, styled as a pale brand-soft chip next to tag chips. It shares a row with 'Задача 1 из 8' and in Uzbek wraps to its own line. In the welcome dialog it comes after about 60 words of text and below the fold. Nothing is read on opening a task, and there is no 'read to me automatically' option for 6-8-year-olds, even though the Start/Begin tap gives a user gesture that would permit autoplay. The label is inconsistent: 'Прочитать' on tasks, 'Послушать' on lessons and legends, 'Послушать приветствие' on the welcome. The state label is a text-only 'Стоп'.
- **Evidence:** ListenButton.tsx:30 'min-h-9 … px-3 py-1 text-sm' = 36px high, measured 122x36 on /week/1/day/1#task-1 (probe1) vs the 44px target other controls use.; richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg: 'Oʻqib berish' wraps below 'Razminka / Oson / 1-masala (jami 8 ta)'. rich-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg: it hangs under the tag chips.; Welcome dialog: the audio button is at y≈1440 px (of a 1066 px scroll content), under the three rules (fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg); dialog scrollHeight 1066 vs height 807 (probe4).; TaskView.tsx:57 label 'Прочитать' vs ListenButton.tsx:36 default 'Послушать'.; No audio request fires on load for either fresh or rich state (probe1: audio reqs []).
- **Principle:** Primary action prominence for the user who needs it most (Fitts's law and visual hierarchy). Recognition over recall: an icon-first control with consistent labelling. Targets of 44-48px for children (WCAG 2.5.5 / Material 48dp).
- **Impact:** Aziz may never discover that tasks can be read to him, or may miss the small chip after the first screen. A parent who has not read the settings text cannot make 'read to me' the default.
- **Skeptic:** Real parts: ListenButton measures 122x36 (min-h-9, ListenButton.tsx:30); no audio request fires on load (reqs []); labels are inconsistent (Прочитать in TaskView.tsx:57 vs Послушать default vs Послушать приветствие); in Uzbek the chip wraps to its own line under the tag chips (richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg). Refuted part: the claim that the welcome audio button is below the fold at y~1440. In the live dialog the button is at y=548 of an 839px viewport, and in fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg it sits right after the three rules in the first screen. The button has a 🔊 emoji and is a distinct pale chip, so discovery is not as bad as claimed. A missing 'read automatically' option is a design choice, since autoplay is contentious, not a defect.

#### A11Y-3 · minor · partly — Reading level does not adapt to age 6-8: adult-register copy is shown to Aziz in both languages

- **Who:** Aziz, Dilnoza
- **Problem:** The age profile only changes ordering and difficulty (age.ts:31-67), not wording or length. Long, abstract sentences with hard words appear at the same size on the same screens for the junior profile: home hero, level goals, lessons, legends, robot personalities, the day intro and footers. Uzbek copy has the same issue plus unusual jargon. Concrete early-reader tasks are fine, so the problem is mostly the framing and chess text.
- **Evidence:** rich-phone-home-t1.jpg / kid7-phone-home-t1.jpg: hero 'Математика — это место, где происходят интересные вещи' (abstract definition); kid7 home has 648 words (probe5).; kid7-phone-pawn-t1.jpg: 'Узнать шахматную доску и имена клеток, расстановку фигур и то, как ходит и бьёт пешка.' (one 18-word infinitive sentence).; kid7-phone-pawn-t2.jpg: 'В древней индийской чатуранге пешки были пехотинцами — самыми простыми воинами армии. Они шли только вперёд: отступать пехоте не полагалось.'; /week/3/day/5 intro (probe5): 'Доказательство строится, как стена из кирпичей… доказывать, что чего-то не бывает'.; kid7-phone-game-robot-t2.jpg: 'Берёт фигуры, которые плохо стоят, дальше одного хода не считает.'; footer 'Любопытство → Мышление → Рассуждение → Открытие → Уверенность'.; richuz-phone-play-t1.jpg: 'Fora — robot oʻynaydi: … f piyodasiz', 'Deyarli tavakkaliga yuradi, lekin baʼzan motni payqab qoladi', and a four-clause intro 'Robot bilan oʻyna, onang yoki otang bilan bitta ekranda bellash, piyodalar jangini uyushtir yoki yolgʻiz shohga mot qilishni mashq qil.'
- **Principle:** Cognitive load and readability for early readers: sentence length of 6-10 words, concrete nouns, one idea per sentence, written vocabulary matched to decoding skill (Chall reading stages, Sweller). Reading for pleasure should not be gated by decoding.
- **Impact:** Aziz skips or guesses at everything beyond the one-line task. He loses the 'story' hooks (legends, robots) that are meant to motivate him, and may feel the product is not for him.
- **Skeptic:** The quoted copy exists: the home hero 'Математика — это место, где происходят интересные вещи' appears in the age-7 body text (probe), and the robot description 'Берёт фигуры, которые плохо стоят, дальше одного хода не считает' appears on /chess/play. But these are secondary, decorative or intro texts, while the core task statement is short and voiced. The week-3 day-5 proof intro is not a screen Aziz (age 7, junior profile) would normally reach. I did not verify that age.ts changes only order and difficulty, nor the 648-word count. The pedagogic point is valid but is over-scoped as 'major'.

#### A11Y-4 · major · confirmed — First-launch onboarding is reading- and typing-heavy for a 7-year-old, with a disabled CTA that does not say why

- **Who:** Aziz, Parent
- **Problem:** Before any task the dialog presents a 60-word welcome and three rules, requires the child to type a name (the 'Поехали!' button stays disabled until a name is entered, with no hint), and then shows a parent-oriented profile paragraph after choosing an age. The disabled button is white text on 45% opacity brand, about 2.3:1. The dialog is role=dialog aria-modal but focus stays on BODY and Tab leaves the dialog into the page behind (probe2).
- **Evidence:** fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg and fresh-dialog-end.png: welcome copy plus rules, 'Имя' input, age grid 6-15+, disabled 'Поехали! 🚀'.; fresh-dialog-end2.png: after tapping 7 the child sees 'Младший профиль · 6–8 лет. Всё по порядку: задания дня одно за другим, шахматные уровни открываются по очереди, робот «Пешка», задача дня с одной звезды.'; probe2: 'go disabled initially true; after age only disabled? true; after name disabled? false'; Tab sequence 'IN:15+' then 'OUT:Начать ▶ | OUT:🖨 Распечатать'; active element at open is BODY.; ui.tsx:34 'disabled:opacity-45' on a primary button gives white on about #a9a4ef = 2.3:1.
- **Principle:** Reduce first-run friction (progressive disclosure; Nielsen 'visibility of system status', error prevention). Ask a young child for the minimum, and explain disabled states. Modal dialogs should capture focus (WAI-ARIA APG).
- **Impact:** Aziz either stops until a parent types for him or enters a placeholder name; a screen-reader user is lost behind the modal. The most important first minute is the least inclusive.
- **Skeptic:** Reproduced on a fresh profile. document.activeElement is BODY when the dialog opens. Tab goes first through OUT elements (logo, ♞, ✍️, 🔒, RU, UZ) before reaching the dialog, and after '15+' leaves to 'Начать ▶' and cards behind the modal, so there is no focus trap or initial focus. 'Поехали! 🚀' is disabled (opacity 0.45 over brand) with no text explaining that a name and an age are needed (fresh.png: placeholder 'Имя' only). The name is a required typed field for a 7-year-old. Caveat: WCAG exempts disabled controls from the contrast requirement, so the 2.3:1 point is weak, but the missing reason and the focus handling stand.

#### A11Y-5 · major · confirmed — Russian child-facing copy still addresses every child as a boy

- **Who:** Dilnoza, Parent
- **Problem:** The owner's rule is 'Russian text gender-neutral toward the child', but masculine past-tense forms remain in high-frequency, child-facing places. The worst offender is the after-solve self-report row, shown after every solved task. Uzbek has no grammatical gender, so this exists only in the Russian UI.
- **Evidence:** AfterSolve.tsx:9-12 buttons: 'Я объяснил решение', 'Я нашёл другой способ', 'Было трудно, но я справился'.; DayFinish.tsx:61 'нашёл другой способ'; HintLadder.tsx:59 'Сначала попробуй подумать сам'; WallLab.tsx:113 'Ты нашёл все числа'; ChessExercises.tsx:709 'Ты нашёл все решения'; ChessDiary.tsx:139 'ты выиграл у робота'; GameReview.tsx:110 'чтобы в следующий раз ты их нашёл сам'; src/content/chess/endgames.ts:207 'Ты сберёг … и выиграл'; week1/day4.ts:340 'что нашёл ВСЕ варианты'; week3/day4.ts:472 'Как бы ты нашёл'.
- **Principle:** Inclusive language: the child should feel addressed. Gender-neutral rewrites such as 'Объяснение готово', 'Нашлось ещё решение', 'Было трудно, а получилось!', 'Все решения найдены', 'подумай сначала сама или сам'. Girls in STEM tasks are sensitive to stereotype cues (stereotype threat).
- **Impact:** Half the audience is told, on every task, that the mathematician is a 'he'. It also signals that the owner's own principle is not fully enforced.
- **Skeptic:** Grep confirms masculine past forms in child-facing UI: AfterSolve.tsx:9-12 ('Я объяснил решение', 'Я нашёл другой способ', 'Было трудно, но я справился'), DayFinish.tsx:61, ChessExercises.tsx:709, GameReview.tsx:110, WallLab.tsx:113. There are more than the auditor listed: GridPuzzles.tsx:279 'Ты нашёл все ... способов', RobotPuzzle.tsx:233, MagicTrianglePuzzle.tsx:236, NumberPuzzles.tsx:300. This breaks the owner's stated gender-neutral rule on a screen shown after every solved task. Uzbek has no such issue.

#### A11Y-6 · minor · partly — Touch targets and type size are below child-friendly thresholds on key controls, and RU/UZ sits flush against the parent lock

- **Who:** Aziz
- **Problem:** Header targets measure 36x34, 42x34, 42x34 and RU/UZ 33x32 each with no gap between them (and 10 px from the 🔒 button). One accidental tap flips the whole interface language. The shared 'sm' button is 36px high, ListenButton 36px, welcome Русский/Oʻzbekcha 36px, 'Сдаться'/'Новая партия' 36px. The 'изменить' profile link is 55x16 at 12px. Many pages carry text under 14px, down to 10-11px on the encyclopedia and endgames pages.
- **Evidence:** probe6 header: Шахматы 36x34 @x190, Мои задачи 42x34 @x230, Родителям 42x34 @x276, RU 33x32 @x328, UZ 33x32 @x361.; audit-metrics.json: small44 = 10 on phone /, 11-14 on day pages, 12 on /chess, 37 on /chess/play, 133 on /chess/history (tiny32 120). textUnder14 = 63 on /, 73 on /chess, 70 on /chess/awards, 402 on /chess/history (309 nodes at 11px), 294 on /chess/endgames (240 nodes at 10.3px).; ui.tsx:23 size sm 'min-h-9'; ListenButton.tsx:30 'min-h-9'; probe6 'изменить 55x16'.
- **Principle:** Fitts's law and motor development: a 7-year-old has lower pointer precision, so 44-48 CSS px targets with 8px spacing are required. Early readers need 16px+ body text (WCAG 1.4.4, 2.5.5).
- **Impact:** Mis-taps change language or leave the lesson. Aziz taps the wrong chip. The smaller pages (history, endgames) are effectively unreadable for him on a 6.3-inch phone.
- **Skeptic:** Measurements reproduced: header 36x34 (♞), 42x34 (✍️), 42x34 (🔒), RU 33x32, UZ 33x32 with no gap between RU and UZ (they sit in one segmented pill, see play.png) and 10px from 🔒. Welcome Русский/Oʻzbekcha 36px high. ui.tsx:23 size sm is min-h-9. audit-metrics.json confirms small44 10 on /, 12 on /chess, 37 on /chess/play, 133 on /chess/history (tiny32 120), and textUnder14 63, 73, 402. Overstated: every primary action is 44-56px (Проверить 56, Открыть подсказку 44, Дальше 44, nav 44). All targets meet the WCAG 2.5.8 minimum of 24px. The worst pages (history, endgames) are encyclopedic and not the Aziz core flow. The 'изменить 55x16' figure was not checked.

#### A11Y-7 · major · confirmed — Reading and comfort settings are parent-only, partial and undiscoverable; no dyslexia options

- **Who:** Aziz, Parent
- **Problem:** 'Крупный текст' and 'Пауза перед подсказкой' live only in the PIN-gated parent settings (SettingsPanel.tsx:81-98). bigText multiplies a single class by 1.15em and is applied only inside the math DaySession (globals.css:129; child-text used in 5 places: HintLadder:71, AfterSolve:30, TaskView:70, DayIntro:38 and DaySession:50). It does nothing in chess lessons, hints in chess, home, drills or puzzles. Neither setting is defaulted by age profile (age.ts), and the child cannot reach them. There is no line-spacing, letter-spacing or 'read everything' control. Uppercase 12px labels and heavy black weights are used widely, which hurts dyslexic readers. In Uzbek, the oʻ/gʻ modifier letter renders detached in the Nunito fallback, so words look split.
- **Evidence:** SettingsPanel.tsx:81-98 (hintPause, bigText toggles) and globals.css:129-131 (.big-text .child-text { font-size: 1.15em }).; grep child-text|big-text: DaySession.tsx:50 sets the class; no chess component does.; richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg: 'ko ʻr', 'o ʻzingga' with visible gap; baʼzan uses a different apostrophe on richuz-phone-play-t1.jpg.; HintLadder.tsx:68 'text-xs … uppercase'; rich-phone-home / welcome: 'СЕГОДНЯШНЕЕ ЗАНЯТИЕ', 'НЕДЕЛЯ 2 · НЕДЕЛЯ ИНСТРУМЕНТОВ' in 12px caps.
- **Principle:** Customisable reading support (UDL, WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing), with defaults chosen for the age rather than expecting a parent to find them. Dyslexia-friendly typography: sentence case, open letterforms, 1.5 line-height, short lines.
