- **Impact:** The features exist but a family will not find or benefit from them where it counts (chess lessons). A slow reader like Aziz gets default sizing everywhere except math task text.
- **Skeptic:** bigText is wired only through DaySession.tsx:50 (class big-text) and .child-text; with bigText=true seeded, /chess/pawn contains 0 .child-text nodes, so the setting does nothing in chess. The settings live in the PIN-gated SettingsPanel; state.ts:227 defaults bigText:false regardless of age. No dyslexia, spacing or letter-spacing controls exist. The detached Uzbek modifier letter is visible in richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg ('ko ʻr', 'o ʻzingga', 'Yana o ʻylab ko ʻr') even though the text itself is correct (Nunito glyph spacing). The Uzbek glyph gap is cosmetic and the weakest sub-point.

#### A11Y-8 · minor · partly — Chess boards expose unnamed tab stops (554 on /chess/openings) and English screen-reader announcements; the dialog does not trap focus

- **Who:** Dilnoza, Parent
- **Problem:** Every piece of every react-chessboard instance is a focusable div role=button tabindex=0 with no accessible name, including decorative mini-boards. /chess/openings has 554 of them, /chess/games 196, /chess/endgames 54, play boards 32. The only keyboard route to move a piece is the library's drag mode (Space, arrows, Space), which is undocumented in the UI, and its live region announces in English ('Draggable item e2 was moved over droppable area e3.') while the UI is Russian or Uzbek. Empty squares are not focusable. The welcome dialog's focus handling is covered in A11Y-4.
- **Evidence:** audit-metrics.json noName: phone /chess 16, /chess/puzzles 16, /chess/openings 554 (interactive 579), /chess/games 196, /chess/endgames 54, /chess/play#robot-2-w 32.; probe1: noName elements are all 'DIV role=button tabindex=0 inBoard' (14x14 px pieces in openings cards).; probe2/3: piece outerHTML 'role=button tabindex=0 aria-disabled=true aria-roledescription=draggable'; live region 'assertive: Draggable item e2 was moved over droppable area e3'; keyboard drag does complete (e2 -> e3).; Only the promotion picker has names (ChessBoard.tsx:315-330).
- **Principle:** Keyboard and assistive-tech access (WCAG 2.1.1, 4.1.2, 3.1.1). Decorative content should be hidden from the accessibility tree, and live regions should use the page language.
- **Impact:** A keyboard or switch user must tab through hundreds of stops on openings; TalkBack announces 'button, draggable' with no piece or square. Lower probability for the core personas, but a clear inclusion gap.
- **Skeptic:** Reproduced: /chess/openings has 554 elements with role=button tabindex=0, all without aria-label or text, none inside aria-hidden/inert, and each is aria-disabled draggable with aria-roledescription=draggable. Metrics agree (noName 554 / 196 / 54 / 16). Boards do get role=group with an aria-label (ChessBoard.tsx:198), but pieces are unnamed. I did not reproduce the English live-region announcement or the keyboard-drag flow, so those claims are unverified. Severity is minor for the target personas (touch on phones), as the auditor admitted.

#### A11Y-9 · minor · partly — Right/wrong marks on the board are colour-only and indistinguishable under red-green colour vision

- **Who:** Dilnoza, Aziz
- **Problem:** Square states 'good' and 'bad' are semi-transparent green and red fills; 'hint' is a green ring and 'selected' an amber ring. There is no glyph or pattern. Under deuteranopia simulation the good and bad fills differ by only 1.03-1.08:1 on light and dark squares. On a light square, the green at 55% is 1.47:1 against the plain square. In places where the flash is the only feedback (the coordinate trainer), the child gets no second cue.
- **Evidence:** ChessBoard.tsx:21-22 good rgba(16,185,129,.55), bad rgba(239,68,68,.55); :23 hint ring #10b981; :15 selected ring #f59e0b.; Computed (this audit, Machado 2009): light square good vs bad 1.54 (protan), 1.08 (deutan); dark square 1.59 / 1.03; green fill vs plain square 1.1-1.5.; CoordinateTrainer.tsx:185, EndgameSchool.tsx:258-259 and ChessExercises.tsx:133-134 use these marks as the main cue.
- **Principle:** Do not convey meaning by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1). About 8% of boys have a red-green deficiency; add a ✓ or ✗ glyph, a different shape, or a pattern to each state.
- **Impact:** A colour-blind child may not read the result of a tap on a square, and the product's 'no shame' feedback depends on seeing it. Most of the time the Feedback text card saves the day, so the severity is minor.
- **Skeptic:** Code confirmed: ChessBoard.tsx:21-22 good = rgba(16,185,129,.55), bad = rgba(239,68,68,.55), hint is a green ring, with no glyph or pattern. I did not recompute the deuteranopia ratios. Feedback also appears as text in an aria-live region (ChessExercises.tsx:140), so the colour is not the only channel in exercises. The point holds mainly for the coordinate trainer.

#### A11Y-10 · minor · partly — Two destructive game actions are one tap, undersized and prominent

- **Who:** Aziz
- **Problem:** In the robot game panel, 'Новая партия' (the only filled primary button) and 'Сдаться' are one-tap with no confirmation, sized 36px (Button sm), and sit in a wrapped row with Подсказка, Отменить and Перевернуть. A 7-year-old's mis-tap discards or resigns a game he may have worked on for 10 minutes. The same pattern applies to 'Сменить PIN-код', which clears the PIN with no confirmation. Strengths: undo exists, and 'Сбросить прогресс' needs a second tap.
- **Evidence:** PlayBoard.tsx:423-441; kid7-phone-game-robot-t2.jpg shows the filled 'Новая партия' under 'Перевернуть' and a faint ghost 'Сдаться'.; SettingsPanel.tsx:153 onClick={forgetPin} with no confirm.; SettingsPanel.tsx:167-190: two-step reset exists, a good pattern to reuse.
- **Principle:** Error prevention and forgiveness (Nielsen #5, #9). Destructive actions need a confirm or an undo toast, and must not be the most attractive button.
- **Impact:** Occasional lost games and discouragement. With 'no shame' feedback elsewhere, a lost game caused by a misclick is the one place a child feels unfairly treated.
- **Skeptic:** Confirmed: PlayBoard.tsx:434-441 'Сдаться' (ghost, size sm = 36px) calls setResigned(true) with no confirmation; 'Новая партия' is the only filled primary button and restart() (:234-246) wipes the game with no confirm. Overstated: resign is recoverable, because undo() sets resigned false and Отменить is enabled when plies exist (:215-225). The 'Сменить PIN-код' example is wrong in scope: SettingsPanel is rendered inside ParentGate, so a child cannot reach it unless already past the gate.

#### A11Y-11 · minor · confirmed — The parent gate can be opened by any literate child

- **Who:** Dilnoza, Parent
- **Problem:** The 'Забыли PIN-код?' panel prints the reset word on the screen ('напишите слово сбросить'), so a ten-year-old who reads it can reset the PIN and see answers, notes and settings. Unlock is a sessionStorage flag that lasts for the browser tab, and there is no attempt limit on a 4-digit PIN. The file itself says it is only a 'мягкая защита'. The first-run text also says parents 'могут поменять имя в своём разделе', which draws a competitive child's attention to the area.
- **Evidence:** ParentGate.tsx:7-8 RESET_WORDS = ['сбросить','oʻchirish']; the panel text prints the word in bold; no lockout in unlockWithPin (parentGate.ts:57-66).; parentGate.ts:5-8 comment 'Это мягкая защита от случайного подглядывания ребёнка, а не система безопасности'.; parentGate.ts:12 UNLOCK_KEY in sessionStorage.
- **Principle:** Parent gates in children's products should require an adult skill, such as a small arithmetic question or press-and-hold, not a visible password (COPPA/Google Families style guidance). Add attempt throttling.
- **Impact:** Moderate: the gate stops accidental taps for 7-year-olds (the main case), but not a curious older child, who can read the answers or alter settings.
- **Skeptic:** ParentGate.tsx:108-138 prints the reset word in bold ('напишите слово сбросить', and in Uzbek 'oʻchirish'); the Сбросить button enables on typing it and calls forgetPin, after which the gate is in create-PIN mode. parentGate.ts unlockWithPin has no attempt counter, and the unlock flag is sessionStorage. A literate 10-year-old can bypass it. The file comment itself calls it soft protection, so the real impact is limited to older children.

#### A11Y-12 · polish · partly — Several state and secondary-text colours are low contrast or state-ambiguous

- **Who:** Aziz, Dilnoza, Parent
- **Problem:** Disabled primary buttons ('Проверить', 'Tekshirish', 'Поехали!') are white on 45% opacity brand, about 2.3:1, and nothing explains why they are disabled. Hero secondary text is white at 80% on a purple gradient, roughly 3.2-3.4:1 at 14px. The settings toggles are 'bg-black/15' (1.41:1 against the card) and distinguish on from off only by knob position and a brand fill, with no on/off words. White on mint #10b981 is 2.54:1 and white on amber 2.15:1.
- **Evidence:** ui.tsx:34 disabled:opacity-45; rich-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg greyed 'Проверить'.; probe5: hero line computed color oklab(… / 0.8), 14px: '8 задач · около 25 минут · привычка…'; rich-phone-home-t1.jpg 'Режим занятий: 9–10 лет · изменить'.; SettingsPanel.tsx:345 'bg-black/15' off state; contrast 1.41:1 (computed).; Computed ratios: white on #10b981 2.54, white on #f59e0b 2.15, white 75% on #7358ee 3.43.
- **Principle:** Contrast of at least 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for UI components (WCAG 1.4.3, 1.4.11). Disabled controls should still say why, for example 'Введи число'.
- **Impact:** Mostly comfort on outdoor phones and for tired eyes; for Aziz a greyed 'Проверить' reads as 'broken' rather than 'type a number first'.
- **Skeptic:** Disabled state confirmed (opacity 0.45 on brand, computed on the welcome CTA and in richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg 'Tekshirish') with no explanation of why. But disabled controls are exempt from WCAG contrast, so the 2.3:1 figure is not a violation; the lack of an explanation is the real issue. I did not verify the toggle bg-black/15 or the hero 80% white ratios.

**Missed by the auditor (found by the skeptic):**

- (minor) Audio failures and loading are silent: no loading state, no error message, no preload — voice.ts:112-132 playClip creates new Audio(src), emits 'playing' immediately (button flips to Стоп) and only does play().catch(() => reset). There is no onerror handler, no buffering indicator, no retry or message. On 4G or offline (the stated Aziz context), a tap either waits with a 'Стоп' button while nothing sounds, or silently reverts. A pre-reader cannot tell it is broken.
- (minor) Hint progress indicator is colour-only and the aria-label is on a role-less div — HintLadder.tsx:42-53: <div className='flex gap-1' aria-label='Открыто подсказок: x из y'> contains empty spans distinguished only by bg-sun vs bg-[#fde68a]. A generic div's aria-label is generally not announced by screen readers, and the dots rely on a pale-yellow vs yellow difference only.
- (minor) After-solve reflection chips and 'А ещё подумай' questions are text-only for a pre-reader, and the self-report asks for reading and abstract self-assessment — AfterSolve.tsx:18-60: follow-up questions render as plain li with .child-text (no Listen), and the four marks are long sentences ('Было трудно, но я справился'). Emoji are present, but the labels carry the meaning; no audio exists for them (A11Y-1 covers the question side, but not the self-report buttons).

### Solutions

#### A11Y-S1 · modify · effort L · impact 5 — Voice for the help, not only for the question: hints, day intros, chess exercises and after-solve prompts

- **Addresses:** A11Y-1
- **Proposal:** Extend the existing recorded-narration pipeline from 'task statement' to every text a stuck first-grader needs. Add four new clip kinds next to tasks/lessons/dyk: 'hints' (id = taskId-1..5), 'intros' (week-day), 'exercises' (levelId-index, question text only), 'prompts' (the first-hint line, 'Подсказки закончились…', AfterSolve follow-ups headings). Each opened hint gets its own icon-only speaker button at the right edge of the hint card; the new hint does NOT autoplay unless the child enabled 'Читать мне' (A11Y-S2). Day intro gets the same big speaker as the task card. Chess exercise question gets a speaker beside the number chips. Cost control, because 5 hints x 165 tasks x 2 languages is ~1,650 clips: ship in phases. Phase 1 = week 1 hints (about 275 per language), the 21 day intros, the 4 fixed prompts, and the questions of chess levels 1-2 (the content Aziz meets in his first two weeks). Phase 2 = weeks 2-3 and the remaining levels, ordered by traffic. Clips load on demand (never prefetched on 4G; see A11Y-S16 for the parent-triggered offline pack). Extend voiceText.ts with hintVoiceText / introVoiceText / exerciseVoiceText and extend voice-clips.json hashes so the existing stale-recording test also catches edited hints. If a clip does not exist for a language, the button is simply absent (current rule, no browser speech). Add a generation script (the repo has no TTS script now, only build-puzzles and fetch-chess-images; add scripts/build-voice.mjs that reads the content, hashes the text and calls ElevenLabs only for missing or stale hashes).
- **Revised after review:** Narrate the help in this order. Step 0 (prerequisite): finish A11Y-S5 and the A11Y-S3 day-intro rewrite so no text is recorded twice. Step 1: add the 'hints' kind for week 1 only, 5 x about 55 tasks per language (about 275 per language). Each opened hint gets one 44px icon-only speaker at the right edge of its card (aria-label 'Послушать подсказку 2'). No autoplay in this solution; autoplay belongs only to A11Y-S2. Step 2: the day intros (21) after they are rewritten, using the same speaker as the task card. Step 3: chess exercise questions for levels 1-2, one 44px speaker beside the question title, question only, never the answer. Drop the AfterSolve and 'Подсказки закончились' clips; if the first-hint helper line stays, give it no speaker. Add hintVoiceText and exerciseVoiceText in voiceText.ts. State how backtick math is spoken: digits and operators read as words, e.g. 'девять плюс девять'. Extend voice-clips.json hashes so the existing stale-clip test also covers hints. A missing clip means the button is absent, as today. Write scripts/build-voice.mjs: it reads the content, hashes the text, calls ElevenLabs only for missing or stale hashes, takes the voice id and key from env, and has a --dry-run that prints the character cost. Phase 2 (weeks 2-3, more chess levels) only after phase 1 is tried by real 6-8 year olds. Acceptance: no audio request on page load, exactly one request per tap, hint audio only after the hint is opened, and the hint pause still gates the next hint.
- **UI spec:** HintLadder card (HintLadder.tsx:68-75): each <li> becomes a 2-column flex row: left = step caption + text (text stays 'child-text'), right = a 44x44 round icon button (bg-brand-soft, 🔊 glyph 22px, aria-label 'Послушать подсказку 2'). Playing state: bg-brand, glyph becomes ⏹, 3 small equaliser bars animate (static under prefers-reduced-motion). The first-hint helper paragraph (HintLadder.tsx:57-62) gets the same button inline at its end. DayIntro.tsx: speaker placed in the intro card's first row, same 56px pill as the task card (A11Y-S2). ChessExercises.tsx: under the question title, one 44px speaker; for 'which colour is h1' type questions the clip reads the question only, never the answer. AfterSolve.tsx: heading 'А ещё подумай' gets one speaker that reads the follow-up list; the four self-report buttons stay text+emoji (they are labels, not paragraphs). Only one clip plays at a time (voice.ts already stops the previous). Opening hint N while hint N-1 is playing stops N-1. Hint pause (cooldown) still gates opening the next hint; audio never bypasses it.
- **Copy:** RU: Послушать подсказку · Подсказка 2 · Послушать / UZ: Maslahatni tinglash · 2-maslahat · Tinglash
- **Files:** src/components/task/HintLadder.tsx, src/components/task/AfterSolve.tsx, src/components/session/DayIntro.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessExercises.tsx, src/components/ListenButton.tsx, src/lib/voice.ts, src/lib/voiceText.ts, src/content/voice-clips.json, scripts/build-voice.mjs (new)
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo ABC and Khan Academy Kids (every instruction is spoken); UDL 'multiple means of representation'; Sesame Workshop/NN-g audio-plus-visual for young children; Desmos principle that help must be as reachable as the problem.
- **Guardrails:** Audio must not become a shortcut around the hint ladder: each clip is tied to an already opened hint, the 15s pause still applies, and the last rung never speaks a final answer. No clip says 'wrong', no buzzer, no praise of ability ('умный'). No autoplay on page load or on opening a hint unless the child/parent turned 'Читать мне' on. Do not prefetch the pack on mobile data. Keep the recorded voices identical to the existing narrator so it does not feel like a different 'teacher'.
- **Test plan:** Vitest: every hint/intro/exercise text in phase-1 scope has a voice-clips.json hash that matches textHash (stale-clip guard, same as tasks). Playwright (Pixel 7, ru and uz): open task 1, open hint 1 and 2, assert one speaker button per opened hint, clicking issues exactly one /audio/ request with 200 or 206 and sets aria-pressed; assert no audio request on load. Coverage metric: percent of child-visible text blocks on the week-1 junior path that have a speaker (target 100 percent for statement, hints, intro). Usability: 5 children aged 6-8 on a mid-range Android; count how many times per task they ask an adult to read something (target: halve versus today), and median time from 'stuck' to hint 2.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Right target: all 165 tasks have exactly 5 hints of about 14 words (max 36), so a hint clip is short, cheap and is the text a stuck 7-year-old cannot decode. The pipeline fits: ListenButton and voice.ts already stop the previous clip, and the hint pause is untouched. But the scope is too wide and the order is wrong. (1) Hints today contain masculine forms ('Каждый раз ты взял на 1 больше', week1/day1.ts hint 5), and my regex finds about 88 candidate masculine/first-person hits in content and components. Recording hints before the A11Y-S5 sweep means re-recording them. (2) Day intros are what A11Y-S3 rewrites; recording the long adult-register intro first wastes it. (3) AfterSolve follow-ups and the 'Подсказки закончились' line are reflective or one-off text. A speaker on every block turns the screen into a row of speakers, which is clutter. (4) The repo has no TTS script. The Uzbek voice is the owner's cloned voice (task #32), so build-voice.mjs needs a voice id and API key from env, never committed. (5) Hints contain backtick math ('`9 + 9 + 9`'); hintVoiceText must define how it is read, or the recording says 'backtick'. The existing taskVoiceText has the same caveat. (6) ChessExercises is not in the clip pipeline at all today (voice-clips.json has tasks, lessons and dyk only), so it is new work.

#### A11Y-S2 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — Make 'Послушать' the primary control for pre-readers: 56px icon-first button, one consistent label, optional 'Читать мне' auto-read after a tap

- **Addresses:** A11Y-2, A11Y-7
- **Proposal:** Replace the 36px pale chip with a dedicated SpeakerButton (variant 'xl' of ListenButton) used on task cards, lessons, day intros and the welcome. It is a filled brand pill, at least 56px high, 🔊 first, label second, on its own row at the top of the card, left-aligned, ABOVE the statement; the 'Задача 1 из 8' and tag chips move to the next line. One label everywhere: 'Послушать' / 'Tinglash' (retire 'Прочитать'/'Oʻqib berish' and 'Послушать приветствие'). Add a setting 'autoRead' (src/lib/state.ts Settings + sanitiser near line 282-290). Default is derived, not stored: autoRead ?? (ageProfile(age) === 'junior'). Behaviour: when a task card becomes the active card AFTER the session already saw a user gesture (the 'Начать' tap, a 'Дальше' tap, a day tab tap), the statement clip plays once. Never on a cold page load, never twice for the same task in one session, stops on navigation or when the child taps stop. If the browser rejects play() (NotAllowedError) the button does a single soft pulse and shows a tooltip 'Нажми, чтобы послушать' - no error text. Phase 2 (optional, M): karaoke highlight - use ElevenLabs timestamps at build time to store a small timing JSON per clip and highlight the current word in RichText with bg-brand-soft; verify Uzbek and Russian word boundaries first.
- **Revised after review:** Do now (S): a SpeakerButton variant with min-h-14 for ages 6-8 and min-h-11 for 9+, always on its own row above the statement, the 'Задача 1 из 8' and tag chips below. Style it soft and strong, not primary: white or brand-soft fill, 2px brand border, bold 🔊 22px, label 'Послушать' / 'Tinglash'. It turns solid brand only while playing, with a ⏹ glyph and the label 'Стоп' / 'Toʻxtatish'. Retire 'Прочитать' / 'Oʻqib berish' and 'Послушать приветствие'. Keep aria-pressed. Autoplay, separately and opt-in: add settings.autoRead, default OFF, to the parent settings (and later the child sheet). In the first-run flow of A11Y-S4, the first task statement plays once after the 'Начать' tap as a demo. After that the choice is the parent's: 'Читать задачу вслух сразу' / 'Masalani darrov ovoz chiqarib oʻqish'. When autoRead is on: only the statement, only after a user gesture, once per task per session, never on a cold load, never for feedback, stops on navigation, hidden if sound is off, a NotAllowedError gives a soft pulse and no error text. Do not auto-advance. Remove the karaoke phase. Measure: a 6-8 year old presses the speaker unaided on task 1.
- **UI spec:** SpeakerButton: min-h-14 (56px), min-w-14, px-5, rounded-2xl, bg-brand text-white shadow-[0_4px_0_0_#3730a3], text-base font-extrabold, gap-2. Idle: '🔊 Послушать'. Playing: bg-white text-brand-dark border-2 border-brand, glyph ⏹, label 'Стоп', plus three vertical bars (4x16px) animating scaleY 0.4-1 at 0.6s offsets; reduced motion = static bars. Position on TaskView.tsx:57 area: row 1 = SpeakerButton, row 2 = chips. In Uzbek the button keeps its own row, so there is no more wrap under the chips. For age 9-10 the same component renders at 44px with the label; for 11+ it is the 44px soft chip (current look) so Dilnoza is not talked down to. Welcome and lesson cards use it as the FIRST element. aria-pressed and a live region 'Звучит запись' are kept. Quiet mode: if settings.sound === false the button is hidden (current behaviour) and autoRead is ignored.
- **Copy:** RU: Послушать · Стоп · Нажми, чтобы послушать · Читать мне вслух · Само читает, когда открываешь задачу / UZ: Tinglash · To'xtatish · Tinglash uchun bos · Menga ovoz chiqarib o'qib ber · Masala ochilganda o'zi o'qiydi
- **Files:** src/components/ListenButton.tsx, src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/components/session/DayIntro.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLesson.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLevelView.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/lib/state.ts, src/lib/voice.ts, src/lib/age.ts, src/app/globals.css
- **Inspired by:** Khan Academy Kids and Duolingo ABC (voice-first); NN/g (children skip text, audio can fail silently, give visible fallback); Sesame touch research (large targets); Sweller cognitive load / modality principle for readers who spend working memory on decoding.
- **Guardrails:** Autoplay only after an explicit user gesture and only for the statement, never for feedback, never looping, never on a cold load, always one tap to stop, and it respects the sound switch. No countdown or 'listen now' urgency. Because autoplay on a shared phone can surprise a parent in public, the first time it fires show a 3-second toast 'Читать вслух можно выключить: Аа' linking to the A11Y-S7 sheet. Do not auto-advance after the clip ends.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: fresh junior profile on Pixel 7 - on cold load assert 0 audio requests; after tapping 'Начать' and then 'Дальше' assert exactly 1 clip request per newly opened task and none when returning to a solved task. Measure button box: height >= 56 for age 7, >= 44 for age 9, >= 44 for age 12 (audit-metrics small44 for task pages drops by 1+). Uzbek screenshot: the button is on its own row and no chip wraps. Child test (5 children aged 6-8): percentage who play audio for task 1 without help (target 90 percent, today unknown), and number of accidental stops. Check autoplay-blocked path with a mocked NotAllowedError.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. The problem is real. richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg shows the speaker as a pale 36px chip that wrapped onto its own row in Uzbek, with 'Oʻqib berish' while lessons say 'Tinglash'. TaskView.tsx:57 puts it in a flex-wrap row with three chips. Filing the label as 'Послушать' everywhere is right, and the user gesture from 'Начать' or 'Дальше' does allow autoplay on Chrome Android. Problems: (1) a filled brand pill with a drop shadow at 56px is the same visual class as the primary 'Проверить' button, so two primary buttons compete and a pre-reader may press the wrong one. (2) autoRead defaulting ON for every age 6-8 means the phone starts talking on every task. On a parent's shared phone in a bus or at a mosque that surprises the adult, and there is no first-run consent. A toast that then explains how to switch it off is not enough, and it must not point to an 'Аа' sheet that only the child can reach. (3) The karaoke phase 2 is gold plating: Russian and Uzbek word timing from ElevenLabs timestamps, plus RichText with math and backticks. Drop it. (4) 'Стоп' text with a ⏹ glyph is fine. (5) HomeDashboard has no home-page clip, only the welcome one; the listed file is wrong.

#### A11Y-S3 · modify · effort L · impact 4 — A short-text layer for ages 6-8: kid wording on the five busiest screens, full text behind 'Подробнее'

- **Addresses:** A11Y-3
- **Proposal:** Age currently reorders content but never rewrites it. Add a tiny pair-with-variant helper so a string can have a 'kid' version: forAge({ full: t(...), kid: t(...) }) in src/lib/age.ts (or a useKid() hook next to useT). Rules for kid text: max 8-9 words per sentence, one idea per sentence, concrete nouns, no abstract nouns or definitions, at most 2 sentences visible, the rest behind a 44px 'Подробнее' toggle that carries its own speaker. Scope in this solution is the five busiest surfaces only: (1) welcome (see A11Y-S4), (2) home hero + level cards (HomeDashboard.tsx), (3) day intro (DayIntro.tsx; intro text lives in src/content/week*/day*.ts - add optional introKid), (4) chess hub and level goals (src/content/chess, ChessLevelView.tsx), (5) robot picker and personalities (PlayHub.tsx). Everything stays full-length for ages 9+; the child can flip 'Коротко / Подробно' in the A11Y-S7 sheet so Dilnoza or a strong 7-year-old is never locked into the short version. Tasks themselves are not rewritten (they are already short and have audio). Example rewrites below; Uzbek is written fresh by a human, not machine-translated from Russian. Uzbek note: apostrophes below are plain; convert to the app's oʻ/gʻ letters when committing.
- **Revised after review:** Write short variants only where junior meets framing text on every visit, and show them instead of the long text. Do not hide the long text behind 'Подробнее', and do not add a global toggle. (1) Home hero for junior: one greeting sentence plus the 'what to do' chip, hide the 'Математика — это место…' paragraph and the 'Любопытство → Мышление…' chain (still shown at 9+). (2) Chess level cards: a one-line goal for the 6 levels. (3) Robot cards: name, avatar and strength shown with dots or icons, and no 'Легко!' labels. (4) Day intro: for junior show the greeting line and one concrete sentence ('Сегодня ищем удобные числа. Не торопись.'); the abstract middle paragraph stays for 9+. Add an optional introKid on days; fall back to the full intro. Add a helper forAge({full, kid}) next to useT. Uzbek kid strings are written by a native speaker, not machine-translated. A lint test (average sentence <= 9 words, none > 14) is advisory, not build-breaking. Sequence this before recording day-intro audio (A11Y-S1). Keep the story characters; shorten only the prose.
- **UI spec:** Home hero for junior: line 1 (text-2xl, 2 lines max) 'Привет, {имя}! Сегодня играем в задачи.', line 2 chip '3 задачи · 8 минут' (needs A11Y-S15), one 64px orange 'Начать' button, speaker pill above. The paragraph 'Математика — это место, где происходят интересные вещи' and the footer chain 'Любопытство → Мышление…' are hidden for junior (still shown 9+). Chess level card: icon + level name + ONE line goal. Robot card: avatar + name + one line + 1-3 dice/brain icons for strength (no numbers). 'Подробнее' toggle: 44px ghost button with chevron, expands inline, sets aria-expanded, speaker inside the expanded block. Example kid strings: Pawn goal 'Узнаешь доску, клетки и как ходит пешка.'; Pawn robot '🎲 Играет как придётся. Легко!'; Week 3 day 5 intro 'Сегодня строим доказательство, как стену. Кирпичик за кирпичиком.'; chess hub 'Выбери урок. Робот ждёт.'
- **Copy:** RU: Привет, {имя}! Сегодня играем в задачи. · Узнаешь доску, клетки и как ходит пешка. · Играет как придётся. Легко! · Подробнее / UZ: Salom, {ism}! Bugun masalalar o'ynaymiz. · Taxtani, kataklarni va piyoda qanday yurishini bilib olasan. · Tavakkaliga yuradi. Oson! · Batafsil
- **Files:** src/lib/age.ts, src/lib/i18n.ts, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/session/DayIntro.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLevelView.tsx, src/components/chess/PlayHub.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessSchool.tsx, src/content/types.ts, src/content/chess/_, src/content/week1/_.ts (introKid)
- **Inspired by:** NN/g (children skip long instructions; separate designs for 6-8 and 9-12), Chall reading stages / Sweller cognitive load, Khan Academy Kids 'one idea per screen'.
- **Guardrails:** Do not label the short version 'для малышей' or show it as a downgrade; the toggle is 'Коротко / Подробно' for everyone. Do not remove story hooks (legends, robot characters) - shorten them, keep the character. Do not hide anything a parent needs. Short text must still be gender-neutral (A11Y-S5) and must not add praise of ability or urgency.
- **Test plan:** Vitest on kid strings: average sentence length <= 9 words, no sentence > 14, max 2 visible sentences; fail the build when a surface has a kid variant missing in either language. Playwright kid7 scenario: visible words above the fold on home <= 40 (today kid7 home has 648 words in total, hero 5 lines). Readability check by a Russian and an Uzbek teacher on 20 sampled strings. Child test: 5 children 6-8 read the home screen aloud - time to first correct 'what do I tap'. Verify Uzbek strings fit 412 px without wrapping a button label.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. The finding is right: age.ts only changes order, thresholds and robot, never wording. For example the day 1 intro (week1/day1.ts:12) says 'Математики умеют замечать то, чего не видят другие: удобные числа, скрытые правила…'. That is abstract for a 7-year-old, and the Uzbek version is longer. But the proposal builds a whole second content layer: forAge, introKid in 21+ day files, kid strings in two languages across five surfaces, a 'Подробнее' toggle with its own speaker, and a global 'Коротко / Подробно' switch. Hidden-by-default text plus a toggle is clutter for a child who cannot read either version. An 8-year-old fluent reader would be talked down to, and every future string edit now has four variants. Two further concerns. Welcome is already replaced by A11Y-S4, so it is not a fifth surface. And '🎲 Играет как придётся. Легко!' labels the first robot as 'easy', which can sting a child who loses to it. Tasks themselves are already short with audio, so rewriting the framing text is the cheap, high-return part.

#### A11Y-S4 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — Voice-first three-step first launch: language, age, optional name - rules become one robot tip per task

- **Addresses:** A11Y-4, A11Y-2, A11Y-3
- **Proposal:** Replace the long welcome dialog (HomeDashboard.tsx ~330-452: about 60 words, three rules, listen button below the fold, 1066px content in an 807px dialog, 'Поехали!' disabled until a name is typed) with a stepper of three single-purpose screens that each fit without scrolling on 412x807. Step 1 Language: robot waves, two 72px buttons 'Русский' and 'Oʻzbekcha' (each in its own language, no flags). Tapping one is the user gesture: it sets the language and plays a NEW short clip 'welcome-short' (one sentence, under 5 seconds, both languages). Step 2 Age: the question is spoken (auto after step 1 audio), 10 round buttons 6..15+ in a 5x2 grid at 56px, a tap saves age and advances after 250ms. Step 3 Name: one input, a speaker, and a 'Без имени' button of EQUAL size to 'Поехали!'; 'Поехали!' is never disabled (empty name falls back to the neutral 'Друг'/'Doʻst' that i18n.ts already supports; ChildNameBanner can invite a name later). Remove the three rules from the dialog and the adult profile paragraph ('Младший профиль · 6–8 лет. Всё по порядку…'); replace the latter by a one-line confirmation. The rules ('Не торопись', 'Подсказка по одной', 'Объясни') become a robot tip card shown once on each of the first three tasks (rule k on task k), 5-second toast with a speaker and a 44px close, never blocking the board. Fix modal a11y: focus moves to the step heading on mount, Tab is trapped (set inert on the page behind), step is restored from sessionStorage on reload, role=dialog aria-modal kept. After 'Поехали!' navigate straight to week 1 day 1 task 1, so the first minute ends in doing, not reading.
- **Revised after review:** Build the three-step stepper (language, age, optional name) as proposed: no scroll at 412x807, 64px language buttons, round age buttons at 56px, always-enabled 'Поехали!' with an equal-size 'Без имени', robot speaking one short sentence per step through a new welcome-short clip, the first step's tap being the audio gesture, a focus move to the heading, inert on the page behind, role=dialog kept. Changes: (a) store nameSkipped and make ChildNameBanner honor it, so a skipped name is never re-asked on the home screen (offer it once, quietly, in the child profile area); (b) after an age tap, highlight it and require a visible 'Дальше' button or a 600 ms delay with Back; no silent jump; (c) the three rules become a robot-tip card shown inline above the task on the first three tasks, one rule per task, dismissible with a 44px close, no auto-dismiss timer, speaker included, never over the board; (d) delete the sessionStorage step restore; (e) land on the first task of the age profile; (f) drop the adult profile paragraph, replace with one friendly sentence. Acceptance: taps to first task <= 5, no scrollHeight > clientHeight on any step, Tab never leaves the dialog.
- **UI spec:** Container: fixed inset-0, bg-paper (not a translucent overlay), max-w-md, content vertically centred, 3 progress dots at the top (12px each, filled = current), no scrolling at 807px height (test). Heading text-2xl font-black, ONE sentence. Primary buttons Button size 'lg' with min-h-16 on this screen (64px), full width. Speaker pill (A11Y-S2) is the first element after the heading. Back is a 48px text button 'Назад' on steps 2-3. Step 3 CTA row: two equal 56px buttons side by side, 'Без имени' (secondary) and 'Поехали!' (primary). Transitions: slide 200ms, none under reduced motion. The profile line after age: 6-8 'Начнём с лёгких задач.', 9-10 'Будут и лёгкие, и посложнее.', 11+ 'Будут и непростые задачи.' Robot tip toast: bottom of the viewport above the sticky nav, 16px dead-zone from the edge, text <= 8 words.
- **Copy:** RU: Привет! Выбери язык. · Сколько тебе лет? · Как тебя зовут? · Поехали! · Без имени · Начнём с лёгких задач. · Совет робота: не торопись, подумай сначала. / UZ: Salom! Tilni tanla. · Necha yoshdasan? · Isming nima? · Boshladik! · Ismsiz · Yengil masalalardan boshlaymiz. · Robot maslahati: shoshilma, avval o'ylab ko'r.
- **Files:** src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/home/ChildNameBanner.tsx, src/components/ChildNameField.tsx, src/components/ui.tsx, src/lib/childName.ts, src/lib/state.ts, src/lib/voice.ts, public/audio/welcome-short.mp3 (new, ru), public/audio/uz/welcome-short.mp3 (new), src/components/task/TaskView.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Duolingo onboarding (first success before forms) and NN/g (long instruction text goes unread); WAI-ARIA APG modal dialog; ChessKid auto-generated usernames (do not demand identity).
- **Guardrails:** Ask only language, age and an optional first name; never a surname, city or phone. Both name options are the same size; no confirm-shaming ('Без имени' is not framed as worse). No time limit on any step, no auto-advance from the name step. Explain why age is asked ('чтобы подобрать задачи'). The first task must be winnable and never timed. Do not block the app behind a long tutorial; the robot tips are skippable and appear at most three times.
- **Test plan:** Playwright fresh profile Pixel 7 (412x807, DPR 2.625): taps from launch to first task <= 5, wall time <= 30s with audio mocked; every step has scrollHeight <= clientHeight; 'Поехали!' never disabled; Tab cycles inside the dialog and activeElement is not BODY at open (today BODY, Tab leaves the dialog); first screen visible words <= 12; axe has no 'aria-dialog-name' or focus issues. Reload at step 2 restores step 2. Child test with 5 children aged 6-8: how many reach task 1 unaided (target >= 4 of 5, today a parent must type the name). Parent check: language chosen is the one the child reads best.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. Strongest of the set and checked against code. HomeDashboard.tsx Welcome (about 330-452) has about 60 words of rules, a name that must be typed because Button is disabled={!ready} (line 446), the adult profile paragraph (profile.about, 'Всё по порядку: задания дня одно за другим…'), and a listen button below the rules. Pawns: on the 'fresh' scenario the child needs reading, typing and a parent. Stepper, no scroll, 64px targets, an always-enabled CTA with a 'Без имени' fallback (NAME_FALLBACK 'Друг'/'Doʻst' already exists) and a real modal fix are all well founded, and it fits the owner's tone. Concrete problems: (1) ChildNameBanner.tsx shows whenever welcomed && !childName, with no dismiss. If 'Без имени' is allowed, the banner will appear on home immediately and keep asking: a nag. Needs a nameSkipped flag. (2) A 5-second toast with a speaker for the rules is hostile to a slow reader; it vanishes before Aziz finishes. Use a dismissible card with no timer. A toast above the sticky bottom nav also collides with it. (3) Auto-advance 250 ms after an age tap turns a mis-tap into a wrong profile. Keep Back, but the age step should show the choice before moving on. (4) 'Restore step from sessionStorage' is over-engineering for a 3-step flow. (5) Navigating to 'week 1 day 1 task 1' for every age ignores the profile; use the profile's first task. (6) New clips welcome-short (RU and UZ) must be recorded in the cloned voice. (7) The 'Родители могут поменять имя в своём разделе' hint line should go (see A11Y-S11).

#### A11Y-S5 · modify · effort S · impact 4 — Gender-neutral Russian sweep with a build-time guard

- **Addresses:** A11Y-5
- **Proposal:** Rewrite every masculine first/second-person past-tense form that addresses the child, starting with the after-solve row shown after EVERY solved task, and add a vitest that fails when a new one appears. Replacements keep meaning and the soft tone. AfterSolve.tsx:9-12: 'Я объяснил решение' -> 'Объяснение готово'; 'Я нашёл другой способ' -> 'Нашлось ещё решение'; 'Было трудно, но я справился' -> 'Было трудно, а получилось!'; 'Понравилась задача' stays. Others: DayFinish.tsx:61 'нашёл другой способ' -> 'нашлось другое решение'; HintLadder.tsx:59 'Сначала попробуй подумать сам' -> 'Сначала подумай сама или сам - это самое интересное!' for text, or better the shorter 'Сначала подумай немного - это самое интересное!'; WallLab.tsx:113 'Ты нашёл все числа' -> 'Все числа найдены!'; ChessExercises.tsx:709 'Ты нашёл все решения' -> 'Все решения найдены!'; ChessDiary.tsx:139 'ты выиграл у робота' -> 'победа над роботом'; GameReview.tsx:110 'чтобы в следующий раз ты их нашёл сам' -> 'чтобы в следующий раз находить их самостоятельно'; src/content/chess/endgames.ts:207 'Ты сберёг … и выиграл' -> 'Фигуры целы, партия выиграна'; week1/day4.ts:340 'что нашёл ВСЕ варианты' -> 'что найдены ВСЕ варианты'; week3/day4.ts:472 'Как бы ты нашёл' -> 'Как можно найти'. Praise lines are rewritten to describe the action, not the person ('Все решения найдены' not 'ты молодец').
- **Revised after review:** Do the sweep first, before any new recording. (1) Replace labels: 'Объяснение готово', 'Нашлось ещё решение', 'Было трудно, а получилось!' (keep 'Понравилась задача'), and update review.ts:23/28/33 and the DayFinish stat labels. (2) Fix all child-facing strings, not only the listed ten: hints, followUps, task bodies, feedback strings in answers/* and robot/*, chess components. Prefer short impersonal forms ('Все числа найдены!'), never 'сама или сам'. For 'подумай сам' use 'подумай сначала'. (3) Add tests/gender-neutral.test.ts scoped to child-facing fields only: task title/body/hints/followUps/intro/question, and t() literals in components outside src/components/parent/**. Pattern: second-person ('ты', 'вы') plus masculine past verb endings, and a short list of words (нашёл, объяснил, справился, выиграл у ... ты, сам). Do not scan 'discuss', 'observe', 'solution.explanation', parent files, or historical text (encyclopedia). Put exceptions in an allowlist with a reason. (4) Re-record only task clips whose body changed (week3/day7:167, week1/day7:148, week1/day4:340 if voiced) via the existing hash test. Do not use emoji or praise of ability as the neutral replacement.
- **UI spec:** No layout change. AfterSolve chips keep emoji + label, 48px min height (A11Y-S6). Guard test (tests/gender-neutral.test.ts): load every RU string reachable from src/content and the t() first arguments in src/components via a regex on '(?:я|ты|вы)\s+\S*(?:ал|ил|ел|ол|ул|ыл|ёл|ся|лась)' plus a banned-word list (нашёл, нашел, объяснил, справился, выиграл, сам, один, рад, уверен, готов, молодец) with a small allowlist file for legitimate cases (e.g. historical figures, robot speech). Expect some false positives; the allowlist is the cost. Because task clips are fingerprinted (voiceText.ts), changing a task body (week1/day4.ts:340, week3/day4.ts:472) marks its recording stale: re-record only those.
- **Copy:** RU: Объяснение готово · Нашлось ещё решение · Было трудно, а получилось! · Все решения найдены! · Победа над роботом / UZ: (Uzbek has no grammatical gender; keep existing: Yechimni tushuntirdim · Boshqa usul topdim · Qiyin bo'ldi, lekin uddaladim)
- **Files:** src/components/task/AfterSolve.tsx, src/components/session/DayFinish.tsx, src/components/task/HintLadder.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessExercises.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessDiary.tsx, src/components/chess/GameReview.tsx, src/content/chess/endgames.ts, src/content/week1/day4.ts, src/content/week3/day4.ts, tests/gender-neutral.test.ts (new)
- **Inspired by:** Owner's own rule (gender-neutral toward the child); inclusive-language practice; stereotype-threat research on girls in STEM (cited in the audit); Hattie-Timperley process feedback (describe the action).
- **Guardrails:** Do not replace a gendered form with identity praise ('умница', 'гений'). Keep feedback about the action. Do not make the neutral phrasing stilted for Aziz: prefer short passive or impersonal forms. Do not add 'сам(а)' with brackets (hard to read and to voice).
- **Test plan:** The new vitest must fail on the 10 current hits listed in the audit and pass after the fix. Grep before/after for 'нашёл|объяснил|справился|выиграл' in child-facing strings (target 0 outside the allowlist). Have one Russian-speaking girl and one boy read the new after-solve row aloud and confirm it sounds natural. Re-record and hash-check only the changed task clips.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Directly enforces the owner's own rule, and AfterSolve.tsx:9-12 ('Я объяснил решение', 'Я нашёл другой способ', 'Было трудно, но я справился') is shown after every solved task, so the sweep is worth doing. But the listed 10 hits badly understate the work. A rough regex over content and components finds about 88 candidates (some false positives). Examples missing from the list: RobotPuzzle.tsx:233 and GridPuzzles.tsx:279 ('Ты нашёл все пути/способов!'), MagicTrianglePuzzle.tsx:236, NumberPuzzles.tsx:300, week3/day2.ts:89 ('Какой ты нашёл первым?'), week1/day7.ts:30 ('Как ты справился?'), week1/day7.ts:148 ('решай сам'), week3/day7.ts:167 ('Ты ходишь первым'), week1/day3.ts:191, and 'сам' in Encyclopedia.tsx:324 and OwnPuzzles.tsx:85. 'Подумай сам' also appears in HintLadder.tsx:59. Side effects: review.ts:23, 28 and 33 quote the old mark labels for parents and must change together with AfterSolve. Parent-facing text in the same files ('ребёнок сам заметит', ParentDayView) is third person and must not be flagged, so the 'small allowlist' is not small unless the guard is scoped. Task body changes make task clips stale (tests/voice.test.ts compares hashes); hints and followUps are not recorded yet, so doing this before A11Y-S1 saves re-recording. 'Объяснение готово' reads fine; avoid stilted passives.

#### A11Y-S6 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — A real touch-target system: 44px floor, 56px for primary actions at ages 6-8, labelled header, language behind a popover

- **Addresses:** A11Y-6
- **Proposal:** Make the floor structural instead of per-page. (1) ui.tsx SIZES: sm min-h-9 -> min-h-11 (44px), md -> min-h-12 (48px), lg -> min-h-14 (56px). 92 Button size='sm' usages inherit this. (2) Add CSS tokens in globals.css: --tap-min: 44px; html[data-profile='junior'] { --tap-min: 56px } applied to primary actions through a utility 'tap-primary' (Проверить, Дальше, Начать, speaker, hint). A tiny client component sets data-profile from ageProfile(settings.age). (3) Header (SiteHeader.tsx): the three nav links become 56x56 icon-over-label tiles (icon 24px, label 12px/700, text always visible, not 'hidden sm:inline'), the 🔒 'Родителям' link is separated by a 16px gap and a 1px divider and is quieter (muted colour, same size, never highlighted), and LangSwitch becomes ONE 48px button showing the current language ('RU') that opens a small popover with two 56px buttons 'Русский' / 'Oʻzbekcha'; a single tap can no longer flip the app language, and RU/UZ no longer touch the lock. (4) Small inline links ('изменить' 55x16 on the profile line) become 44px-high buttons or get an invisible ::after hit area of inset -12px. (5) Text floor: raise child-facing text under 14px to 14px: sweep text-xs/text-[11px]/10.3px in History, Endgames, Awards, Home chips (audit-metrics: textUnder14 63 on /, 73 on /chess, 70 on /chess/awards, 402 on /chess/history, 294 on /chess/endgames); keep 12px only for decorative badges. 8px minimum spacing between adjacent targets. Board squares are excluded (A11Y-S9 and existing 8px drag tolerance).
- **Revised after review:** Do in this order. (a) ui.tsx SIZES: sm min-h-11 (44), md min-h-12, lg min-h-14; check PlayBoard, secrets and chess hub for wraps at 412px. (b) LangSwitch: one 48px button showing the current language (RU / UZ) that opens a two-row popover with 56px options; it must never sit within 16px of the parent lock. The lock becomes a quiet icon-only link, 44px, with aria-label and no highlight; consider moving it to the footer of home. (c) Header nav items 48px with the icon over a visible 12-13px label. (d) Day tabs 44px with a 4px gap, horizontal scroll kept. (e) The 'изменить' link and similar inline links get a 44px hit area through padding or ::after. (f) Raise text-xs and text-[11px] to 14px only on pages a 6-12 year old uses daily (home, day, chess hub, pawn, play, drills, puzzles, awards). Leave history, endgames and encyclopedia at their current sizes unless an audit shows a real problem. Verify: small44 on '/' <= 3, hOverflow false in both languages, a stray tap at the old RU/UZ position does not flip the language.
- **UI spec:** Header at 412px: [logo 40] [Шахматы 56] [Мои задачи 56] [gap 16 + divider] [🔒 Родителям 56] [RU 48] - total about 330px plus padding 16 each side fits; the app name text beside the logo is already hidden below sm. Language popover: anchored under the RU button, 2 rows x 56px, current language has a check, closes on pick or outside tap, Esc closes, focus returns to the button. PlayBoard action row: wraps in a 2-column grid of equal 48px buttons so nothing sits 4px from anything else. Pager chips 'Задача 1 из 8' stay non-interactive text (no tap target). Day tabs (40x40) -> 48x48 with 8px gap.
- **Copy:** RU: Шахматы · Мои задачи · Родителям · Язык: Русский · Oʻzbekcha / UZ: Shaxmat · Masalalarim · Ota-onalarga · Til: O'zbekcha · Русский
- **Files:** src/components/ui.tsx, src/components/SiteHeader.tsx, src/components/LangSwitch.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/components/chess/PlayBoard.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/components/chess/History*.tsx / Encyclopedia.tsx / EndgameSchool.tsx (font-size sweep), src/lib/age.ts
- **Inspired by:** NN/g children physical development (2 cm targets, tap before drag), WCAG 2.5.5 and 2.5.8, Material 48dp, Sesame Workshop bottom-edge research, ICO equal-prominence buttons.
- **Guardrails:** Bigger targets must not create a 'giant orange button' that pushes the child into one path: only the genuinely primary action is 56px, siblings keep equal size where they are alternatives (e.g. 'На сегодня хватит' / 'Ещё'). Do not hide the parent lock entirely (parents need it) and never put it where a child's thumb lands on it by habit. No guilt or urgency in labels.
- **Test plan:** Re-run the audit script: phone '/' small44 from 10 to <= 2 (only non-interactive decoration), tiny32 = 0; '/chess/play' small44 from 37 to <= 5; textUnder14 on '/' from 63 to <= 10, '/chess/history' from 402 to <= 40. Header probe on kid7: each nav item >= 48x48, gap between lang button and lock >= 16px. Language flip by one stray tap: simulate tap at old RU/UZ coordinates - language must not change. hOverflow stays false at 412 px in both languages. 5-children tap test: mis-tap rate on header (today unmeasured) should fall.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. The evidence is concrete: audit-metrics shows small44 = 10 on phone '/', 37 on /chess/play, 41 on /chess/secrets, 133 on /chess/history; the SIZES sm is min-h-9 (ui.tsx:23); LangSwitch is min-h-8 with no gap and sits next to the lock. Raising the floor in ui.tsx and giving language a popover are the right moves. But the package is too big. (1) Changing sm globally to 44px touches every Button size='sm' including dense rows (PlayBoard action row, chess cards); verify hOverflow at 412px. (2) The proposed day tabs 40 -> 48px with 8px gap: richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg shows 9 tabs already overflowing the 412px width, and 48+8 makes the overview worse. Keep about 44 x 44 with a small gap, and let the row scroll. (3) The data-profile CSS-token system with a 'tap-primary' utility is machinery; ui.tsx Button 'lg' already is 56px and primary actions can just use lg. (4) Sweeping 400+ small text nodes on /chess/history and /chess/endgames to 14px is a large, low-value change: those are encyclopedia pages for older readers; 12px captions on mini-boards are fine. Limit it to pages Aziz uses. (5) Nav tiles at 56px each with text always visible leaves little room next to a 48px language button; 48px tiles are enough. (6) Putting the lock behind a popover or in the footer is better than giving it a 56px tile that draws a child's curiosity.

#### A11Y-S7 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — 'Аа' reading sheet for the child: text size everywhere, spacing, read-aloud and short-text toggles, with age-based defaults

- **Addresses:** A11Y-7, A11Y-3, A11Y-2
- **Proposal:** Move the reading controls to where the child and the family can find them and make them work app-wide. (1) Replace boolean bigText with textScale: 'm' | 'l' | 'xl' in src/lib/state.ts (migrate bigText true -> 'l'). Apply via a tiny client component mounted in layout.tsx that sets <html data-size> and <html data-spacing>. Because Tailwind 4 sizes are rem-based, html[data-size='l']{font-size:112.5%} and 'xl' 125% scale chess, home, drills and puzzles, not only .child-text in the math session (today bigText touches only 5 usages of .child-text). (2) 'Больше воздуха' spacing toggle: html[data-spacing='on'] body {line-height:1.6; letter-spacing:.02em; word-spacing:.08em} (inside WCAG 1.4.12 limits). (3) Defaults by age when the setting is undefined: junior -> size 'l', spacing on, autoRead on (A11Y-S2), shortText on (A11Y-S3); middle -> 'm'; senior -> 'm'. A parent choice always wins. (4) Entry point: a 44px 'Аа' button in the task card toolbar and in chess lesson/exercise headers (not the global header, which is crowded); it opens a bottom sheet. (5) Typography: remove uppercase from child-facing labels (HintLadder.tsx:68 'uppercase', home 'СЕГОДНЯШНЕЕ ЗАНЯТИЕ', 'НЕДЕЛЯ 2 ·…'), use sentence case and min 14px; no dyslexia font (no evidence of benefit), keep Nunito. hintPause stays PARENT-ONLY by design (it is a pacing rule, not a comfort setting). SettingsPanel.tsx:81-98 replaces its bigText toggle with the same three-step control so the parent sees the same options.
- **Revised after review:** Ship the useful core: settings.textScale 'm'|'l'|'xl' with bigText:true migrating to 'l' and bigText:false to 'm'; a small client component sets html[data-size] so every page scales; @media print resets the root size. Defaults by age when undefined: junior 'l', others 'm'; a parent's choice always wins. The 'l' and 'xl' presets also apply line-height 1.6 and slight word spacing, so there is no separate spacing switch. Replace the parent toggle in SettingsPanel with a 3-step control with live preview. Replace uppercase 12px labels with sentence case at >= 14px. For the child, add at most one entry point: an 'Аа' button on the home profile line (not in every task toolbar or chess header) opening a sheet with two rows only: text size and 'Читать вслух' (the A11Y-S2 setting). hintPause stays parent-only. Skip dyslexia font and Коротко/Подробно. Verify hOverflow and clipped labels on 12 pages at m/l/xl in both languages at 412px, and a print preview unchanged.
- **UI spec:** Bottom sheet (max-h 60dvh, rounded-t-3xl, handle bar, 48px close 'Готово'). Row 1 'Размер текста': three 56px buttons 'А' 'А' 'А' rendered at 16/18/20px, aria-pressed, selected = brand border + check. Row 2 switch 'Читать мне вслух': 56px row, on/off words inside the switch ('Вкл'/'Выкл'), knob contrast >= 3:1. Row 3 switch 'Больше воздуха между буквами'. Row 4 switch 'Коротко / Подробно' (hidden for 11+). Changes apply live behind the sheet so the child sees the effect. Sheet state is stored in settings, so Dilnoza on the same phone can set her own look; after changing, a small toast 'Родители могут поменять это в своём разделе' is not shown (avoid pointing a curious child at the parent area).

- **Files:** src/lib/state.ts, src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx, src/app/layout.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/components/ReadingPrefs.tsx (new), src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLesson.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessExercises.tsx, src/components/task/HintLadder.tsx, src/lib/age.ts
- **Inspired by:** UDL 'multiple means of representation' and WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing; ICO defaults-by-age thinking; kidsux research (readable type by size and spacing, skip dyslexia fonts: Wery and Diliberto 2017).
- **Guardrails:** Defaults must be a convenience, not a label: never write 'for young readers' in the sheet. Settings are never reset by progress or streak. The sheet shows no scores and no rewards. Do not move hintPause or reset controls into the child sheet.
- **Test plan:** Playwright over 12 pages (home, day, chess, pawn, pawn-ex, play, drills, puzzles, history, endgames, awards, openings) at sizes m/l/xl in ru and uz on 412px: hOverflow false and no clipped button labels. Check that html font-size changes chess lesson text (computed font-size of lesson paragraph grows 12.5 percent). Migration unit test: stored bigText:true becomes textScale 'l'. Child test: 5 children aged 6-8 - can they find 'Аа' in 20 seconds and does the larger setting reduce reading errors on a lesson paragraph (read-aloud error count).
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Real bug behind it: bigText only adds .big-text .child-text { font-size:1.15em } (globals.css:129) and is set only inside DaySession.tsx, so it does nothing in chess, home, drills or puzzles; the toggle lives only behind the PIN (SettingsPanel.tsx:81-98). A global textScale via html font-size is the right fix, and sentence case instead of 12px uppercase (HintLadder.tsx:68 uses 'uppercase') is a good small win. But the child sheet is over-built: four abstract settings (size, read-aloud, letter spacing, Коротко/Подробно) for a child who cannot read them, and a new 'Аа' button in the task toolbar and chess headers next to a 56px speaker, a hint button and pager chips. The people who actually change reading settings are the parent and perhaps Dilnoza. Evidence for extra letter spacing helping non-dyslexic readers is thin; WCAG 1.4.12 is a tolerance limit, not a benefit claim. Technical risks: (1) Tailwind 4 spacing is rem-based, so html font-size 125% scales the whole layout, not only text; hOverflow at 412px is likely on the header and chess hub. (2) Print styles use pt (globals.css:172) but any rem-based element scales with html font-size, so printouts change; force html{font-size:100%} under @media print. (3) e2e seeds write settings {hintPause:false, bigText:false}, so the sanitiser must keep accepting bigText and migrate it. (4) The 'Коротко/Подробно' switch depends on A11Y-S3, which is revised to have no toggle.

#### A11Y-S8 · modify · effort M · impact 2 — Quiet, named boards: decorative mini-boards are hidden from the accessibility tree, interactive boards get names, instructions and a Russian/Uzbek live region

- **Addresses:** A11Y-8
- **Proposal:** Add a 'decorative' mode to ChessBoard.tsx and use it for every non-interactive diagram: openings cards (554 unnamed tab stops today), games, endgame thumbnails, encyclopedia figures. In decorative mode the wrapper is <div aria-hidden='true' inert> so pieces are not focusable and not announced; infer it automatically when draggable is false and no square handler is passed, and allow override. For interactive boards: wrap in role='group' with aria-label (RU/UZ) and an aria-describedby sr-only help text explaining the keyboard route that already works (Space picks up, arrows move, Space drops, Esc cancels). Name the pieces: the PIECES render objects in ChessBoard.tsx already control the SVG, so add role='img' and aria-label ('белая пешка' / 'oq piyoda') in each piece renderer; the library's role=button wrapper then gets its accessible name from content (verify with the Playwright noName probe). Add an own polite live region (sr-only) that announces in the UI language: 'Выбрана белая пешка на e2', 'Ход: e2 - e4', 'Так нельзя, фигура вернулась'. Silence the library's English dnd-kit announcements: react-chessboard 5.12.1 does not expose dnd-kit accessibility props (grep of its d.ts found none), so set aria-live='off' and aria-hidden on the dnd-kit live-region and description nodes (ids starting DndLiveRegion / DndDescribedBy) via a small effect with a MutationObserver scoped to the board wrapper; confirm in a spike before committing to this approach.
- **Revised after review:** Do only the decorative part. Add decorative to ChessBoard (aria-hidden and inert on the wrapper, tabindex removed) and default it on when draggable is false and no square handler is passed; apply to openings, games, endgames and encyclopedia thumbnails. Test that cards still open when tapped. For the interactive boards add role='group' with a localized aria-label and a short sr-only keyboard hint. Postpone the live-region announcer, the MutationObserver hack and the visible '?' popover. Check by the audit: noName on /chess/openings 554 -> 0, /chess/games 196 -> 0, /chess/endgames 54 -> 0, and keyboard tab order on the main board still works.
- **UI spec:** No visual change. Optional tiny '?' 44px button near the main board opens a popover 'Как играть с клавиатуры' (4 lines, RU/UZ). Promotion picker keeps its names. Live region text style sr-only; do not display.

- **Inspired by:** WCAG 2.1.1, 4.1.2, 3.1.1; WAI-ARIA APG (hide decorative content); Lichess keyboard-input approach.
- **Guardrails:** Announcements are factual and short, never evaluative ('неверно'); no extra sounds. Do not remove the existing board tap tolerance. Do not trap focus inside boards; Esc always leaves.
- **Test plan:** Re-run the audit probe: noName on /chess/openings from 554 to 0, /chess/games from 196 to 0, /chess/endgames from 54 to 0, /chess/play#robot-2-w from 32 to 0 (or named). Playwright keyboard test: Tab to a piece, Space, Right, Space moves it and the live region text is in the UI language; no element in the document has an English 'Draggable item' text in ru/uz. Manual TalkBack pass on Android: announces 'белая пешка, кнопка'.

The measurements are real (audit-metrics noName: 554 on /chess/openings, 196 on /chess/games, 54 on /chess/endgames, 32 on the robot board) and the decorative fix is cheap: ChessBoard.tsx already has a draggable prop (default false), so decorative boards can be aria-hidden and inert. But impact 2 is honest: the target personas are Aziz and Dilnoza, not screen-reader users, so this should be small. The rest of the proposal is fragile: a MutationObserver that hides dnd-kit live regions by id inside react-chessboard is a hack that can break on any library upgrade and may remove announcements for someone who needs them; custom per-piece role=img names depend on internals of PIECES; a new live-region announcer plus a '?' keyboard popover add code and visual clutter for a child app. One concern with 'inert': OpeningsView and other lists wrap mini boards; confirm that inert on a board inside a clickable card does not swallow the card's click (inert content is excluded from hit testing). Chrome Android supports inert.

#### A11Y-S9 · keep · effort S · impact 2 — Board feedback you can see without colour: glyphs and hatching for 'good' and 'not that one'

- **Addresses:** A11Y-9
- **Proposal:** MARK_STYLE in ChessBoard.tsx currently separates 'good' (green .55) and 'bad' (red .55) by hue only; deutan/protan simulation gives 1.03-1.08:1 between them. Add a second channel to each state without making it harsh. 'good': keep green fill and add a white check badge (SVG data-URI as background-image, 40% of the square, top-right, circle #047857 with white tick). 'bad' (which the child sees as 'not that one'): change to a warm orange hatch (repeating-linear-gradient 45deg, rgba(234,88,12,.6) 0 5px, transparent 5px 10px) plus a small curved-arrow badge 'try another', NOT a red cross and NOT the word wrong. REJECTED_STYLE (rejected move) uses the same hatch and the existing shake (disabled under reduced motion). 'hint' ring becomes dashed (outline 3px dashed #047857, outline-offset -4px) so it differs from the solid amber 'selected' ring by shape; target/capture already differ by dot vs ring. 'check' stays a radial glow plus a small crown icon on the king. Add a tiny shared helper so CoordinateTrainer.tsx:185, EndgameSchool.tsx:258-259 and ChessExercises.tsx:133-134 get the same marks automatically. Validate with a Machado 2009 simulation script: good vs bad luminance/pattern distinguishable, and each mark at least 3:1 against both light and dark squares where text/glyph is involved.

Hatch stripe 5px so it stays visible at 22px mini boards (omit badge below 28px square size, keep hatch). Legend line under the board in exercises only when marks appear: '✓ верно · ↺ попробуй другую клетку'. Keep with two cautions in the implementation: the curved-arrow badge and the legend line '✓ верно · ↺ попробуй другую клетку' add reading and clutter and a 17px arrow is not legible; drop both and rely on the hatch plus check. Check the hatch at 22px mini-boards and with the existing shake under reduced motion.

#### A11Y-S10 · modify · effort S · impact 3 — Forgiving destructive actions: calm 'Сдаться', undo-able 'Новая партия', confirmed PIN change

- **Addresses:** A11Y-10
- **Proposal:** PlayBoard.tsx:423-441: reorder and re-style the action row. Primary row (equal 48px buttons): Подсказка, Отменить, Перевернуть. 'Новая партия' is demoted from the only filled button to a secondary button; it becomes the filled primary action only when the game is over ('Сыграть ещё'). When tapped mid-game (plies > 0), restart() keeps the previous game in memory and shows a 10-second undo toast 'Новая партия началась. Вернуть прошлую?' (no extra dialog to read; reversible). 'Сдаться' keeps ghost style and needs a deliberate inline confirm in place: it swaps for two equal 48px buttons 'Продолжаю играть' and 'Сдаться', no shaming copy, robot stays neutral. SettingsPanel.tsx:153 'Сменить PIN-код' gets the same two-step pattern that SettingsPanel.tsx:167-190 already uses for progress reset. Games are autosaved every move so reload or accidental back never loses them.
- **Revised after review:** (1) Demote 'Новая партия' to a secondary button and make it the filled primary only when the game is over ('Сыграть ещё'); order Подсказка, Отменить, Перевернуть first. (2) When restart() is called mid-game (plies > 0), keep the previous state in memory and show a bottom bar with a large ↶ button and a 3-4 word label ('Вернуть партию'), no countdown ring, dismissible, readable by a screen reader; no extra dialog. (3) Leave 'Сдаться' one tap since 'Отменить' already reverses it, but make the undo discoverable by keeping 'Отменить' enabled after resign. (4) Separate item, M effort: persist the in-progress game (sessionStorage or the existing store) so a reload does not lose it; do not claim autosave until it exists. (5) PIN change confirm: low priority, same two-step pattern as reset progress. All buttons 44px+ and 8px apart.
- **UI spec:** Actions grid: grid-cols-2 gap-2 on phone, each min-h-12; 'Сдаться' sits last in its own row full width, ghost. Inline confirm replaces that row (aria-live polite, focus moves to 'Продолжаю играть' which is the safe default). Undo toast: bottom sheet-like 56px bar above the nav, 'Вернуть' button 48px, auto-dismiss 10s, pauses on hover/focus, aria-live. Animation 150ms, none under reduced motion.

Старый код перестанет работать. / UZ: Taslim bo'lish · O'ynashda davom etaman · Yangi partiya boshlandi. Oldingisini qaytaraymi? · Qaytarish · PIN-kodni almashtiramizmi? Eski kod ishlamay qoladi.
- **Files:** src/components/chess/PlayBoard.tsx, src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx, src/lib/play.ts, src/components/ui.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Nielsen error prevention and forgiveness; NN/g (undo beats confirm dialogs for children); ICO equal-size choices (no lopsided yes/no buttons).
- **Guardrails:** Both confirm options are the same size and neutral. No 'Ты уверен, что хочешь сдаться?' guilt, no sad robot, no loss counter. 'Сдаться' must not reduce XP or crowns more than a normal loss. The undo toast never counts down aggressively (no ring animation).
