- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Two claims in the proposal do not match the code. First, it says games are autosaved every move; in PlayBoard.tsx the game lives in useState only (start, plies, gameId at lines 80-93) and I found no persistence, so a reload or back swipe loses the game and the proposed undo toast would not cover it. Second, 'Сдаться' (PlayBoard.tsx:434) only sets resigned=true, and undo (line 215-223) calls setResigned(false), so an accidental resign is already reversible with 'Отменить'. An inline two-button confirm for it adds friction to a deliberate choice and a second sentence to read. What is genuinely irreversible is 'Новая партия' (restart() resets everything) and it is the only filled button in a wrapped row of 36px buttons. 'Сменить PIN-код' (SettingsPanel.tsx:154 -> forgetPin) clears the PIN on one tap, but it sits in the PIN-gated parent area, so the child impact is nil. The undo toast text 'Новая партия началась. Вернуть прошлую?' is reading-heavy for Aziz.

#### A11Y-S11 · modify · effort M · impact 3 — A parent gate a curious 10-year-old cannot talk herself through: recovery word set by the parent, attempt throttling, no printed reset word

- **Addresses:** A11Y-11
- **Proposal:** ParentGate.tsx prints the reset word ('сбросить'/'oʻchirish') and parentGate.ts has unlimited tries. Replace the printed word with a parent-chosen recovery word created together with the PIN (stored salted and hashed via SubtleCrypto, never shown again). Forgot-PIN flow: 'Введите слово для восстановления'. Add throttling in localStorage (not sessionStorage): after 3 wrong PINs wait 60 seconds, doubling to a 10-minute cap; the counter survives reload. Wrong-entry message is neutral and does not say how many tries are left to a child. Keep the unlock in sessionStorage (acceptable) but add an auto-lock after 10 minutes of inactivity so a handed-over phone is not left open. Remove the sentence in the welcome that advertises the parent area ('Родители могут поменять имя в своём разделе') and replace it with 'Имя можно поменять позже.' Be honest in the code comment and parent copy that this is a soft gate on a local-only app (a determined teenager can clear site data); the goal is to stop a curious child from stumbling in, not to be a security system. Do NOT use an arithmetic gate: Dilnoza is strong at maths and would pass it.
- **Revised after review:** Minimal child-protecting changes: (1) Remove the printed reset word. Forgot-PIN becomes either a parent-chosen recovery word created together with the PIN (stored as a salted hash; a nudge to add one for existing PINs after the next unlock) or, if skipped, an explanation of how to clear site data. (2) Close the no-PIN hole: the first-run flow of A11Y-S4 ends with a 'Для взрослых: создайте PIN-код' step that is only reached by a short adult-skill check, or the parent area simply shows nothing but 'Раздел для взрослых' until a PIN is created from the Settings menu on the parent's device. At minimum, creating a PIN must not unlock the answers without a second confirmation. (3) 3 wrong PINs -> 60 s wait with the counter in localStorage; the message is neutral, no counts. (4) Remove the welcome sentence about the parent area. (5) No arithmetic gate. Be honest in comments that this is a soft gate and a determined child can clear site data.
- **UI spec:** PIN creation screen gets step 2 'Придумайте слово для восстановления' with an input (min 4 letters), a show/hide eye button (48px) and helper text 'Запишите его: без него PIN не восстановить.' Locked state: calm card 'Раздел для взрослых. Попробуйте чуть позже.' with a plain time indicator in minutes (no red, no bar). Parent unlock timeout shows a quiet toast on return to the parent area, not on child screens.
- **Copy:** RU: Придумайте слово для восстановления · Раздел для взрослых. Попробуйте чуть позже. · Имя можно поменять позже. / UZ: Tiklash uchun so'z o'ylab toping · Kattalar bo'limi. Birozdan keyin urinib ko'ring. · Ismni keyin o'zgartirish mumkin.
- **Files:** src/components/parent/ParentGate.tsx, src/lib/parentGate.ts, src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Google Families / COPPA-style parent gates (require an adult skill, throttle attempts); owner's existing 'soft protection' stance in parentGate.ts:5-8.
- **Guardrails:** The gate must never trap a legitimate parent: provide the nuclear path (clear data) with the existing two-step confirm, and tell parents about it. No shaming copy toward the child, no alarms. Do not log or send attempts anywhere. Do not claim real security.
- **Test plan:** Vitest on parentGate: 3 wrong PINs lock for 60s (use fake timers), lock survives reload (localStorage), recovery word compare is case/space-insensitive and hash-only in storage. Playwright: forgot-PIN panel contains no reset word text. Check migration for existing PINs without a recovery word (offer to add one after the next successful unlock). Manual: old 10-minute inactivity relock.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. The listed hole is real: ParentGate.tsx:9,118-121 prints the reset words ('сбросить' / 'oʻchirish') and enabling the reset button depends only on typing them, so any reader gets in. But the proposal misses a bigger hole in the same file. When no PIN exists, useParentGate returns 'no-pin' and the form is in 'create' mode (ParentGate.tsx:21): a child who taps the lock before a parent sets a PIN can create the PIN herself and see answers, and then the parent is locked out of their own area. A recovery word also adds a second secret for a busy parent, and existing PINs have none (migration is needed). The 10-minute inactivity relock and doubling throttle are reasonable but extra. Throttling in localStorage is easily cleared by a clever 10-year-old, which the proposal admits. Child-flow-relevant parts are: no printed word, and removing 'Родители могут поменять имя в своём разделе' from the welcome so a competitive child is not pointed at the parent area. Detailed parent controls are a later phase, so keep this minimal.

#### A11Y-S12 · modify · effort S · impact 2 — Say why a button is waiting, and fix the weak contrast pairs

- **Addresses:** A11Y-12, A11Y-4
- **Proposal:** Disabled state is currently opacity-45 on a filled button (ui.tsx:34), roughly 2.3:1, and silent. Replace with a purpose-built look and a reason. (1) Button gets an optional disabledReason prop: renders the button with aria-disabled (still focusable), a muted grey fill with ink text at >= 4.5:1, and a one-line helper under it with a small pointer glyph: 'Сначала впиши ответ'. Tapping the disabled button does not do nothing: it focuses the input and plays a 200ms gentle nudge (reduced-motion: just focus). (2) Contrast fixes: hero secondary text white/80 on the purple gradient (about 3.4:1) -> white/95 or a darker gradient stop, target 4.5:1; filled 'success' button white on #10b981 (2.54:1) -> mint-dark #047857 (about 5.5:1, the shadow colour already exists) ; sun buttons already use ink text, keep. (3) SettingsPanel toggle (SettingsPanel.tsx:345, off state bg-black/15 = 1.41:1) -> off = white with 2px ink/50 border and a visible 'Выкл' label, on = brand fill with 'Вкл' and a check. (4) 'Проверить' and 'Tekshirish' reasons use age-friendly short phrases. Apply the same to the welcome CTA is moot after A11Y-S4 (never disabled).
- **Revised after review:** 1) For 'Проверить'/'Tekshirish' and similar primary actions, do not disable. Keep the button fully styled; if the input is empty, tapping it focuses the field with a short 200 ms nudge (none under reduced motion) and shows a one-icon hint (✏️ and 'Впиши ответ'). 2) For true disabled states elsewhere (waiting on the hint pause, game over), use a flat grey fill, ink text at >= 4.5:1, no opacity, and, where the reason is not obvious, a one-line reason after a tap. 3) Colour tokens: success fill #047857 (or ink text on mint), hero secondary white/95, settings toggle off = white with a 2px ink/50 border and 'Выкл', on = brand fill with a check. 4) Verify contrast values by script. Keep copy neutral: no 'ошибка', no red.
- **UI spec:** Disabled style: bg-[#e5e7f0] text-ink/80 border-2 border-line shadow-none, no opacity. Reason line: text-sm text-muted below the button, left-aligned, with 👆 glyph; it is announced through aria-describedby. Toggle: 52x32 track with border, knob 24px, text 'Вкл/Выкл' inside the track at 12px bold (decorative, aria-checked carries state).
- **Copy:** RU: Сначала впиши ответ · Сначала выбери клетку · Вкл · Выкл / UZ: Avval javobni yoz · Avval katakni tanla · Yoniq · O'chiq
- **Files:** src/components/ui.tsx, src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/app/globals.css
- **Inspired by:** WCAG 1.4.3 and 1.4.11; Nielsen visibility of system status; NN/g (children read a dead button as 'broken').
- **Guardrails:** The reason line is helpful, not nagging: shown only while the control is disabled and after one tap on it, never as red text, never with urgency. Do not use 'ошибка' or 'wrong' wording.
- **Test plan:** Contrast script on the computed colours (disabled button >= 4.5:1, toggle off-state border >= 3:1, hero line >= 4.5:1, success button >= 4.5:1). Playwright: tapping disabled 'Проверить' focuses the input and exposes aria-describedby text. Screenshot diff on day1-t1 and settings.
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Confirmed on richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg: the 'Tekshirish' button is a faded lilac block with white text and no explanation (ui.tsx:34 disabled:opacity-45 plus pointer-events-none). The colour fixes are right and cheap: success white on #10b981 is about 2.5:1, toggles in SettingsPanel.tsx:345 use bg-black/15 for off, and the hero uses white/80. But a disabled button with a helper line 'Сначала впиши ответ' is reading for a pre-reader, and it keeps a dead control on the screen. The disabled state is the wrong tool for children: a button should be tappable and respond. Also pointer-events-none means taps do nothing, which the proposal fixes only with a new aria-disabled path through a shared Button. 'Поехали!' is moot once A11Y-S4 lands. The toggle labels are in the parent area, so they are lower priority for the child flow.

#### A11Y-S13 · modify · effort S · impact 3 — Fix the wide Uzbek apostrophe (oʻ, gʻ) with a tiny glyph-override font

- **Addresses:** A11Y-7
- **Proposal:** On richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg words like koʻr and oʻzingga show a visible gap before the modifier letter, which makes a first-grader read o + ʻ + z as separate pieces. First confirm the cause with a Playwright canvas measureText of 'oʻ' versus 'o' + narrow comma in Nunito Variable (the font file includes U+02BB in its latin subset per the fontsource unicode-range, so the gap is the glyph's own side bearing, not a fallback font). Then ship a 1-2 KB subset font 'UzApos' containing only U+02BB and U+02BC with a tightened advance width and left bearing (made once with fonttools from Nunito, two static weights 700 and 900 since headings are heavy), declared in globals.css with unicode-range: U+02BB-02BC and put FIRST in the font-family stack. This fixes every string app-wide with no JSX changes, and does not touch the stored text (search, copy and screen readers still see ʻ). Do not replace ʻ with an ASCII apostrophe. The same layer can later host the new alphabet letters if the Latin reform lands.
- **Revised after review:** First measure with a Playwright canvas script (measureText of 'oʻ' versus 'o' + comma) at weights 400-900. Then make a tiny subset containing only U+02BB and U+02BC with a tightened advance and left bearing, as a small variable font that keeps the wght axis (or static 400, 600, 700, 800, 900) so the weight matches. Declare it with unicode-range U+02BB-02BC in globals.css and put it before Nunito in --font-sans. Name it UzApos (OFL). Add the files to the service-worker precache list. Verify copy/paste still yields U+02BB, no layout shift, and that headings (900), buttons and body (400-600) all look consistent in the richuz screenshots. Do not replace ʻ with ASCII.
- **UI spec:** No layout change; word widths shrink about 0.15em per apostrophe. Check headings (font-weight 900), buttons, chips and the 'child-text' at 125 percent size (A11Y-S7).
- **Copy:** RU: (none) / UZ: koʻr, oʻzingga, gʻalaba, Oʻqib berish - visually one word
- **Files:** src/app/globals.css, public/fonts/uz-apos-700.woff2 (new), public/fonts/uz-apos-900.woff2 (new), src/app/layout.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Local Uzbek context research (script and typography for early readers); Chall decoding stages - Aziz decodes letter by letter.
- **Guardrails:** Typography only, no content change. Preload at most 2 files totalling a few KB so 4G is unaffected (add them to the SW precache list). Provide a fallback: if the font fails to load the normal glyph is shown.
- **Test plan:** Playwright canvas measureText before/after for 'oʻ', 'gʻ' at 16, 20, 28px and weights 400/700/900: width delta matches the target. Visual regression on richuz day1-t1, richuz-home and play pages. Verify copying text from the page still yields U+02BB. Check there is no layout shift (font-display swap, size within 2KB).
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. The problem is visible in richuz-phone-day1-t1-t1.jpg: 'Oʻqib', 'koʻr', 'oʻzingga' show the modifier letter floating with wide gaps on both sides, so a first-grader decoding letter by letter sees it as a separate piece. Nunito's latin subset does include U+02BB-02BC (unicode-range in @fontsource-variable/nunito), so the gap is the glyph's own bearings, not a fallback font; the claim in the proposal is consistent. A subset override font is an elegant app-wide fix with no content change. Flaw: it ships only two static weights (700 and 900), but the body text on that screen is regular/medium weight, and the app uses the variable font in many weights. With a unicode-range override, the browser picks the nearest weight, so body apostrophes would render noticeably bolder than their neighbours. Also check the OFL licence terms: a derivative must not use the Reserved Font Name 'Nunito'; call it UzApos.

#### A11Y-S14 · drop · effort M · impact 3 — NEW: A robot companion with four non-verbal states and neutral sounds (thinking with you, never disappointed)

- **Addresses:** (new idea)
- **Proposal:** Give the existing LogoMark/robot a small reactive companion beside the answer area. Four states: ready (blink), thinking (hand on chin, plays when a hint opens or the child pauses > 20s), happy (after a solved task, 1.2s), cheering (end of a part/day, 2s, skippable). 'Not yet' is a head tilt plus a soft two-note 'hm' - never a buzzer, never a red mark; the Feedback card keeps its words. Sound cues are language-independent (3-4 short tones) via sfx.ts, volume tied to the existing sound setting, with a 'quiet mode' that keeps the visuals and mutes tones. The robot reacts within 1-2 seconds and then gets out of the way; nothing blocks the next action. For ages 10+ it renders smaller (36px) and without idle blinking. Implemented as SVG with CSS keyframes (3-5 KB), lazy loaded; under prefers-reduced-motion it swaps poses without motion.
- **UI spec:** Position: bottom-right corner of the task card, 64px for junior, 40px for senior, never overlapping the answer input or the sticky nav; hidden when the on-screen keyboard is open. Speech bubble only for the first three tasks (S4 tips), 8 words max, with a speaker. Poses: ready (eyes open, antenna wiggle every 6s), thinking (head tilt 8deg + hand on chin), happy (arms up + small spark, 1.2s), cheering (jump x2 + confetti dots limited to 12 particles). No loops longer than 5 seconds. Sounds: ding-up (solved), soft hm (not yet), tick (hint opened), all under 600ms.
- **Copy:** RU: Подумаем вместе? · Ещё идея? · Получилось! / UZ: Birga o'ylaymizmi? · Yana bir fikr? · Bo'ldi!
- **Files:** src/components/Logo.tsx, src/components/task/TaskView.tsx, src/components/task/TaskContext.tsx, src/lib/feedback.ts, src/lib/sfx.ts, src/components/robot/ (new RobotMascot.tsx), src/app/globals.css
- **Inspired by:** Khan Academy Kids (character reacts with gestures, non-verbal feedback, 'thinking with you'), Brilliant (tutor asks instead of tells), Duolingo ABC (quiet mode request). Deliberately NOT copying KAK's 'bong' for incorrect.
- **Guardrails:** The robot is never sad, angry, disappointed or pleading, never says 'Не уходи', never reacts to the child leaving or stopping, never asks for anything (no purchase/streak/notification). Praise describes the action ('проверил второй шаг'), not ability. Celebrations only per part/day, skippable, never per tap. No flashing.
- **Test plan:** Playwright: robot states switch within 300ms of events; reduced-motion emulation shows no transform animations. Audio: no sound when sound=false or quiet mode. Measure added JS/CSS <= 6 KB gzip and no CLS. Child test: ask 5 children 'what does the robot say now?' after not-yet vs solved - at least 4 of 5 interpret 'not yet' as friendly. Parent check that no state looks disappointed.
- **Review:** feasibility hard, age fit True, manipulation risk low. Fashionable and costly, and it fights the rest of the plan. (1) The app already gives feedback: cheer('praise'|'retry') plays recorded clips (voice.ts:136), the Feedback card carries words and emoji, sfx.ts exists, and PlayBoard has robotSays. A mascot with four animated states needs new illustration and animation assets: M-L work with design review for little proven gain. (2) An idle 'thinking' state triggered after 20 seconds of pause is activity monitoring that reacts to a child who is thinking; the owner's principle is 'don't hurry, think'. (3) Constant idle animation (blinking, antenna wiggle every 6s) is a seductive-detail distraction for a 7-year-old with a 10-minute attention window. (4) Bottom-right placement collides with the sticky bottom nav and the on-screen keyboard on a 412 x 807 phone, and it adds a speech bubble with more text. (5) 'Soft two-note hm' for 'not yet' is a new sound language on top of retry clips; sounds already exist. (6) Celebrations per part/day depend on A11Y-S15, which itself is unproven. The evidence for pedagogical agents in math apps is mixed and mostly about speech, not idle animation.

#### A11Y-S15 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — NEW: Short parts with a calm finish line - 'Часть 1 из 3' and 'На сегодня хватит'

- **Addresses:** (new idea)
- **Proposal:** A day of 8 tasks (about 25 minutes, kid7-phone-home-t1.jpg) exceeds the 10-minute attention window of a 7-year-old. For the junior profile, split the day's tasks into parts of about 3 tasks (about 8 minutes) in DaySession/DayFinish, ordered as today. After each part show a Part-complete screen: the robot waves, the child's own marks for the part (stars/ticks), and two equal 56px buttons 'На сегодня хватит' and 'Ещё часть'. Stopping early still counts for the daily quest; progress autosaves per task so there is nothing to lose. Home card for junior reads '3 задачи · около 8 минут' instead of '8 задач · около 25 минут'. Middle and senior profiles keep the full day with an optional break prompt after about 20 minutes ('Потянемся?' with one 48px 'Продолжить'). Parent setting (later phase) can change the part length. No auto-advance into the next part, no countdown, no 'streak at risk' language anywhere.
- **Revised after review:** For junior only: after every third task the child has seen, show a calm pause card between tasks (a hash step such as #pause-1), with the robot waving, the child's own ticks for those three tasks (solved vs not yet, no 'complete' claim), and two equal 56px buttons, 'Ещё' / 'На сегодня хватит' (icon + 2 words, with a speaker). 'На сегодня хватит' goes to the existing finish view. Nothing auto-advances; nothing counts down. Keep the existing pager and dots unchanged. The home card for junior says '3 задачи · около 8 минут' as a suggestion. No streak or quest effects (they already depend only on solved tasks). Middle and senior profiles get nothing. Make the 3-task length a constant first; a parent setting comes later. Test that Back and reload resume at the right task and that no streak decrement path exists.
- **UI spec:** Pager changes from 'Задача 1 из 8' to 'Часть 1 · задача 1 из 3' for junior; part dots under the day tabs. Part-complete card: full-width, 3 slots showing the finished tasks' emoji, one sentence, two equal buttons side by side (stacked on < 360px). 'На сегодня хватит' leads to the existing day-finish view with 'Завтра продолжим' and a gentle 'С возвращением!' next time (no zero, no lost-streak screen).
- **Copy:** RU: Часть 1 готова. · На сегодня хватит · Ещё часть · Завтра продолжим · С возвращением! / UZ: 1-qism tayyor. · Bugunga yetarli · Yana bir qism · Ertaga davom etamiz · Xush kelibsan!
- **Files:** src/components/session/DaySession.tsx, src/components/session/DayFinish.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx, src/lib/quest.ts, src/lib/age.ts, src/components/parent/ParentDashboard.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Math Academy short doses, Duolingo round structure (celebration at completion, not per tap), ICO Children's Code (breaks, pause and save), Mathseeds 15-minute lessons; research digest 'round-based sessions with a natural stop'.
- **Guardrails:** The stop button is as large and as friendly as continue; no guilt copy, no loss framing, no streak damage for stopping, no auto-start of the next part, no fake urgency. XP is informational and not promised before the task. The part length is a suggestion, not a lock. Dilnoza is not forced into parts.
- **Test plan:** Playwright kid7: after 3 solved tasks the part-complete screen appears, both buttons equal size, 'На сегодня хватит' marks the daily quest item done and leaves a resumable state; reload resumes at task 4. Check the home card copy for junior vs senior. Measure: median session length for 6-8 testers (target about 8-10 minutes) and share of children who start a second part voluntarily. Verify no streak decrement path exists.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk low. Right observation: DayIntro.tsx says '20-30 минут' and a day has 8-9 tasks (richuz day1 shows 9 tabs), far over a 7-year-old's 10-minute attention. Short stopping points with an equal 'stop' button are the right direction and match ICO-style break guidance. But some claims are redundant or overreaching. 'Stopping early still counts for the daily quest' is already true: quest.ts defines the task goal as need: 1 solved task per day, independent of finishing the day. The pager rewrite 'Часть 1 · задача 1 из 3' adds reading and a new concept; the existing '1 / 8' plus progress dots already work. 'Часть готова' is shown after three tasks even if some were skipped, so the claim of completion could be false. DaySession navigation is hash-based (#task-N, #finish), so a part break needs a new step type and back-button handling. The 'Потянемся?' prompt for 9-12 after 20 minutes is a timer-driven nudge that Dilnoza does not need. Home copy changing from '8 задач' to '3 задачи · около 8 минут' is fine.

#### A11Y-S16 · modify · effort M · impact 3 — NEW: Reliable audio on 4G - parent-triggered offline sound packs with Range support

- **Addresses:** A11Y-1, A11Y-2
- **Proposal:** Audio-first (S1, S2, S4) only works if clips play on a mid-range phone on 4G. public/sw.js:41 skips every .mp3 and files are served with max-age=0, so even a clip heard yesterday needs the network. Add (1) immutable, content-hashed audio URLs and 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' in next.config.ts headers; (2) a cache-first route for /audio/ in sw.js that supports Range requests by reading the whole cached file and answering 206 with the requested slice (or Workbox RangeRequestsPlugin), so seeking and replays work offline; (3) a parent-only action in SettingsPanel: 'Скачать звуки для работы без интернета: Неделя 1 (≈ X МБ)' with size shown before the tap, a progress bar and storage check through navigator.storage.estimate(); only the UI language is downloaded; also request navigator.storage.persist() after the first reward and say 'Сохранено на этом телефоне' (progress and audio). Nothing is prefetched automatically; the only automatic caching is the clip being played (cache after first successful play, capped at about 20 MB with LRU eviction).
- **Revised after review:** Phase 1, small: version audio URLs with the text hash that voice-clips.json already stores (for example /audio/tasks/w1d1t1.mp3?v=<hash>), and send Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for /audio/* so browsers keep clips and revalidation round-trips disappear; a re-recorded clip changes ?v=. Service worker: cache-first for /audio/ with Range support (read the cached body and answer 206 with the slice, or fall through to the network), cache only clips the child actually played, and cap by number of entries. Do not call persist() in the child flow; call it only from the parent settings. Phase 2, later with the parent phase: a parent-triggered 'Звуки без интернета' per week and language with size shown before download, a progress bar, a storage check and a delete button. Nothing prefetched automatically on mobile data. Test: offline play of a clip heard before, time-to-first-sound on Slow 4G before/after, and that a clip with changed ?v= is re-fetched.
- **UI spec:** Parent settings card 'Звуки без интернета': list of packs (Неделя 1, Неделя 2, Неделя 3, Шахматы: уровни 1-2) each with size, 'Скачать' 48px button, then 'Скачано ✓' and 'Удалить'. Progress bar with percentage text, cancel button. Low-storage warning if free space < pack size x 3. Child never sees this card.
- **Copy:** RU: Звуки без интернета · Скачать · Скачано · Удалить · На это уйдёт примерно {N} МБ. Лучше скачивать по Wi-Fi. / UZ: Internetsiz ovozlar · Yuklab olish · Yuklab olindi · O'chirish · Taxminan {N} MB kerak. Wi-Fi orqali yuklab olgan ma'qul.
- **Files:** public/sw.js, next.config.ts, src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx, src/components/ServiceWorker.tsx, src/lib/voice.ts
- **Inspired by:** Local-context research (80 MB of mp3, 536 files, no mp3 caching, median clip about 139 KB); web.dev range-request guidance; PWA offline practice for low-end Android.
- **Guardrails:** No automatic large downloads on mobile data, size always shown before download, easy deletion. Do not collect any usage data about downloads. No pressure copy to download. Do not claim guaranteed offline play if the browser evicts storage.
- **Test plan:** Playwright with context.setOffline(true) after downloading week 1: task clip plays (206 from cache) and seeking works; before download offline shows the silent fallback with 'нужен интернет' only for the speaker tooltip. Check that cache size matches the pack size shown and that delete frees it. Lighthouse PWA offline check. Measure clip time-to-first-sound on Slow 4G throttle before/after (target under 300ms from cache).
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. The gap is real and checked: public/sw.js:41 returns early for every .mp3, next.config.ts sets no cache headers for /audio, and public/audio is 82 MB (536 files; about 164 KB per task clip). Audio-first design (S1, S2, S4) is only as good as clip start time on a parent's phone on 4G. But 'immutable, content-hashed URLs' do not exist today: clips are addressed as /audio/tasks/<id>.mp3, so a one-year immutable header would make a re-recorded clip (S5 will cause some) play stale for a year in browsers that cached it. A hand-rolled 206 Range slicer in the service worker is custom code with a Safari/iOS risk. Calling navigator.storage.persist() after the first reward could trigger a prompt in some browsers, in the child flow. A parent-facing download pack UI is a parent-area feature, which belongs to the later parent phase, and 'LRU with 20 MB cap' needs custom code on top of the Cache API.

## Perceived performance, states, consistency

Perceived performance, states and consistency (TECH). The pipes are lighter than expected. The home page transfers about 680 KB in 43 requests. Narration mp3s average 165 KB (64 kbps mono) and none are fetched on load. The puzzle bank loads lazily, at most 74 KB per theme. There is no horizontal overflow on any page. The weak spots are mostly state and consistency problems, not bandwidth. (1) The page is deliberately hidden until hydration for Uzbek UI and for any named child on /week, /parent and /my-problems; on a throttled mid-range phone that is about 1.8 s of blank screen. (2) In-page sub-views do not reset scroll, so openings and puzzle modes open mid-page. (3) Narration fails silently offline and has no loading state. (4) The parent PIN gate can be removed by any child who can read. (5) The list pages (openings, endgames, games, history) are heavy: 8,001 DOM nodes and a 791 ms long task on openings, with 554 unlabelled focusable elements. Measurements were taken with Playwright on Pixel 7 emulation: 4x CPU, 150 ms latency, about 1.6 Mbps, service worker blocked; scripts are in scratchpad/audit-agents/tech. Housekeeping: my first Playwright run wrote four screenshots into the project directory by mistake; I moved them straight to the scratchpad, so nothing is left in /home/user/Davlatjon.

**Keep (strengths):**

- Network weight is already modest: home is 43 requests / about 680 KB on a throttled load (FCP 868 ms at 4x CPU + 4G) and no mp3 is requested until a child taps a button. Narration is 64 kbps mono (avg 165 KB, max about 726 KB; 165 task clips = 27 MB total, fetched only on demand). Keep this.
- The Lichess puzzle bank is split into per-theme JSON files (mix.json 73 KB, mate3.json 32 KB; public/puzzles 572 KB in total). It has Loading and LoadError states with a friendly 'Ещё раз' retry (PuzzleBankViews.tsx:114-139), failed loads are evicted from the cache (puzzleBank.ts:73), and other themes are pre-cached for offline use (puzzleBank.ts:79-83).
- History page images are lazy (107 of 107 images loading=lazy, all with alt text) and fonts are one variable Nunito file (about 60 KB).
- Hydration-safe store: useSyncExternalStore with default-state snapshot (store.ts:90-95, useToday.ts), so no hydration errors. CLS on home is only 0.012, on lessons 0, on history/openings 0 to 0.001.
- Answer fields are well tuned for phones: inputMode="numeric", 24 px font (no zoom on focus), 48 px height, not auto-focused (no keyboard pop-up covering the task); name field has autocapitalize=words, enterKeyHint=done, autocomplete off (ChildNameField.tsx:34-48).
- Deep links and history behave well on list pages: #task-N and #finish work, #task-99 is clamped to the last task, and Back from an opening detail restores the list scroll position (2568 px). No page has horizontal overflow (hOverflow false for all 26 phone pages).
- A custom 404 ('Робот не нашёл такую страницу') in the app's voice with one big 'На главную' button; the reset-progress action uses an inline two-step confirm with a rose-coloured 'Да, удалить' and 'Отмена' (SettingsPanel.tsx:163-190); answers on print pages are gated behind the PIN (PrintView.tsx:127).
- Service worker caches hashed build files and images cache-first and keeps /api out of the cache (sw.js:42-52), which is the correct split; the PIN field is type=password with inputMode=numeric and a 3xl big-digit style (ParentGate.tsx:76-83).

### Findings

#### TECH-1 · major · confirmed — The whole page is hidden for about 1.8 s on cold open in Uzbek, and on lesson/parent pages for any named child

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** An inline head script adds the class i18n-wait when the UI language is Uzbek, or when a name is saved and the path is /week, /parent or /my-problems. CSS then sets body opacity to 0 until LangSync removes the class after hydration, with a 1.5 s safety timeout. On a throttled phone hydration is slow, so the child stares at an empty cream background with no logo, skeleton or spinner. Every Uzbek cold open and every lesson open after the first launch is affected, even in Russian.
- **Evidence:** src/app/layout.tsx:42 (script) and src/app/globals.css:265-267 (html.i18n-wait body {opacity:0}); removal only in src/components/LangSwitch.tsx:48 after hydrated.; Measured with 4x CPU + 4G (perf.mjs/wait.mjs): ru /week/1/day/1 unhide at 1775 ms, FCP 1976 ms; ru /chess unhide 599 ms, FCP 804 ms; uz / unhide 1784 ms, FCP 1988 ms; uz /chess 1841 ms; uz /chess/puzzles 1867 ms; 6x CPU + Fast3G: lesson 1865 ms. Unthrottled it is only 238 ms, so it is invisible on developer hardware.; /parent in Russian with a saved name: unhide 1780 ms, FCP 1952 ms.
- **Principle:** Perceived performance: show something meaningful immediately (skeleton or progressive paint) rather than a blank page; a blank screen over 1 s on a child's device is read as 'broken' and causes repeated taps (Nielsen's 1 s flow threshold). Never trade first paint for avoiding a text flicker.
- **Impact:** The platform's main language (Uzbek) and its main activity (a lesson) both start with about 2 s of nothing on a mid-range phone on 4G. Aziz is the least likely to wait.
- **Skeptic:** The layout.tsx script, the globals.css rule and the removal in LangSync after hydration are all as cited. My own run on a Pixel 7 profile (4x CPU, 4G) gave: ru /week/1/day/1 with name 'Анна' unhid at 1771 ms and FCP 1980 ms; uz / unhid at 2058 ms, FCP 2264 ms; ru /parent with name unhid at 1770 ms; ru /chess unhid at 539 ms. The same lesson with no saved name unhid at 468 ms, so the 'named child' condition is real. The impact is only on throttled devices (unthrottled it is about 240 ms), and 'nothing' means a cream background rather than a white screen. It still matches the target phone and the main language.

#### TECH-2 · major · confirmed — Sub-views inside a page do not reset scroll, so new screens open mid-page

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** Openings, puzzle modes, games, secrets and play modes navigate by changing location.hash. setHash (useHash.ts) never scrolls. Only DaySession, ChessLevelView and GameReview call scrollTo(0). A child who has scrolled the list opens a short detail page that starts at the old scrollY, clamped to the bottom, so the title, board and Back link are off-screen above.
- **Evidence:** Openings (scroll.mjs, Pixel 7): card at scrollY 2568 -> after tap scrollY 630 on a 1469 px page with 839 px viewport, i.e. exactly the page bottom; screenshot audit-agents/tech/openings-detail.png shows the move list, 'Как играть' and the trainer buttons but not the board or the title.; Puzzles hub: tapping 'Решать задачу дня' at scrollY 747 -> #daily at scrollY 194 on a 1033 px page (scroll2.mjs).; scrollTo exists only at DaySession.tsx:46, ChessLevelView.tsx:53, GameReview.tsx:465; src/lib/useHash.ts:16-19 has no scroll handling.
- **Principle:** Orientation and 'new screen starts at the top': a navigation must reset the viewport so a child sees the title and the primary object first (Nielsen: visibility of system status; match between system and the real world: a new page begins at its top).
- **Impact:** Aziz lands in the middle of an unfamiliar page with no board visible and assumes he tapped the wrong thing; this affects every chess hub that uses hashes.
- **Skeptic:** useHash.setHash only assigns location.hash, and scrollTo exists only in DaySession, ChessLevelView and GameReview (grep). I reproduced it on openings: a card at scrollY 3849 on a 4688 px page; after the tap the page is 1892 px high and scrollY 1053, which is the bottom, and the h1 sits at -905 px. My screenshot open-detail.png shows 'Как играть', 'Интересно' and the trainer buttons, but not the title or the board. Browsers restore scroll to the clamped old position because the content is swapped in place.

#### TECH-3 · major · confirmed — Narration fails silently offline and has no loading or error state; the button is the smallest control on the screen

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** The service worker explicitly skips every .mp3 (even though the clips are tiny), and the player has no 'loading' or 'failed' feedback: it flips the button to 'Стоп' immediately, and when play() rejects it just flips back. On 4G the first tap waits for the buffer with a 'playing' button but silence; offline the tap does nothing. Clips are never prefetched for the lesson the child just opened. The button is also visually secondary: 36 px high, small pill next to the 'Задача 1 из 8' text.
- **Evidence:** public/sw.js:33 ('Звук браузер запрашивает кусками — его не кэшируем') ; src/lib/voice.ts:112-128 (emit(id) before audio is ready; catch only resets state, no message).; Offline test (listen.mjs): task page loaded from cache, context.setOffline(true), click 'Прочитать' -> button text unchanged '🔊 Прочитать', no sound, no message; zero mp3 requests on load.; src/components/ListenButton.tsx:23 min-h-9 text-sm; measured box 122x36 px at (253,190) in task1.png, while the primary 'Проверить' and 'Дальше' buttons are about 56 px.; Clip sizes: tasks avg 165 KB, max 726 KB (a lesson day of 8 clips is about 1.3 MB).
- **Principle:** Visibility of system status plus recognition: audio is the pre-reader's primary channel, so its states (loading, playing, unavailable) need a visible, audible-icon feedback and a graceful offline path. Equal-importance controls need equal target size (WCAG 2.5.5, 44 px).
- **Impact:** Aziz cannot read the condition and relies on the sound; a silent failure teaches him that the app is unreliable. On a parent's metered 4G the first-tap delay is also unexplained.
- **Skeptic:** sw.js:33 skips every .mp3, and mp3 is served with Cache-Control 'public, max-age=0', so offline playback is impossible. voice.ts playClip emits the playing state before the audio is ready, and a failed play() only resets state with no message. In my run the lesson page made 0 mp3 requests on load, and offline the 'Прочитать' button stayed '🔊 Прочитать' with no sound and no message. The button measured 122x36 against 'Проверить' 145x56 and 'Открыть подсказку' 186x44. The 'loading' part is inferred from code, not timed. Offline use of narration needs a prior connection anyway, so the severity stays major rather than higher.

#### TECH-4 · minor · partly — The parent gate is a 'please don't' sign for a 10-year-old: the reset word is printed next to the field, and the first visitor to /parent sets the PIN

- **Who:** DILNOZA, PARENT
- **Problem:** Behind the PIN are the answers, progress reset, import of a progress file and name change. The 'Забыли PIN-код?' panel shows the exact confirmation word in bold ('сбросить' / 'oʻchirish') in the same paragraph as the field, so any reading child can wipe the PIN without any adult knowledge, then set a new one and enter. When no PIN exists (rich scenario) the first screen is 'Новый PIN-код', so whoever opens /parent first controls it; a child who does can lock the parent out. There is no attempt counter or delay on the 4-digit code (10,000 combinations). The full parent navigation (Обзор, Недельный обзор, Шахматы, Методичка, Настройки) is visible above the lock card, and the 🔒 'Родителям' icon sits next to the RU/UZ toggle on every page.
- **Evidence:** src/components/parent/ParentGate.tsx:105-137 (RESET_WORDS = ['сбросить','oʻchirish'] printed with <b> and checked against the input; forgetPin removes the hash with no other check); src/lib/parentGate.ts:12-14 admits it is only a 'soft' lock.; rich-phone-parent-t1.jpg: 'Раздел для взрослых' asks to create a PIN, parent nav tabs visible above it.; parentGate.ts unlockWithPin has no failure counter or lockout.
- **Principle:** A gate for adults has to rely on adult-only knowledge or ability (a short arithmetic question, a hold gesture, 'type the number in words'), and a safe default state should be set by the adult during onboarding, not 'first come first served' (children's app guidelines, e.g. Apple Kids parental gates).
- **Impact:** The parent's trust in 'safe sessions' and the integrity of the progress (certificates, crowns, wiped-by-curiosity) depend on a barrier that a motivated fifth-grader will pass in under a minute.
- **Skeptic:** The code facts are right: the reset word is printed in <b> in the same paragraph (ParentGate.tsx:105-137), forgetPin has no other check, unlockWithPin has no counter or delay, and rich-phone-parent-t1.jpg shows the 'create PIN' state with the parent tabs above it. However, parentGate.ts:5-7 openly calls this a soft lock against accidental peeking, and the card text says 'чтобы ребёнок случайно не увидел ответы'. The data is in localStorage on a device the child owns anyway. It is a valid design weakness but off-dimension and overstated as a security flaw, so I rate it minor.

#### TECH-5 · minor · partly — List pages are heavy: openings draws about 40 full chessboards as thumbnails inside buttons; endgames and history are 13-15 screens long

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** Each opening card is a <button> that contains a complete react-chessboard (64 squares plus piece SVGs). The page therefore has 8,001 DOM nodes, 573 SVGs and 554 unlabelled focusable/role elements nested inside buttons. Under 4x CPU this causes an 791 ms long task and many 200-300 ms ones. Games has 211 interactive and 196 unnamed elements for ten thumbnails. Endgames is 4,671 nodes and 15.4 screens with 294 text nodes under 14 px, and history is 23,850 px (13.5 screens) with 120 credit links under 32 px high and 402 text nodes under 14 px.
- **Evidence:** src/components/chess/OpeningsView.tsx:96-110 (button wrapping <ChessBoard maxWidth=120 ...> per card; replayPositions for each card).; heavy.mjs (Pixel 7): openings noName 554, svg 573; games noName 196; endgames noName 54, svg 77; history tinyLinks 120, 107 images.; perf.mjs 4x CPU + 4G: openings nodes 8001, longtasks [... 791, 309, 303 ...] ms; endgames longtasks up to 491 ms, nodes 4671, CLS 0.042.; audit-metrics.json: 'phone /chess/openings' interactive 579, noName 554; 'phone /chess/history' small44 133, tiny32 120, textUnder14 402; 'phone /chess/endgames' ratio 15.4, textUnder14 294.
- **Principle:** Perceived performance and chunking (Miller/Hick): static previews should be static (SVG/CSS grid or image), long reference pages should be collapsible or paginated, and a screen reader or keyboard user should not hit 550 tab stops inside a card.
- **Impact:** The phone stutters when Aziz taps a card, scrolling is janky, TalkBack users hear hundreds of unnamed items, and credits and captions at 12 px are hard for an early reader.
- **Skeptic:** The structure claims hold. The OpeningsView.tsx:96-110 button wraps a ChessBoard per card. My 4x CPU run gave 8004 DOM nodes, 573 SVGs and 590 elements with role/tabindex/aria-label inside buttons. audit-metrics.json gives openings noName 554, games noName 196 with 211 interactive, history tiny32 120 with textUnder14 402, and endgames ratio 15.4 with textUnder14 294. The longest long task I measured was 490 ms, not 791 ms, with others at 394, 314 and 262 ms. 'Phone stutters on tap' is inferred rather than observed. These are secondary reference pages, so the effect on Aziz's main flow is limited, but the a11y noise is real.

#### TECH-6 · minor · partly — Layout shifts and text-only waiting states when saved data arrives after paint

- **Who:** AZIZ, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** Several pages paint an empty shell and then re-flow when localStorage-derived data hydrates, so buttons jump under the finger. The puzzle bank 'Loading' state is one line of text ('Загружаю задачи…'), with no skeleton of the board or card that will replace it.
- **Evidence:** Throttled CLS (cls.mjs/perf.mjs): /chess/puzzles 0.157 (shifts caused by the 'Мой уровень: …' block and the solved/best-streak counters), /chess/play 0.109 (mode buttons and level cards), uz /chess 0.179, ru /chess 0.027 (late shift of the 'Разделы школы' section at 3.9 s). Google's 'good' threshold is 0.1.; src/components/chess/PuzzleBankViews.tsx:114-120 Loading = plain text paragraph.
- **Principle:** Skeleton screens and reserved space reduce perceived wait and avoid mis-taps (Core Web Vitals CLS; Doherty threshold).
- **Impact:** A moving hub card under a 7-year-old's thumb leads to accidentally opening a different mode and a feeling of unreliability.
- **Skeptic:** I reproduced the CLS values under 4x CPU and 4G: /chess/puzzles 0.157, /chess/play 0.11, /chess 0.027. The Loading state is a text-only paragraph (PuzzleBankViews.tsx:114-120). I did not reproduce uz /chess 0.179. The numbers appear only under heavy throttling and the 'mis-tap' impact is hypothetical. It is a real but small polish issue.

#### TECH-7 · minor · partly — Progress lives only in localStorage: failures are silent and persistent storage is never requested

- **Who:** DILNOZA, PARENT
- **Problem:** If writing to localStorage fails the app 'works in memory' without telling anyone, and the app never calls navigator.storage.persist(), so Android can clear site data under storage pressure (and parents clear 'cache' to free space). The only warning is a small grey line at the very bottom of pages. Dilnoza's streak, crowns, awards and rank certificates are exactly the things that would vanish.
- **Evidence:** src/lib/store.ts:42-48 (persist() swallows the error with the comment 'работаем в памяти'); no occurrence of navigator.storage in src/; openings-detail.png bottom line 'Прогресс хранится только в этом браузере.'; Sync with Google/Telegram is optional (AccountSync) and never suggested after meaningful progress.
- **Principle:** Error prevention and honest status: a child who has invested weeks needs a safety net; losing earned rewards without notice is demotivating (loss aversion).
- **Impact:** One cleared-cache moment erases the motivation layer, and nobody would know why.
- **Skeptic:** There is no navigator.storage anywhere in src (grep), and store.ts swallows write errors, as cited. Android Chrome often grants persistence automatically to installed PWAs or engaged sites, so 'can clear' is less likely than stated. The sync nudge claim was not tested by me.

#### TECH-8 · minor · partly — Service worker waits for the network before using its own cache (no timeout), so bad 4G feels hung

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** All pages and JSON use network-first with no time limit: on a weak or half-connected 4G link the page waits for the fetch to fail before the cached copy is shown, which can take tens of seconds. The offline fallback text is a plain Russian string with 503 status even for Uzbek users, and the app has no visible 'offline' indicator anywhere.
- **Evidence:** public/sw.js:26-41 networkFirst (await fetch, cached only in catch), 48-57 (fallback text 'Нет интернета, а эта страница ещё не открывалась…' unstyled, Russian only).; Only PuzzleTrainer.tsx mentions offline in src/components; no global offline status.
- **Principle:** Resilience and perceived speed on unreliable networks: stale-while-revalidate or a 2-3 s network timeout; error messages in the user's language and tone.
- **Impact:** On a village or elevator 4G the child waits on a spinner-less white screen while a perfectly good cached lesson is available.
- **Skeptic:** sw.js networkFirst awaits fetch with no timeout and the fallback is a plain Russian 503 string (sw.js:26-57), and PuzzleTrainer is the only component mentioning offline. I did not reproduce 'tens of seconds'; that depends on the network stack, so it is an inference. A lie-fi stall is a well-known weakness of this pattern.

#### TECH-9 · minor · confirmed — First-launch welcome dialog scrolls inside itself; name, age and 'Поехали!' are below the fold

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** The welcome dialog contains a heading, a paragraph, three rules, a listen button, the name field, 10 age buttons in 2 rows and the start button. On a 412x839 viewport the dialog content is 1066 px high in an 807 px box, so the age buttons start at y=856 and 'Поехали! 🚀' at y=970, below the fold. Focus remains on BODY rather than in the dialog. The language buttons and listen button are 36 px high.
- **Evidence:** welcome.mjs on Pixel 7: vh 839, dialog scrollH 1066 vs clientH 807; buttons: 'Русский'/'Oʻzbekcha' h36, '🔊 Послушать приветствие' @y548 h36, age '6'-'11' @y856 h44, 'Поехали! 🚀' @y970 h56; focus: BODY.; fresh-phone-home-t1.jpg shows three rule sentences before the name field.
- **Principle:** Single clear action per screen for a pre-reader; keep the primary call to action visible (Fitts, progressive disclosure). Modals must take focus (WCAG 2.4.3).
- **Impact:** Aziz's first minute is a scroll through text he cannot read to find the start button; this is the first impression of reliability and ease.
- **Skeptic:** Reproduced on a Pixel 7 fresh profile: dialog scrollHeight 1066 vs clientHeight 807 (viewport 839), the age buttons are at y=856, 'Поехали! 🚀' at y=970 (56 px high), 'Русский'/'Oʻzbekcha' and the listen button are 36 px high, and document.activeElement is BODY although aria-modal is true. welcome.png shows the age heading cut off at the bottom edge. The dialog does scroll, so the start button is reachable, which is why this is minor.

#### TECH-10 · minor · confirmed — Header navigation targets under 44 px and next to the language toggle

- **Who:** AZIZ
- **Problem:** The persistent top bar has the knight, pencil and lock icons at 36x34, 42x34 and 42x34 px, with the RU/UZ toggle directly beside the lock. A slightly missed tap switches the whole UI language or opens the grown-up area. The same bar appears on all 26 phone pages and is the smallest repeated target.
- **Evidence:** audit-metrics.json smallSamples for chess/history/openings/endgames/games/play: '♞Шахматы 36x34', '✍️Мои задачи 42x34', '🔒Родителям 42x34'; rich-phone-home-t1.jpg.; Inconsistent with the 56 px primary Button and the 44 px age buttons.
- **Principle:** Fitts's law and WCAG 2.5.5: minimum 44x44 px (children's thumbs need more) with spacing between unrelated actions; consistent control sizing.
- **Impact:** Mis-taps cost Aziz a context switch (language changes, parent lock) that he cannot understand or undo.
- **Skeptic:** Measured in the live header: 'Шахматы' 36x34, 'Мои задачи' 42x34, 'Родителям' 42x34, RU and UZ 33x32 each. They are all below 44 px and the lock sits next to the toggle (gap about 10 px in rich-phone-parent-t1.jpg). The finding overlooks that the language toggle itself (33x32) is even smaller than the icons.

#### TECH-11 · polish · confirmed — A lesson step is a history entry, so Back walks through every task instead of leaving

- **Who:** AZIZ, PARENT
- **Problem:** Every 'Дальше' pushes a #task-N hash entry. After three taps the history has 5 entries and Back goes to #task-3 (scrollY 0). Leaving the lesson from task 8 needs about 8 back presses with the Android gesture. This is nice as 'undo previous task' but unexpected as 'leave'; there is no 'finish for today / progress is saved' reassurance.
- **Evidence:** probe.mjs: after three 'Дальше', location.hash '#task-4', history.length 5; goBack -> '#task-3'.; src/components/session/DaySession.tsx:44-47 setHash(hashForStep) on each step; useHash.ts replaceHash exists but is not used here.
- **Principle:** Predictable navigation and user control (Nielsen #3): back should mean 'leave', and a visible 'save and exit' reduces anxiety.
- **Impact:** A tired child or parent cannot quickly exit; a minor but repeated friction.
- **Skeptic:** Reproduced: after three 'Дальше' clicks location.hash was #task-4 and history.length 5; goBack went to #task-3 (not out of the lesson). Whether this is a defect or a deliberate undo is a design call, hence polish.

#### TECH-12 · polish · confirmed — Destructive actions use two different confirmation patterns, and native dialogs are not readable by a child

- **Who:** PARENT, DILNOZA
- **Problem:** Reset progress uses a themed, inline two-step confirm; replacing progress from a file and deleting a 'my problem' use window.confirm (browser-styled, in the OS language, can be blocked by Chrome after repeated dialogs). The two patterns differ in tone, button naming and visibility, and none offers undo.
- **Evidence:** src/components/parent/SettingsPanel.tsx:37 (window.confirm for import) vs :163-190 (inline 'Точно удалить весь прогресс?' + 'Да, удалить'/'Отмена'); src/components/MyProblems.tsx:156 (window.confirm for delete).; Plain-text confirm in ParentGate.tsx:105 uses yet another pattern (type a word).
- **Principle:** Consistency and standards, plus error prevention: one confirm component with a clear verb and a safe default, preferably with undo for child-created content.
- **Impact:** Minor friction and inconsistency; a child deleting her own problem with an unthemed system dialog may confirm without understanding.
- **Skeptic:** window.confirm is used at SettingsPanel.tsx:37 and MyProblems.tsx:156, while progress reset uses an inline two-step confirm (SettingsPanel.tsx:163-190) and the PIN reset uses a typed word. Three patterns coexist. Consistency issue only.

**Missed by the auditor (found by the skeptic):**

- (minor) No error boundary and no loading UI at all in the app router — find src/app -name loading.tsx -o -name error.tsx -o -name global-error.tsx returns nothing; only src/app/not-found.tsx exists. A runtime exception, a corrupted localStorage shape or a failed chunk load on 4G falls back to the framework default error screen, with no friendly 'try again' in Russian or Uzbek and no recover button for a child.
- (minor) The language toggle (RU/UZ) is the smallest target in the header, 33x32, and sits beside the parent lock — m.mjs on /chess: RU 33x32, UZ 33x32, 'Родителям' 42x34. TECH-10 lists only the icons; a missed tap switches the whole UI language mid-session.
- (minor) Praise and retry cheer clips go through the same uncached, unprefetched mp3 path — voice.ts cheer() calls playClip on a random clip after every answer, and sw.js:33 never caches .mp3 (Cache-Control max-age=0). Each cheer therefore needs a fresh request, so on slow 4G the encouraging sound arrives late, after the on-screen feedback, and offline it never plays. Same root cause as TECH-3 but it hits every task, not only the Read-aloud button.
- (polish) Service worker cache name is a fixed 'davlatjon-lab-v1' and all non-hashed pages are cached network-first without versioning — public/sw.js:2 CACHE = 'davlatjon-lab-v1'; activate only deletes other cache names. Cached HTML for stale deploys can reference removed /_next/static chunks when the user is offline after a deploy, giving a half-working cached page. Not reproduced, inferred from code.
- (polish) Sub-view hash navigation also lacks focus management — useHash.ts setHash only changes location.hash; after the openings tap in my run the document was left at the clamped scroll position (scrollY 1053, h1 at -905) and nothing moved focus to the new heading, so TalkBack and keyboard users get no announcement of the new screen. Same root cause as TECH-2.

### Solutions

#### TECH-S1 · modify · effort S · impact 5 — Никогда не пустой экран: CSS-заставка с роботом вместо opacity:0 и короткий потолок ожидания

- **Addresses:** TECH-1
- **Proposal:** Убрать 'белый экран' на 1.8 с. (1) В globals.css заменить `html.i18n-wait body{opacity:0}` на `html.i18n-wait body>*{visibility:hidden}` плюс `html.i18n-wait::before` (position:fixed; inset:0; фон --paper; по центру логотип-робот 96 px как data-URI SVG) и `::after` с тремя пульсирующими точками. Чистый CSS, виден на первом же paint, потому что класс ставит inline-скрипт в <head>. Без слов, поэтому одинакова для RU и UZ. (2) В inline-скрипте layout.tsx:42 снизить страховочный таймаут 1500 -> 700 мс. (3) Для /week, /parent, /my-problems с именем: не ждать вовсе. Там на SSR уже есть нейтральная форма ('Друг'); подмена нескольких слов хуже не будет, чем 1.8 с пустоты. Ожидание оставить только для UZ, где меняется весь язык. (4) Этап 2, только если на реальном телефоне всё ещё >1 с: писать lang в cookie `dj-lang` из LangSync/setLang и читать в layout.tsx через cookies(), чтобы SSR сразу отдавал узбекский (layout станет динамическим, сначала замерить TTFB). Заставка гасится fade 150 мс; при reduced-motion без анимации.
- **Revised after review:** 1) globals.css: `html.i18n-wait body>*{visibility:hidden}` + `html.i18n-wait::before` (fixed, inset:0, фон --paper, робот-логотип 96 px data-URI SVG по центру) + `::after` три точки. Весь слой заставки стартует с `opacity:0` и `animation: splash-in 150ms 250ms forwards`: если страница готова быстрее 250 мс, ребёнок видит только фон --paper без вспышки логотипа. При reduced-motion точки статичны. Без aria (заставка не читается скринридером, контент под ней скрыт <1.5 с). 2) Потолок: для uz оставить 1500 мс (чужой язык хуже заставки); для именованных страниц (/week,/parent,/my-problems) на русском снизить до 600-700 мс и принять мгновенную подмену 'Друг'->имя. 3) Cookie `dj-lang` (только язык, не имя) и dynamic layout - отдельным этапом, только если на реальном Android после заставки uz всё ещё >1 с, и после замера влияния на статические страницы дней и на SW-кэш. 4) Проверки: тап не проходит сквозь заставку, e2e ждёт h.dataset.lang, печать не затронута (класс ставится только в screen).
- **UI spec:** Заставка: фон --paper, по центру LogoMark 96 px (data-URI SVG, ~1 KB), под ним три точки 10 px, пульсация 1.2 с (opacity .3->1, сдвиг фазы 150 мс). Нет текста, нет спиннера-кольца (кольцо читается как 'зависло'). Переход на контент: fade 150 мс. При prefers-reduced-motion точки статичны. Заставка не блокирует тапы дольше 700 мс (потолок).
- **Copy:** RU: (без текста; aria-label у заставки: 'Загружаю') / UZ: (matnsiz; aria-label: 'Yuklanmoqda')
- **Files:** src/app/layout.tsx, src/app/globals.css, src/components/LangSwitch.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Nielsen 1 s flow threshold и skeleton screens (аудит TECH-1); Khan Academy Kids: персонаж как точка опоры, пока что-то грузится
- **Guardrails:** Заставка без слов, без обратного отсчёта, без 'подожди' (не создаёт давления). Не показывать рекламу или подсказки на заставке. Потолок 700 мс, чтобы заставка сама не стала ожиданием.
- **Test plan:** Playwright Pixel 7, 4x CPU + 4G: uz /, uz /chess, ru /week/1/day/1 с сохранённым именем, ru /parent. Метрики: скриншот на 300 мс должен показывать робота, не пустоту; время до unhide <=700 мс, FCP <1000 мс; CLS <0.1. Проверить, что e2e-ожидание h.dataset.lang работает, что тап по скрытому контенту не проходит сквозь заставку, и вид с reduced-motion.
- **Review:** feasibility easy, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Проблема реальна и проверена: globals.css:265 `html.i18n-wait body{opacity:0}`, layout.tsx:42 ставит класс для uz или для /week,/parent,/my-problems с именем, таймаут 1500. Заставка вместо пустоты - верное решение, это чистый CSS. Но три детали вредят: (a) потолок 700 мс на uz означает, что на медленном телефоне вспыхнет русский текст и перескочит на узбекский - то, что ожидание и должно было предотвратить; ребёнку 7 лет это хуже, чем заставка. (b) Заставка без задержки будет мигать логотипом на каждой быстрой загрузке (100-300 мс) у Дильнозы на хорошем планшете. (c) aria-label нельзя повесить на псевдоэлемент, пункт в copy невыполним. Пункт 3 (не ждать имя) допустим, но это обмен: слово 'Друг' сменится именем на глазах читающего с усилием Азиза, поэтому делать после замера, а не сразу. Пункт 4 (cookie dj-lang + cookies() в layout) делает ВЕСЬ сайт динамическим: теряется статическая отдача 3 недель x 7 дней страниц, поэтому только после замера TTFB; имя в cookie класть нельзя (ПДн ребёнка уходят на сервер в каждом запросе), только lang.

#### TECH-S2 · modify · effort S · impact 4 — Новый экран всегда начинается с верха: scroll-to-top и фокус на заголовок внутри setHash

- **Addresses:** TECH-2
- **Proposal:** Научить общий хелпер навигации по хэшу сбрасывать прокрутку. В useHash.ts: `setHash(hash, opts?: {keepScroll?: boolean})` — после смены хэша `requestAnimationFrame(() => window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'instant'}))` и перенос фокуса на первый `h1[tabindex=-1]` (добавить tabIndex=-1 на заголовки подэкранов) для TalkBack. Пройтись по 46 вызовам setHash (PlayHub, PuzzleHub, PuzzleModes, PuzzleBankViews, OpeningsView, MiniDrills, OwnPuzzles, PrintView, GameReview, ChessLevelView) и разметить: 'новый экран' (по умолчанию, сброс) или 'тот же экран' (keepScroll: вкладки Урок/Упражнения/Словарик). DaySession уже сам скроллит. Back (popstate) браузер сам восстанавливает позицию списка (2568 px) — не трогать. Прокрутка мгновенная, не smooth, чтобы не пролетать мимо заголовка на медленном телефоне.
- **Revised after review:** В useHash.ts: setHash(hash,{keepScroll?}) выставляет модульный флаг pendingReset=true (если не keepScroll) и присваивает hash. Один маленький эффект (в useHash или общем ScrollReset) слушает hashchange: если флаг стоит - сбрасывает его и делает `window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'})` после коммита (useLayoutEffect/микрозадача, не rAF) и `h1[tabindex=-1]?.focus({preventScroll:true})`. Popstate/Back флаг не ставит, поэтому браузер восстанавливает позицию списка (2568 px). replaceHash флаг не ставит. Вкладки Урок/Упражнения/Словарик и любые 'обновить параметр на том же экране' помечаются keepScroll. DaySession/ChessLevelView/GameReview оставить как есть. Тест: таблица всех 46 вызовов (новый экран / тот же экран) + e2e #task-N, #finish и Back на списке дебютов.
- **UI spec:** Поведение: тап по карточке дебюта -> экран деталей открывается с названием и доской вверху (scrollY=0); 'Назад' возвращает в список на прежнюю позицию. Вкладки внутри экрана сохраняют позицию. Фокус-кольцо на h1 скрыто (outline:none при программном фокусе).
- **Copy:** RU: (текста нет) / UZ: (matn yo'q)
- **Files:** src/lib/useHash.ts, src/components/chess/OpeningsView.tsx, src/components/chess/PuzzleHub.tsx, src/components/chess/PuzzleModes.tsx, src/components/chess/PuzzleBankViews.tsx, src/components/chess/PlayHub.tsx, src/components/chess/MiniDrills.tsx, src/components/chess/OwnPuzzles.tsx, src/components/chess/GameReview.tsx, src/components/chess/ChessLevelView.tsx

#### TECH-S3 · modify · effort M · impact 5 — Кнопка озвучки: большая, первая на экране и с понятными состояниями (грузится / играет / нет звука)

- **Addresses:** TECH-3
- **Proposal:** Переделать ListenButton и voice.ts. (1) voice.ts: emit состояний 'loading' (после тапа, пока нет события playing), 'playing', 'error'; слушать a.onwaiting/onplaying/onerror и reject от play(); для error хранить причину: offline (!navigator.onLine) или other. (2) ListenButton: для возраста <10 size='lg' — min-h-14 (56 px), иконка динамика 28 px; в задачах и уроках ставится первым элементом карточки (над 'Задача 1 из 8'), а не рядом с мелким текстом. Для 10+ компактная, но не ниже 44 px (min-h-11). (3) Состояния: покой — динамик; loading — динамик с бегущим кольцом и aria-busy; playing — три анимированные волны и 'Стоп'; error — перечёркнутый динамик и под кнопкой плашка в одну строку, кнопка остаётся активной для повтора. (4) При offline-ошибке плашка не пропадает 6 с, текст задачи читается и без звука. (5) Предзагрузка: при открытии задачи `new Audio(src).preload='metadata'` только для текущего клипа, без автоплея.
- **Revised after review:** voice.ts: emit состояния {id,state:'loading'|'playing'|'error'} (подписка onVoiceChange расширяется, cheer-* игнорируют). loading до события 'playing' (onplaying), error по onerror/reject play(), причина offline по !navigator.onLine. ListenButton: проп size; в TaskView и в приветствии при age<10 `lg` (min-h-14, иконка 28 px, подпись 'Послушать'), ставится первым в карточке; во всех остальных местах и для 10+ min-h-11 (44). Состояния: покой - динамик; loading - динамик с тонким вращающимся кольцом (aria-busy), без текста; playing - заполненный фон и 'Стоп' (простая смена иконки, без трёх волн); error - перечёркнутый динамик + одна строка 14 px в amber-soft под кнопкой (role=status), кнопка остаётся активной для повтора, исчезает при следующем тапе или через 6 с. Тексты: 'Не получилось включить звук. Попробуй ещё раз.' / offline 'Нет интернета, но задачу можно прочитать.' Убрать preload metadata. Уважать settings.sound, автоплея нет.

Loading: кольцо 2 px вокруг иконки, вращение 0.9 с. Error: иконка 🔇 и плашка amber-soft (не красная), текст 14 px, role=status. Тапаться можно в любом состоянии. На 412 px расстояние до соседних целей >=8 px.

Различать loading/playing/error нужно; 56 px для возраста <10 и первое место в карточке - верно и подкреплено практикой детских приложений. #### TECH-S4 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — Озвучка работает офлайн: кэш mp3 с поддержкой Range и 'докачка дня' при открытии урока

- **Addresses:** TECH-3, TECH-8
- **Proposal:** В public/sw.js убрать `if (url.pathname.endsWith('.mp3')) return;` и добавить маршрут `/audio/`: cache-first с корректным Range (Chrome/Safari запрашивают куски). Алгоритм: на запрос с Range взять `cache.match(url)` без Range; если нет — fetch целиком, cache.put, затем вернуть срез arrayBuffer().slice(start,end+1) с заголовками 206/Content-Range/Content-Type audio/mpeg. Отдельный кэш `djl-audio-v1`, кэшировать только язык интерфейса (клиент сообщает язык через postMessage). Лимит LRU ~40 МБ и проверка navigator.storage.estimate(). При открытии страницы дня клиент шлёт SW `PREFETCH_DAY {urls}` (озвучка 8 задач дня на текущем языке, ~1.3 МБ) только если `!navigator.connection?.saveData` и тип соединения не 2g/slow-2g; выполняется в idle после первого paint. Позже добавить хеш/версию в имена файлов (Cache-Control сейчас max-age=0).
- **Revised after review:** 1) sw.js: белый список кэшей в activate (CACHE и 'djl-audio-v1'). 2) Маршрут `/audio/`: cache-first по полному URL с query; на Range-запрос брать из кэша целый файл и отдавать срез 206 с Content-Range, Accept-Ranges, Content-Type audio/mpeg; при промахе fetch целиком (без Range), cache.put, затем срез. Ответы не 200 не кэшировать. 3) voice.ts recordedClip добавляет `?v=<отпечаток из voice-clips.json>` к URL клипов задач/уроков/dyk (для общих клипов - версия сборки). 4) Префетч: при открытии страницы дня клиент шлёт SW список URL восьми задач ТЕКУЩЕГО языка, в requestIdleCallback, последовательно, только если !navigator.connection?.saveData и effectiveType не 2g/slow-2g и navigator.storage.estimate() даёт запас. 5) Без LRU, без UI в /parent сейчас (ребёнку и родителю ничего нового не показывается). Тест: офлайн после открытия дня, тап 'Послушать', перемотка/повтор, смена языка, повторная запись клипа подхватывается.
- **UI spec:** У ребёнка нового UI нет. В /parent -> Настройки: строка 'Звук без интернета: сохранено N из M клипов' и кнопка 'Скачать звук недели' с размером (см. TECH-S16 как продолжение).
- **Copy:** RU: (у ребёнка текста нет) / UZ: (bolada matn yo'q)
- **Files:** public/sw.js, src/components/ServiceWorker.tsx, src/lib/voice.ts, src/components/session/DaySession.tsx
- **Inspired by:** web.dev sw-range-requests; Workbox RangeRequestsPlugin; локальный контекст: слабый 4G и сёла (research digest)
- **Guardrails:** Не качать 80 МБ без действия родителя; префетч только текущего дня и не в режиме экономии трафика. Никаких фоновых больших загрузок на мобильных данных.
- **Test plan:** Android Chrome/Playwright: открыть день онлайн, подождать, setOffline(true), тап 'Послушать' -> звук есть (served from SW). Проверить перемотку/повтор (Range 206), смену языка, переполнение квоты (мок estimate), отсутствие регресса картинок. Трафик: страница дня +~1.3 МБ один раз; в saveData 0.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit True, manipulation risk none. Нужное и реально полезное для слабого 4G и сёл: sw.js действительно пропускает .mp3 (`url.pathname.endsWith('.mp3')) return`), клипы задач около 100-115 КБ (w1d1t1.mp3 105 644 Б), день из 8 задач около 0.9-1.3 МБ - префетч допустим. Но в предложении есть минимум три ловушки. (1) Существующий activate в sw.js удаляет все кэши, имя которых не равно CACHE (`keys.filter(k=>k!==CACHE)`): новый `djl-audio-v1` будет стираться при каждом обновлении SW, нужно добавить в белый список. (2) Кэш cache-first без версии: Cache-Control сейчас max-age=0, значит перезаписанная ElevenLabs запись у ребёнка не обновится никогда. Решение уже есть в коде: voice-clips.json хранит отпечаток текста (например 'e19c5227') - добавлять его как `?v=`. 'Хеш позже' нельзя оставлять на потом. (3) Лишнее: LRU на 40 МБ в Cache API (нет метаданных, нужна самописная бухгалтерия), postMessage языка, строка и кнопка в /parent (ссылка на несуществующий S16, вне объёма). Весь аудио-корпус 82 МБ, ребёнок играет единицы клипов, LRU не нужен. Range-логика нужна (комментарий в sw.js говорит, что мп3 исключили сознательно из-за кусков), ручной срез 100 КБ буфера безопасен.

#### TECH-S5 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — Взрослая проверка вместо напечатанного слова: сброс PIN через задачу для взрослых, паузы при переборе, закрытая навигация

- **Addresses:** TECH-4
- **Proposal:** (1) Убрать из текста слово 'сбросить'/'oʻchirish' и всю механику RESET_WORDS (ParentGate.tsx:105-137). Заменить на 'проверку взрослого': случайный пример на умножение двузначных чисел (например 47 x 36) с цифровой клавиатурой; при ошибке новый пример. Это защита от ребёнка и спасение родителя, которого ребёнок заблокировал своим PIN. (2) Счётчик попыток в parentGate.ts: 5 неверных PIN подряд -> пауза 5 мин (timestamp в localStorage). (3) Когда PIN ещё не создан: экран 'Новый PIN-код' тоже за той же проверкой (ребёнок, открывший /parent первым, не займёт PIN), и до разблокировки не рендерить ParentNav и вкладки (сейчас они видны над картонкой замка). (4) Мягкий вход для родителя: на детской главной после первого завершённого дня (не во время занятия) один раз показать закрываемую карточку для взрослых 'Задайте PIN' со ссылкой на /parent. (5) В parentGate.ts честно оставить комментарий 'мягкий замок'.
- **Revised after review:** 1) Убрать слово-подтверждение и RESET_WORDS. 2) 'Забыли PIN-код?' запускает сброс с задержкой: кнопка 'Сбросить PIN' появляется через 24 часа после запроса (timestamp в localStorage, объяснение родителю: 'Сброс будет доступен завтра в HH:MM, прогресс ребёнка сохранится'); мгновенно сбрасывается PIN только у вошедшего в аккаунт Google/Telegram (если sync включён). Это не 'проверка знаний', ребёнок не получает вызова решить задачу. 3) parentGate.ts: 5 неверных PIN подряд -> пауза 5 минут (нейтральный серый текст). 4) Пока не разблокировано (включая экран 'Новый PIN-код'), не рендерить ParentNav и вкладки. 5) Карточку для взрослых на детской главной не делать. 6) Тон нейтральный, без 'Тебе сюда нельзя'. Тест: grep DOM на слово сброса, пауза после 5 ошибок (мок времени), ParentNav не в DOM до разблокировки.
- **UI spec:** Карточка замка на /parent: иллюстрация робота у двери (не пугающая), заголовок, поле PIN 4 цифры крупно (как сейчас). 'Забыли PIN-код?' открывает блок 'Проверка для взрослых': пример `47 x 36 = ?`, цифровая клавиатура, кнопка 'Проверить' (min-h-14). После успеха — установка нового PIN. После 5 ошибок: 'Подождите 5 минут' серым, не красным тоном. ParentNav скрыт до разблокировки.
- **Copy:** RU: Раздел для взрослых · Забыли PIN-код? · Проверка для взрослых: сколько будет 47 x 36? · Проверить · Пока не получилось. Вот новый пример. · Подождите 5 минут и попробуйте снова. / UZ: Kattalar uchun bo'lim · PIN-kodni unutdingizmi? · Kattalar uchun tekshiruv: 47 x 36 necha bo'ladi? · Tekshirish · Hozircha bo'lmadi. Mana yangi misol. · 5 daqiqa kuting va yana urinib ko'ring.
- **Files:** src/components/parent/ParentGate.tsx, src/lib/parentGate.ts, src/components/parent/ParentNav.tsx, src/app/parent/page.tsx, src/components/home/HomeDashboard.tsx
- **Inspired by:** Apple Kids/COPPA parental gate: ворота опираются на знание/умение взрослого (аудит TECH-4); ChessKid: родитель решает о доступе
- **Guardrails:** Не пугать и не стыдить ребёнка (никаких 'Тебе сюда нельзя!'); тон нейтральный. Пример без таймера. Не называть это защитой от взлома — это мягкий замок. Не блокировать ребёнка в остальной части приложения.
- **Test plan:** Юнит: счётчик попыток и пауза 5 мин (мок времени), генерация примеров. e2e: без PIN -> нет ParentNav, нужна проверка; с PIN -> 'Забыли' больше не содержит слова-ответа (grep по DOM); неверный пример даёт новый; успешный даёт форму нового PIN. Проверка с 3 детьми 10-11 лет: сколько проходят без помощи за 2 мин без калькулятора (цель 0 из 3). Родитель проходит <40 с.
- **Review:** feasibility moderate, age fit False, manipulation risk low. Диагноз верен и ценен: ParentGate.tsx:105-137 печатает слово сброса жирным в том же абзаце, пункт 'убрать' - обязательный. Пункты 2 (5 попыток, пауза), 3 (не рендерить ParentNav до разблокировки, и PIN при создании - тот же барьер) и 5 (честный комментарий 'мягкий замок', он уже есть в parentGate.ts) - дёшевы и хороши. Но центральная замена - пример 47 x 36 - не работает для именно этой аудитории: умножение двузначных чисел в столбик проходят в 4 классе, а Дильноза (10, пятиклассница) на платформе по математике решит его на бумаге за минуту; собственный тест-план цели '0 из 3 без калькулятора' на этом и ломается. Гейты-арифметика для 10-12 лет не отличают взрослого от ребёнка. Пункт 4 (карточка 'Задайте PIN' на детской главной) направляет ребёнка в /parent и повторяет дыру 'кто первым открыл, тот и задаёт PIN' - вырезать, у родителя уже есть 🔒 и ссылка в подвале.

#### TECH-S6 · modify · effort M · impact 4 — Лёгкие превью вместо 40 полноценных досок: статичный SVG-миниатюр и сворачиваемые секции на длинных страницах

(2) Карточке-кнопке задать `aria-label={o.name}`, превью aria-hidden -> убрать 554 безымянных элемента. (3) `content-visibility:auto; contain-intrinsic-size:auto 420px` на секциях категорий. (4) Endgames и history: аккордеоны по темам (details/summary с числом '6 позиций'), открыта только первая; в history блок источников фото свернуть в один список 'Кто нарисовал картинки' в конце, ссылки min-h-11. (5) Подписи >=14 px. Цель: openings <1500 узлов, нет long task >200 мс при 4x CPU.
- **Revised after review:** 1) MiniBoard: один <svg viewBox='0 0 8 8' aria-hidden> с 32 тёмными клетками одним <path>, фигуры через <use> на один спрайт <defs> (12 фигур, отрисованных из defaultPieces один раз на страницу). Использовать в OpeningsView и в миниатюрах games. 2) Карточка-кнопка получает `aria-label={o.name}`, миниатюра aria-hidden. 3) `content-visibility:auto; contain-intrinsic-size:auto 420px` на секциях категорий (вспомогательно). 4) История: блок 'Кто нарисовал картинки' одним списком в конце и свёрнут (details), ссылки min-h-11.
